questions.text: "The power of numbers": Why did the king have to give the pilgrim so much rice?
questions.A: Because of the doubling agreement — the amount doubled on every square, reaching exponential growth
questions.B: Because the pilgrim was very hungry
questions.C: Because rice was very cheap at the time
questions.D: Because the king wanted to fill the palace
questions.expl: 1 grain, then double on every square: by the 64th square the total exceeded 18 × 10^18 grains.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Почему королю пришлось отдать паломнику так много риса?
ru.explanation: 1 зерно, затем удвоение на каждой клетке: к 64-й клетке общее количество превысило 18 × 10^18 зёрен.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Shoh nima uchun ziyoratchiga bunday koʻp guruch berishga majbur boʻldi?
uz.explanation: 1 don, soʻngra har bir katakda ikki barobar: 64-katakkacha boʻlganda jami 18 × 10^18 donadan oshib ketdi.

questions.text: "The power of numbers": What is Moore's Law?
questions.A: Memory grows by 424 kilobytes every year
questions.C: Computer speed increases by 400,000 instructions per second
questions.D: The power of computer microchips doubles every 18 months
questions.expl: Moore's Law: microchip power doubles every 18 months.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Что такое закон Мура?
ru.explanation: Закон Мура: мощность микрочипов удваивается каждые 18 месяцев.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Mur qonuni nima?
uz.explanation: Mur qonuni: mikrochipning quvvati har 18 oyda ikki barobar oshadi.

questions.text: "The power of numbers": Which has more memory — the first space shuttle computer or a smartphone?
questions.D: The space shuttle — 424 kilobytes is more
questions.expl: The shuttle had 424 KB; a smartphone has over 33,000,000 times more.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": У чего больше памяти — у компьютера первого шаттла или у смартфона?
ru.explanation: У шаттла было 424 KB; у смартфона — более чем в 33,000,000 раз больше.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Qaysi birida xotira koʻp — birinchi kosmik shattl kompyuterida yoki smartfonda?
uz.explanation: Shattlda 424 KB bor edi; smartfonda esa 33,000,000 martadan koʻproq.

questions.text: "The power of numbers": Why is it now quicker to analyse human genes?
questions.A: Because there are fewer genes now
questions.B: Because the Human Genome Project never finished
questions.C: Because of faster computers — what took 13 years now takes a week
questions.expl: The Human Genome Project took 13 years (1990-2003); faster computers now do it in a week.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Почему теперь анализ человеческих генов проходит быстрее?
ru.explanation: Проект «Геном человека» занял 13 лет (1990-2003); теперь более быстрые компьютеры делают это за неделю.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Nima uchun endi inson genlarini tahlil qilish tezroq?
uz.explanation: Inson genomi loyihasi 13 yil vaqt oldi (1990-2003); endi tezkor kompyuterlar buni bir haftada bajaradi.

questions.text: "The power of numbers": How many people now go to university in the UK and in Finland?
questions.expl: About 40% in the UK (vs ~5% in the 1960s) and 80% in Finland.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Сколько людей теперь учится в университетах в Великобритании и в Финляндии?
ru.explanation: Около 40% в Великобритании (против ~5% в 1960-е годы) и 80% в Финляндии.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Endi Buyuk Britaniya va Finlyandiyada necha kishi universitetda oʻqiydi?
uz.explanation: Buyuk Britaniyada taxminan 40% (1960-yillardagi ~5% ga qarshi), Finlyandiyada 80%.

questions.text: "The power of numbers": Why is research now published more quickly?
questions.A: More postgraduate students → more competition for funding → pressure to publish quickly
questions.expl: The cause-effect chain: more students → competition for funding → as a result, pressure to publish quickly.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Почему исследования теперь публикуются быстрее?
ru.explanation: Цепочка причина–следствие: больше студентов → конкуренция за финансирование → в результате, давление в пользу быстрой публикации.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Nima uchun tadqiqotlar endi tezroq nashr etiladi?
uz.explanation: Sabab–natija zanjiri: koʻproq talabalar → mablagʻ uchun raqobat → natijada tez nashr etish bosimi.

questions.text: Cause–effect connectors: "___ the increase in university students, more people now do research." — choose the connector + noun.
questions.expl: because of + noun (because needs a clause).

ru.text: Коннекторы причины–следствия: "___ the increase in university students, more people now do research." — выберите коннектор + существительное.
ru.explanation: because of + существительное (because требует придаточного предложения).

uz.text: Sabab–natija bogʻlovchilari: "___ the increase in university students, more people now do research." — bogʻlovchi + ot juftligini tanlang.
uz.explanation: because of + ot (because esa qoʻshma gap talab qiladi).

questions.text: Cause–effect: "This has created greater competition. ___, there is more pressure on scientists."
questions.expl: As a result — the fixed connector.

ru.text: Причина–следствие: "This has created greater competition. ___, there is more pressure on scientists."
ru.explanation: As a result — устойчивый коннектор.

uz.text: Sabab–natija: "This has created greater competition. ___, there is more pressure on scientists."
uz.explanation: As a result — oʻzgarmas bogʻlovchi.

questions.text: Cause–effect: "This new research then ___ other new discoveries."
questions.expl: lead to = cause.

ru.text: Причина–следствие: "This new research then ___ other new discoveries."
ru.explanation: lead to = приводить к.

uz.text: Sabab–natija: "This new research then ___ other new discoveries."
uz.explanation: lead to = olib boradi (sabab boʻladi).

questions.text: Cause–effect: "___, new technologies are developed more rapidly." — choose the connector meaning "as a result".
questions.expl: as a consequence = as a result.

ru.text: Причина–следствие: "___, new technologies are developed more rapidly." — выберите коннектор со значением «as a result».
ru.explanation: as a consequence = as a result.

uz.text: Sabab–natija: "___, new technologies are developed more rapidly." — «as a result» maʼnosidagi bogʻlovchini tanlang.
uz.explanation: as a consequence = as a result (natijada).

questions.text: Verbs of change: "The power of microchips ___ every 18 months." (trend verb from the text)
questions.expl: double = become twice as much.

ru.text: Глаголы изменения: "The power of microchips ___ every 18 months." (глагол тренда из текста)
ru.explanation: double = становиться вдвое больше.

uz.text: Oʻzgarish feʼllari: "The power of microchips ___ every 18 months." (matndagi trend feʼli)
uz.explanation: double = ikki barobar boʻlmoq.

questions.text: Trend vocabulary: "Student numbers ___ by 75% between 2000 and 2010." — choose the correct verb + preposition.
questions.expl: rise by + amount (rose by 75%).

ru.text: Лексика трендов: "Student numbers ___ by 75% between 2000 and 2010." — выберите правильную пару «глагол + предлог».
ru.explanation: rise by + величина (rose by 75%).

uz.text: Trend lugʻati: "Student numbers ___ by 75% between 2000 and 2010." — toʻgʻri «feʼl + predlog» juftligini tanlang.
uz.explanation: rise by + miqdor (rose by 75%).

questions.text: Trend vocabulary: "Sales ___ in the third quarter" — which verb is the MOST dramatic (worksheet tip)?
questions.expl: Be dramatic: rocketed tells the audience more than increased.

ru.text: Лексика трендов: "Sales ___ in the third quarter" — какой глагол САМЫЙ драматичный (совет из рабочего листа)?
ru.explanation: Будьте драматичны: rocketed сообщает аудитории больше, чем increased.

uz.text: Trend lugʻati: "Sales ___ in the third quarter" — qaysi feʼl ENG dramatik (varaqdagi maslahat)?
uz.explanation: Dramatik boʻling: rocketed tinglovchiga increased dan koʻproq maʼlumot beradi.

questions.text: Trend vocabulary: Which pair describes DOWNWARD movement most dramatically?
questions.expl: slump and plummet are dramatic downward verbs; jump/take off = up; hold steady/settle = stability.

ru.text: Лексика трендов: Какая пара наиболее драматично описывает движение ВНИЗ?
ru.explanation: slump и plummet — драматичные глаголы движения вниз; jump/take off = вверх; hold steady/settle = стабильность.

uz.text: Trend lugʻati: Qaysi juftlik PASTGA harakatni eng dramatik tasvirlaydi?
uz.explanation: slump va plummet — pastga harakatning dramatik feʼllari; jump/take off = yuqoriga; hold steady/settle = barqarorlik.

questions.text: Quantifying change: "…the number of students studying abroad rose ___ 75% ___ 2000 ___ 2010." — choose the correct series.
questions.expl: rose by 75% between 2000 and 2010 (also: from 2000 to 2010).

ru.text: Количественная оценка изменений: "…the number of students studying abroad rose ___ 75% ___ 2000 ___ 2010." — выберите правильную серию.
ru.explanation: rose by 75% between 2000 and 2010 (также: from 2000 to 2010).

uz.text: Oʻzgarishni miqdoriy ifodalash: "…the number of students studying abroad rose ___ 75% ___ 2000 ___ 2010." — toʻgʻri ketma-ketlikni tanlang.
uz.explanation: rose by 75% between 2000 and 2010 (yoki: from 2000 to 2010).

questions.text: Fluctuation: "The exchange rate ___ between 0.33% and 4%." — choose the verb.
questions.expl: fluctuate between X and Y.

ru.text: Колебание: "The exchange rate ___ between 0.33% and 4%." — выберите глагол.
ru.explanation: fluctuate between X and Y (колебаться между X и Y).

uz.text: Tebranish: "The exchange rate ___ between 0.33% and 4%." — feʼlni tanlang.
uz.explanation: fluctuate between X and Y (X va Y orasida tebranmoq).

questions.text: Test 1 format: What is Test 1?
questions.C: A paper-based writing task, 1 hour, worth 10% of the course grade
questions.expl: Test 1: paper-based writing task, 1 hour, 10% of the grade, covering Weeks 1-3.

ru.text: Формат Test 1: Что такое Test 1?
ru.explanation: Test 1: письменное задание на бумаге, 1 час, 10% итоговой оценки, охватывает недели 1-3.

uz.text: Test 1 formati: Test 1 nima?
uz.explanation: Test 1: qogʻoz asosidagi yozma topshiriq, 1 soat, bahoning 10%, 1-3 haftalarni qamrab oladi.

questions.text: Test 1 checklist: When choosing a tense, what is the FIRST question to ask?
questions.A: Is the word long or short?
questions.B: Is it routine/permanent (PS), now/temporary (PC), or a stative meaning (PS)?
questions.C: Is the sentence long or short?
questions.D: Is the subject human or not?
questions.expl: Routine/permanent → present simple; now/temporary → present continuous; stative → present simple.

ru.text: Чек-лист Test 1: Выбирая глагольное время, какой вопрос задаёте ПЕРВЫМ?
ru.explanation: Регулярное/постоянное → present simple; сейчас/временное → present continuous; состояние → present simple.

uz.text: Test 1 tekshiruv roʻyxati: Zamon tanlashda BIRINCHI qanday savol beriladi?
uz.explanation: Muntazam/doimiy → present simple; hozir/vaqtincha → present continuous; holat → present simple.

questions.text: Test 1 checklist: When choosing an article, what should you ask?
questions.B: Always use the with singular nouns
questions.C: Articles are optional in writing tasks
questions.D: First mention or general → a/an; already known, unique or superlative → the; general plural/uncountable → zero
questions.expl: The article decision tree from Weeks 2.

ru.text: Чек-лист Test 1: Выбирая артикль, о чём следует спросить себя?
ru.explanation: Дерево решений для артикля из недели 2.

uz.text: Test 1 tekshiruv roʻyxati: Artikel tanlashda nimadan soʻrash kerak?
uz.explanation: 2-haftadagi artikel boʻyicha qarorlar daraxti.

questions.text: Test 1 checklist: How much time should you leave for checking?
questions.expl: Leave 5 minutes to check verbs and articles — most marks are lost there.

ru.text: Чек-лист Test 1: Сколько времени нужно оставить на проверку?
ru.explanation: Оставьте 5 минут на проверку глаголов и артиклей — именно там теряется больше всего баллов.

uz.text: Test 1 tekshiruv roʻyxati: Tekshirish uchun qancha vaqt qoldirish kerak?
uz.explanation: Feʼllar va artikelni tekshirish uchun 5 daqiqa qoldiring — aynan shu yerda koʻp ball yoʻqoladi.

questions.text: Test 1 checklist: What sentence type does the answer key convention reward?
questions.A: Long paragraphs without the target grammar
questions.C: Complete sentences with the justified grammatical form
questions.expl: Write complete sentences, not notes — a full sentence with the justified form.

ru.text: Чек-лист Test 1: Какой тип предложения поощряется конвенцией ключа ответов?
ru.explanation: Пишите полные предложения, а не заметки — полное предложение с обоснованной формой.

uz.text: Test 1 tekshiruv roʻyxati: Javoblar kaliti anʼanasi qanday gap turini ragʻbatlantiradi?
uz.explanation: Toʻliq gaplar yozing, qisqa yozuvlar emas — asoslangan shakl bilan toʻliq gap.

tests.title: English for Engineering I — Weeks 1-4: Complete Test · F

questions.text: Getting to know you: "Where ___ you from?"
questions.expl: The verb be with you → are: "Where are you from?" (given question).

ru.text: Знакомство: «Откуда ты ___?»
ru.explanation: Глагол be с you → are: “Where are you from?” (данный вопрос).

uz.text: Tanishuv: «Sen qayerdan ___?»
uz.explanation: you bilan be feʼli → are: “Where are you from?” (berilgan savol).

questions.text: Getting to know you: "Where ___ you born?"
questions.expl: "Where were you born?" — passive past of be with you → were (given question).

ru.text: Знакомство: «Где ты ___?»
ru.explanation: “Where were you born?” — страдательный залог в прошедшем времени от be с you → were (данный вопрос).

uz.text: Tanishuv: «Sen qayerda ___?»
uz.explanation: “Where were you born?” — be feʼlining you bilan oʻtgan zamondagi majhul shakli → were (berilgan savol).

questions.text: What languages do you ___?
questions.expl: speak a language; "say/tell" take different objects, "talk" needs "about/of".

ru.text: Какими языками ты ___?
ru.explanation: speak a language (говорить на языке); “say/tell” требуют других дополнений, “talk” требует “about/of”.

uz.text: Sen qaysi tillarda ___?
uz.explanation: speak a language (til gapirish); “say/tell” boshqa toʻldiruvchilar bilan ishlatiladi, “talk” uchun esa “about/of” kerak.

questions.text: Where do you ___? (= where are you a student / do you work?)
questions.expl: Key: live (also possible: study). "Where do you live?" is the standard question.

ru.text: Где ты ___? (= где ты учишься / работаешь?)
ru.explanation: Ключ: live (возможен также: study). “Where do you live?” — стандартный вопрос.

uz.text: Sen qayerda ___? (= qayerda oʻqiysan yoki ishlaysan?)
uz.explanation: Kalit: live (yana mumkin: study). “Where do you live?” — standart savol.

questions.text: Do you ___ any brothers or sisters?
questions.expl: Do + you + infinitive have: "Do you have any brothers or sisters?"

ru.text: У тебя ___ братья или сёстры?
ru.explanation: Do + you + инфинитив have: “Do you have any brothers or sisters?”

uz.text: Senda aka-uka yoki opa-singillar ___?
uz.explanation: Do + you + have feʼlining asosiy shakli: “Do you have any brothers or sisters?”

questions.text: Do you ___ any pets?
questions.expl: Key: have — "Do you have any pets?" (present simple question with do).

ru.text: У тебя ___ домашние животные?
ru.explanation: Ключ: have — “Do you have any pets?” (вопрос в present simple с do).

uz.text: Senda uy hayvonlari ___?
uz.explanation: Kalit: have — “Do you have any pets?” (do bilan present simple savoli).

questions.text: What do you ___? (= what is your job or study?)
questions.expl: The fixed question "What do you do?" asks about job/study.

ru.text: Чем ты ___? (= какая у тебя работа или учёба?)
ru.explanation: Устойчивый вопрос “What do you do?” спрашивает о работе/учёбе.

uz.text: Sen nima ___? (= ishing yoki oʻqishing nima?)
uz.explanation: “What do you do?” — ish yoki oʻqish haqida soʻraydigan barqaror savol.

questions.text: What time do you ___ up during the week?
questions.expl: get up = leave your bed. Key: get.

ru.text: Во сколько ты ___ в будние дни?
ru.explanation: get up = вставать с кровати. Ключ: get.

uz.text: Hafta davomida soat nechada ___?
uz.explanation: get up = yotoqdan turish. Kalit: get.

questions.text: What do you usually ___ lunch?
questions.expl: have lunch (also eat). Key: have.

ru.text: Что ты обычно ___ на обед?
ru.explanation: have lunch (также: eat). Ключ: have.

uz.text: Odatda tushlikka nima ___?
uz.explanation: have lunch (yana: eat). Kalit: have.

questions.text: What do you usually ___ in the evening?
questions.expl: "What do you do in the evening?" — general activity verb do.

ru.text: Что ты обычно ___ вечером?
ru.explanation: “What do you do in the evening?” — do как общий глагол действия.

uz.text: Kechqurun odatda nima ___?
uz.explanation: “What do you do in the evening?” — umumiy harakat feʼli do.

questions.text: What time do you usually ___ to bed?
questions.expl: go to bed is the fixed expression.

ru.text: Во сколько ты обычно ___ спать?
ru.explanation: go to bed — устойчивое выражение.

uz.text: Odatda soat nechada uxlashga ___?
uz.explanation: go to bed — barqaror ibora.

questions.text: Where did you ___ English before?
questions.expl: did + you + infinitive: study (also: learn). Key: study.

ru.text: Где ты раньше ___ английский?
ru.explanation: did + you + инфинитив: study (также: learn). Ключ: study.

uz.text: Ilgari ingliz tilini qayerda ___?
uz.explanation: did + you + asosiy shakl (infinitiv): study (yana: learn). Kalit: study.

questions.text: What kind of music do you ___ to?
questions.expl: listen TO music; "hear" is not used with to.

ru.text: Какую музыку ты ___?
ru.explanation: listen TO music (слушать музыку); “hear” с to не употребляется.

uz.text: Qanday musiqani ___?
uz.explanation: listen TO music; “hear” feʼli to bilan ishlatilmaydi.

questions.text: What TV programmes or series do you ___?
questions.expl: watch TV programmes — the standard collocation.

ru.text: Какие телепередачи или сериалы ты ___?
ru.explanation: watch TV programmes — стандартное словосочетание.

uz.text: Qanday telekoʻrsatuv yoki seriallarni ___?
uz.explanation: watch TV programmes — standart birikma.

questions.text: Do you ___ any sport or exercise?
questions.expl: do sport / do exercise (also: play + game). Key: do.

ru.text: Ты ___ каким-нибудь спортом или упражнениями?
ru.explanation: do sport / do exercise (также: play + game). Ключ: do.

uz.text: Sen biror sport yoki mashq bilan ___?
uz.explanation: do sport / do exercise (yana: play + game). Kalit: do.

questions.text: What kind of books or magazines do you ___?
questions.expl: read books/magazines.

ru.text: Какие книги или журналы ты ___?
ru.explanation: read books/magazines (читать книги/журналы).

uz.text: Qanday kitob yoki jurnallarni ___?
uz.explanation: read books/magazines (kitob/jurnal oʻqish).

questions.text: How often do you ___ to the cinema?
questions.expl: go to the cinema — fixed expression.

ru.text: Как часто ты ___ в кино?
ru.explanation: go to the cinema — устойчивое выражение.

uz.text: Qanchalik tez kinoga ___?
uz.explanation: go to the cinema — barqaror ibora.

questions.text: What did you ___ last weekend?
questions.expl: did + infinitive: "What did you do last weekend?"

ru.text: Что ты ___ в прошлые выходные?
ru.explanation: did + инфинитив: “What did you do last weekend?”

uz.text: Oʻtgan dam olish kunlari nima ___?
uz.explanation: did + asosiy shakl: “What did you do last weekend?”

questions.text: (?) Anna / like music — Choose the correct question.
questions.expl: does + subject + infinitive (Rule 2): "Does Anna like music?"

ru.text: (?) Anna / like music — Выберите правильный вопрос.
ru.explanation: does + подлежащее + инфинитив (Правило 2): “Does Anna like music?”

uz.text: (?) Anna / like music — Toʻgʻri savolni tanlang.
uz.explanation: does + ega + asosiy shakl (2-qoida): “Does Anna like music?”

questions.text: (+) my sister / have a lot of hobbies — Choose the correct sentence.
questions.A: My sister is have a lot of hobbies.
questions.B: My sister haves a lot of hobbies.
questions.C: My sister have a lot of hobbies.
questions.D: My sister has a lot of hobbies.
questions.expl: have → has after she (Rule 3).

ru.text: (+) my sister / have a lot of hobbies — Выберите правильное предложение.
ru.explanation: have → has после she (Правило 3).

uz.text: (+) my sister / have a lot of hobbies — Toʻgʻri gapni tanlang.
uz.explanation: she dan keyin have → has boʻladi (3-qoida).

questions.text: (−) I / get on very well with my parents — Choose the correct sentence.
questions.A: I doesn't get on very well with my parents.
questions.B: I don't get on very well with my parents.
questions.C: I not get on very well with my parents.
questions.D: I don't gets on very well with my parents.
questions.expl: don't + infinitive for I.

ru.text: (−) I / get on very well with my parents — Выберите правильное предложение.
ru.explanation: don't + инфинитив для I.

uz.text: (−) I / get on very well with my parents — Toʻgʻri gapni tanlang.
uz.explanation: I uchun don't + asosiy shakl.

questions.text: (+) my nephew / study English at university — Choose the correct sentence.
questions.A: My nephew study English at university.
questions.B: My nephew studies English at university.
questions.C: My nephew studys English at university.
questions.D: My nephew is study English at university.
questions.expl: consonant + y → -ies: studies (Rule 3).

ru.text: (+) my nephew / study English at university — Выберите правильное предложение.
ru.explanation: согласная + y → -ies: studies (Правило 3).

uz.text: (+) my nephew / study English at university — Toʻgʻri gapni tanlang.
uz.explanation: undosh + y → -ies: studies (3-qoida).

questions.text: (−) my neighbours / have any children — Choose the correct sentence.
questions.A: My neighbours doesn't have any children.
questions.B: My neighbours not have any children.
questions.C: My neighbours aren't have any children.
questions.D: My neighbours don't have any children.
questions.expl: don't have any — plural subject, any in negatives.

ru.text: (−) my neighbours / have any children — Выберите правильное предложение.
ru.explanation: don't have any — подлежащее во множественном числе, any в отрицаниях.

uz.text: (−) my neighbours / have any children — Toʻgʻri gapni tanlang.
uz.explanation: don't have any — koʻplikdagi ega, inkor gapda any.

questions.text: (?) what time / the film start — Choose the correct question.
questions.A: What time does the film start?
questions.B: What time does the film starts?
questions.C: What time do the film start?
questions.expl: does + the film + start (Rule 2).

ru.text: (?) what time / the film start — Выберите правильный вопрос.
ru.explanation: does + the film + start (Правило 2).

uz.text: (?) what time / the film start — Toʻgʻri savolni tanlang.
uz.explanation: does + the film + start (2-qoida).

questions.text: (+) he / go out twice a week — Choose the correct sentence.
questions.A: He is go out twice a week.
questions.B: He go out twice a week.
questions.C: He goes out twice a week.
questions.D: He gos out twice a week.
questions.expl: go → goes (Rule 3); frequency expression at the end (Rule 6).

ru.text: (+) he / go out twice a week — Выберите правильное предложение.
ru.explanation: go → goes (Правило 3); выражение частотности в конце (Правило 6).

uz.text: (+) he / go out twice a week — Toʻgʻri gapni tanlang.
uz.explanation: go → goes (3-qoida); chastota iborasi oxirida (6-qoida).

questions.text: (−) we / often talk about politics — Choose the correct sentence.
questions.A: We don't often talk about politics.
questions.B: We don't talk often about politics.
questions.C: We often don't talk about politics.
questions.D: We often talk not about politics.
questions.expl: the adverb goes after don't, before the main verb (Rule 5).

ru.text: (−) we / often talk about politics — Выберите правильное предложение.
ru.explanation: наречие стоит после don't, перед смысловым глаголом (Правило 5).

uz.text: (−) we / often talk about politics — Toʻgʻri gapni tanlang.
uz.explanation: ravish don't dan keyin, asosiy feʼldan oldin keladi (5-qoida).

questions.text: (?) how often / you see your brother — Choose the correct question.
questions.A: How often you see your brother?
questions.B: How often does you see your brother?
questions.C: How often are you see your brother?
questions.D: How often do you see your brother?
questions.expl: do + you + see.

ru.text: (?) how often / you see your brother — Выберите правильный вопрос.
ru.explanation: do + you + see.

uz.text: (?) how often / you see your brother — Toʻgʻri savolni tanlang.
uz.explanation: do + you + see.

questions.text: (−) Sally / go on social media very much — Choose the correct sentence.
questions.A: Sally doesn't go on social media very much.
questions.B: Sally don't go on social media very much.
questions.C: Sally isn't go on social media very much.
questions.D: Sally doesn't goes on social media very much.
questions.expl: doesn't + go (third person -s is on the auxiliary).

ru.text: (−) Sally / go on social media very much — Выберите правильное предложение.
ru.explanation: doesn't + go (показатель 3-го лица -s у вспомогательного глагола).

uz.text: (−) Sally / go on social media very much — Toʻgʻri gapni tanlang.
uz.explanation: doesn't + go (-s qoʻshimchasi yordamchi feʼlga qoʻshiladi, 3-shaxs).

questions.text: always / before / go / I / bed / 11.00 / to — Choose the correct order.
questions.A: I go always to bed before 11.00.
questions.B: Always I go to bed before 11.00.
questions.C: I always go to bed before 11.00.
questions.D: I go to bed always before 11.00.
questions.expl: Adverb of frequency before the main verb (Rule 5).

ru.text: always / before / go / I / bed / 11.00 / to — Выберите правильный порядок.
ru.explanation: Наречие частотности перед смысловым глаголом (Правило 5).

uz.text: always / before / go / I / bed / 11.00 / to — Toʻgʻri tartibni tanlang.
uz.explanation: Chastota ravishi asosiy feʼldan oldin keladi (5-qoida).

questions.text: ever / her / Kate / sees / family / hardly — Choose the correct order.
questions.A: Hardly Kate ever sees her family.
questions.B: Kate sees hardly ever her family.
questions.C: Kate hardly sees ever her family.
questions.D: Kate hardly ever sees her family.
questions.expl: hardly ever behaves like a frequency adverb: before the main verb.

ru.text: ever / her / Kate / sees / family / hardly — Выберите правильный порядок.
ru.explanation: hardly ever ведёт себя как наречие частотности: перед смысловым глаголом.

uz.text: ever / her / Kate / sees / family / hardly — Toʻgʻri tartibni tanlang.
uz.explanation: hardly ever chastota ravishi kabi ishlaydi: asosiy feʼldan oldin.

questions.text: Saturdays / never / shopping / on / go / we — Choose the correct order.
questions.A: We go shopping never on Saturdays.
questions.B: Never we go shopping on Saturdays.
questions.C: We never go shopping on Saturdays.
questions.D: We go never shopping on Saturdays.
questions.expl: never before the main verb go.

ru.text: Saturdays / never / shopping / on / go / we — Выберите правильный порядок.
ru.explanation: never перед смысловым глаголом go.

questions.text: TED "Stereotypes" (0:01–0:27): What did people tell Olivia about French people — and what did she discover?
questions.A: People said France was just like her home country.
questions.B: People warned her the French were rude and unfriendly, but she found them kind and welcoming — the stereotype was wrong.
questions.C: People said the French were very friendly, but she found them rude.
questions.D: People told her nothing about the French before her trip.
questions.expl: Before the trip people warned her; on arrival she discovered the opposite — a classic wrong stereotype.

ru.text: TED «Stereotypes» (0:01–0:27): Что люди рассказывали Olivia о французах — и что она обнаружила?
ru.explanation: До поездки люди предупреждали её; по прибытии она обнаружила обратное — классический ошибочный стереотип.

uz.text: TED «Stereotypes» (0:01–0:27): Odamlar Oliviyaga fransuzlar haqida nima dedilar — va u nimani aniqladi?
uz.explanation: Sayohatdan oldin odamlar uni ogohlantirgan; yetib kelgach esa aksini koʻrgan — notoʻgʻri stereotipning klassik namunasi.

questions.text: TED "Stereotypes" (0:57–1:09): What happened after Olivia won a point in a sport?
questions.A: A boy congratulated her and asked her to join the team.
questions.B: Her coach said she should practise more.
questions.D: A boy told her "you play like a girl" — meant as an insult, and it made her feel hurt, small and angry.
questions.expl: The comment "you play like a girl" treats being a girl as something bad — a gender stereotype.

ru.text: TED «Stereotypes» (0:57–1:09): Что случилось после того, как Olivia выиграла очко в спорте?
ru.explanation: Реплика “you play like a girl” подаёт «быть девочкой» как нечто плохое — гендерный стереотип.

uz.text: TED «Stereotypes» (0:57–1:09): Olivia sportda ochko yutgandan keyin nima boʻldi?
uz.explanation: “you play like a girl” degan gap qiz boʻlishni yomon narsa kabi koʻrsatadi — gender stereotipi.

questions.text: TED "Stereotypes" (2:22): Which two phrases does Olivia mention as harmful?
questions.A: "you play like a girl" and "that's not very ladylike"
questions.B: "you are so tall" and "you are so kind"
questions.expl: Both phrases box children (especially girls) into gender stereotypes.

ru.text: TED «Stereotypes» (2:22): Какие две фразы Olivia называет вредными?
ru.explanation: Обе фразы загоняют детей (особенно девочек) в гендерные стереотипы.

uz.text: TED «Stereotypes» (2:22): Olivia qaysi ikki iborani zararli deb ataydi?
uz.explanation: Har ikkala ibora bolalarni (ayniqsa qizlarni) gender stereotiplariga siqib joylaydi.

questions.text: TED "Stereotypes" (3:15): What are Olivia's three steps to stop contributing to stereotypes?
questions.A: Read more books; watch less TV; do more sport.
questions.B: Ignore stereotypes; change the subject; stay silent.
questions.C: Call out stereotypes; check your own assumptions; be the example.
questions.D: Argue with everyone; write complaints; leave the room.
questions.expl: Her closing message: "You have to be the change you wish to see."

ru.text: TED «Stereotypes» (3:15): Каковы три шага Olivia, чтобы перестать поддерживать стереотипы?
ru.explanation: Её финальный призыв: “You have to be the change you wish to see.”

uz.text: TED «Stereotypes» (3:15): Olivia stereotiplarga hissa qoʻshishni toʻxtatish uchun qanday uch qadamni aytadi?
uz.explanation: Uning yakuniy murojaati: “You have to be the change you wish to see.”

questions.text: Giving your opinion (3.13): "___, I don't think people ___ ___ a driving licence…" — choose the complete correct phrase pair.
questions.A: Personally, I am not thinking people should need a driving licence
questions.B: Personally, I don't think people should need a driving licence
questions.C: Personal, I don't think people should needing a driving licence
questions.D: In person, I don't think people shall need a driving licence
questions.expl: The box trains Personally / should need: opinion adverb + should + infinitive (Rule 7).

ru.text: Выражение своего мнения (3.13): «___, I don't think people ___ ___ a driving licence…» — выберите полную правильную пару фраз.
ru.explanation: Упражнение отрабатывает Personally / should need: наречие мнения + should + инфинитив (Правило 7).

uz.text: Fikr bildirish (3.13): «___, I don't think people ___ ___ a driving licence…» — toʻliq toʻgʻri iboralar juftligini tanlang.
uz.explanation: Mashq Personally / should need ni mustahkamlaydi: fikr ravishi + should + asosiy shakl (7-qoida).

questions.text: Giving your opinion (3.13): "In ___, e-scooters are dangerous." — choose the correct phrase.
questions.B: In my view of e-scooters are dangerous.
questions.C: In my opinionate, e-scooters are dangerous.
questions.D: In my opinion, e-scooters are dangerous.
questions.expl: Key: In my opinion / In my view — fixed phrases for opinions.

ru.text: Выражение своего мнения (3.13): «In ___, e-scooters are dangerous.» — выберите правильную фразу.
ru.explanation: Ключ: In my opinion / In my view — устойчивые фразы для выражения мнения.

uz.text: Fikr bildirish (3.13): «In ___, e-scooters are dangerous.» — toʻgʻri iborani tanlang.
uz.explanation: Kalit: In my opinion / In my view — fikr bildirishning barqaror iboralari.

questions.text: Giving your opinion (3.13): "But I think people ___ to ride them." — choose the correct completion.
questions.A: should have to pass a test to ride them
questions.B: are should passing a test to ride them
questions.C: have should pass a test to ride them
questions.D: should to pass a test to ride them
questions.expl: should + have to + infinitive: "people should have to pass a test" (Rule 7).

ru.explanation: should + have to + инфинитив: “people should have to pass a test” (Правило 7).

uz.text: Fikr bildirish (3.13): «But I think people ___ to ride them.» — toʻgʻri yakunni tanlang.
uz.explanation: should + have to + asosiy shakl: “people should have to pass a test” (7-qoida).

questions.text: Reading "Generalize, but don't stereotype!": Generalizing is useful because it helps us to…
questions.expl: Generalizations are based on facts and evidence and help us understand the world → C.

ru.text: Текст «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Обобщение полезно, потому что помогает нам…
ru.explanation: Обобщения основаны на фактах и доказательствах и помогают нам понимать окружающий мир → C.

uz.text: Matn «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Umumlashtirish foydali, chunki u bizga… yordam beradi.
uz.explanation: Umumlashtirishlar fakt va dalillarga asoslanadi va bizga atrofdagi dunyoni tushunishga yordam beradi → C.

questions.text: Reading "Generalize, but don't stereotype!": Stereotyping is a problem because it is based on…
questions.expl: A stereotype "can come from ideas about these groups, not truths" → B.

ru.text: Текст «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Стереотипизация — проблема, потому что она основана на…
ru.explanation: Стереотип “can come from ideas about these groups, not truths” — возникает из представлений об этих группах, а не из истин → B.

uz.text: Matn «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Stereotiplash muammo, chunki u …ga asoslangan.
uz.explanation: Stereotip “can come from ideas about these groups, not truths” — bu guruhlar haqidagi tasavvurlardan kelib chiqadi, haqiqatlardan emas → B.

questions.text: Reading "Generalize, but don't stereotype!": It's wrong to make assumptions about people based on things like…
questions.expl: The article calls appearance- and gender-based assumptions inappropriate → D.

ru.text: Текст «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Неправильно делать предположения о людях на основе таких вещей, как…
ru.explanation: В статье предположения на основе внешности и гендера названы неуместными → D.

uz.text: Matn «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Odamlar haqida … kabi narsalar asosida taxmin yuritish notoʻgʻri.
uz.explanation: Maqolada tashqi koʻrinish va jinsga asoslangan taxminlar maʼqulsiz deb ataladi → D.

questions.text: Reading "Generalize, but don't stereotype!": Generalizing is neutral, but…
questions.expl: Generalizing is neutral; stereotyping is a harmful, often negative generalization → A.

ru.text: Текст «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Обобщение нейтрально, но…
ru.explanation: Обобщение нейтрально; стереотипизация — вредное, часто негативное обобщение → A.

uz.text: Matn «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Umumlashtirish neytral, lekin…
uz.explanation: Umumlashtirish neytral; stereotiplash esa zararli, koʻpincha salbiy umumlashtirish → A.

questions.text: Complete the quote (Santayana): "___ child educated only at ___ school is ___ uneducated child."

questions.text: Complete the quote (Malala): "___ extremists have shown what frightens them ___ most: ___ girl with ___ book."

uz.text: Iqtibosni toʻldiring (Malala): «___ ekstremistlar ularni ___ eng koʻp qoʻrqitadigan narsani koʻrsatdilar: ___ qiz bilan ___ kitob.»

questions.text: Complete the quote (Sotomayor): "Until we get ___ equality in ___ education we will not be ___ equal society."
questions.expl: Uncountable abstract nouns take zero article; an + adjective (equal) + singular noun.

ru.text: Дополните цитату (Sotomayor): «Пока мы не добьёмся ___ равенства в ___ образовании, мы не будем ___ равноправным обществом.»
ru.explanation: Несчётные абстрактные существительные — нулевой артикль; an + прилагательное (equal) + существительное в единственном числе.

uz.text: Iqtibosni toʻldiring (Sotomayor): «___ tenglikni ___ taʼlimda qoʻlga kiritmagunimizcha, biz ___ teng jamiyat boʻlmaymiz.»
uz.explanation: Sanalmaydigan abstrakt otlar artiklsiz (nol artikl); an + sifat (equal) + birlikdagi ot.

questions.text: Complete the quote (Frost): "Having one child makes you ___ parent. Having two, you are ___ referee."
questions.expl: a member of a class: a parent, a referee.

ru.text: Дополните цитату (Frost): «Один ребёнок делает тебя ___ родителем. Когда детей двое, ты — ___ судья.»
ru.explanation: a — отнесение к классу: a parent, a referee.

uz.text: Iqtibosni toʻldiring (Frost): «Bitta bola seni ___ ota-onaga aylantiradi. Ikkitasi boʻlsa, sen ___ hakamsan.»
uz.explanation: a — sinfga mansublikni bildiradi: a parent, a referee.

questions.text: Ariana is ___ in a hospital. ___ is a long way from her house.

ru.text: Ариана — ___ в больнице. ___ находится далеко от её дома.
ru.explanation: a nurse — представитель класса (профессия); The hospital — конкретная, уже известная больница.

uz.text: Ariana kasalxonada ___. ___ uning uyidan uzoqda joylashgan.
uz.explanation: a nurse — sinf vakili (kasb); The hospital — maʼlum, aniq kasalxona.

questions.text: What ___! We'll have to eat our picnic in ___.

ru.text: Как ___! Придётся съесть наш пикник в ___.

uz.text: Qanday ___! Piknikimizni ___ yeyishimizga toʻgʻri keladi.

questions.text: My wife and I like ___, but our children prefer ___.
questions.A: the love stories; the war films
questions.expl: General plural = zero article.

ru.text: Мы с женой любим ___, но наши дети предпочитают ___.
ru.explanation: Общее множественное число — нулевой артикль.

uz.text: Men va rafiqam ___ yaxshi koʻramiz, lekin farzandlarimiz ___ afzal koʻradi.
uz.explanation: Umumiy koʻplik — nol artikl.

questions.text: We go to ___ about ___.
questions.expl: the theatre = place in a town; a in frequency expressions (once a month).

ru.text: Мы ходим в ___ примерно ___.
ru.explanation: the theatre — место в городе; a в выражениях частотности (once a month).

uz.text: Biz ___ ga taxminan ___ boramiz.
uz.explanation: the theatre — shahardagi joy; chastota iboralarida a (once a month).

ru.text: У меня ___ с друзьями ___.
ru.explanation: Названия приёмов пищи — без артикля; next + день — без the.

uz.text: Men baʼzi doʻstlarim bilan ___ ni ___ oʻtkazaman.
uz.explanation: Ovqat nomlari artiklsiz; next + kun oldidan the kelmaydi.

questions.text: My boyfriend is ___. I think he's ___ in the world.

ru.text: Мой парень — ___. Думаю, он ___ в мире.
ru.explanation: Профессия → a; превосходная степень → the.

uz.text: Mening yigʻitim — ___. Menimcha, u dunyoda ___.
uz.explanation: Kasb → a; superlativ → the.

questions.text: I'm not sure if I closed ___ before I left ___ this morning.
questions.expl: The specific windows of the house; fixed expression left home.

ru.text: Не уверен, закрыл ли я ___ перед тем, как уйти из ___ сегодня утром.
ru.explanation: Конкретные окна этого дома; устойчивое выражение left home (без артикля).

uz.text: Bugun ertalab ___ dan chiqishdan oldin ___ ni yopdim-yoʻqmidi, ishonchim komil emas.

questions.text: In general, I like ___, but I don't like ___ that live next door to me.

ru.text: В целом я люблю ___, но мне не нравятся ___, которые живут по соседству со мной.
ru.explanation: Общее множественное против the + dogs, определённых придаточным предложением.

uz.text: Umuman olganda, men ___ ni yaxshi koʻraman, lekin menga qoʻshnimizda yashovchi ___ yoqmaydi.

questions.text: I got to ___ late every day ___.

ru.text: Каждый день я опаздывал в ___ ___.
ru.explanation: School как учреждение после get to; last + week (без артикля).

questions.text: I think ___ is more important than ___.

ru.text: Я думаю, ___ важнее, чем ___.
ru.explanation: Несчётные абстрактные существительные в общих высказываниях — без артикля.

uz.text: Menimcha, ___ ___ dan muhimroq.
uz.explanation: Umumiy bayonlarda sanalmaydigan abstrakt otlar artiklsiz.

questions.text: "How often do you go to ___ gym?" — "About three times ___ week. But I never go on ___ Fridays."

ru.text: «Как часто ты ходишь в ___ спортзал?» — «Около трёх раз ___ неделю. Но по ___ пятницам я никогда не хожу.»

uz.text: «Sen ___ sportzalga qanchalik tez-tez borasan?» — «Taxminan uch marta ___ haftada. Lekin ___ juma kunlari umuman bormayman.»

questions.text: "What time does ___ train leave?" — "In 40 minutes. Can you drop me off at ___ station on your way to ___ work?"

ru.text: «Во сколько отходит ___ поезд?» — «Через 40 минут. Можешь высадить меня на ___ станции по пути на ___ работу?»

uz.text: BGP 5-mashq: "The marketing people ___ to find a brand name that ___ natural and sophisticated." (try / sound)

uz.text: BGP 5-mashq: "___ what Mrs Ericson ___? She's not in her office." (you / know — she / do)

uz.text: BGP 5-mashq: "Could you help me? I ___ to translate this letter… and I don't know what this word ___." (try / mean)
uz.explanation: Jarayondagi harakat → am trying; statik mean → means.

ru.text: BGP Упр.5: "Their new 'own brand' instant coffee ___ very good, so it ___ more and more popular." (taste / become)

uz.text: BGP 5-mashq: "Their new 'own brand' instant coffee ___ very good, so it ___ more and more popular." (taste / become)

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 1-mashq: "We ___ (be) very tired."
uz.explanation: we → are.

questions.text: Worksheet Ex.1: "Some people ___ (not need) a lot of sleep."

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 1-mashq: "Some people ___ (not need) a lot of sleep."

questions.text: Worksheet Ex.1: "___ your bus late?" (be)

ru.explanation: your bus = it → Is.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 1-mashq: "___ your bus late?" (be)

ru.explanation: have → has (Правило 3).

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 1-mashq: "He ___ (have) a big house in the country."
uz.explanation: have → has (3-qoida).

questions.text: Worksheet Ex.2: correct the mistake: "I often am tired at work."
questions.A: I am tired often at work.
questions.B: Often I am tired at work.
questions.C: I often tired am at work.
questions.D: I am often tired at work.
questions.expl: Adverb goes AFTER the verb be: I am often tired.

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.2: исправьте ошибку: "I often am tired at work."
ru.explanation: Наречие стоит ПОСЛЕ глагола be: I am often tired.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 2-mashq: xatoni tuzating: "I often am tired at work."
uz.explanation: Ravish feʼl be dan KEYIN keladi: I am often tired.

questions.text: Worksheet Ex.2: correct the mistake: "We twice a week eat out in a restaurant."
questions.A: Twice a week we eat out in a restaurant twice.
questions.B: We eat out twice a week in a restaurant twice.
questions.C: We eat out in a restaurant twice a week.
questions.D: We eat twice a week out in a restaurant.
questions.expl: Expression of frequency at the END of the sentence (Rule 6).

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.2: исправьте ошибку: "We twice a week eat out in a restaurant."
ru.explanation: Выражение частотности — в КОНЦЕ предложения (Правило 6).

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 2-mashq: xatoni tuzating: "We twice a week eat out in a restaurant."
uz.explanation: Takrorlik iborasi gap OXIRIDA boʻlishi kerak (6-qoida).

questions.text: Worksheet Ex.2: correct the mistake: "I have two or three times a day a cup of coffee."
questions.A: I have two or three times a day a cup of coffee twice.
questions.B: I have a cup of coffee two or three times a day.
questions.C: I two or three times a day have a cup of coffee.
questions.D: Two or three times a day I have a cup of coffee a day.
questions.expl: The frequency phrase belongs at the end.

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.2: исправьте ошибку: "I have two or three times a day a cup of coffee."
ru.explanation: Обстоятельство частотности должно стоять в конце предложения.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 2-mashq: xatoni tuzating: "I have two or three times a day a cup of coffee."
uz.explanation: Takrorlik iborasi gap oxiriga qoʻyiladi.

questions.text: Worksheet Ex.2: correct the mistake: "They don't play often board games."
questions.A: They often don't play board games.
questions.B: They don't play board games often play.
questions.C: They don't often play board games.
questions.D: They often play don't board games.
questions.expl: Adverb after don't, before the main verb.

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.2: исправьте ошибку: "They don't play often board games."
ru.explanation: Наречие после don't, перед смысловым глаголом.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 2-mashq: xatoni tuzating: "They don't play often board games."
uz.explanation: Ravish don't dan keyin, asosiy feʼldan oldin keladi.

questions.text: Worksheet Ex.2: correct the mistake: "Does usually she take public transport?"
questions.A: Does usually takes she public transport?
questions.B: Does she take usually public transport?

questions.D: Does she usually take public transport?
questions.expl: Adverb after the subject (she), before the main verb.

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.2: исправьте ошибку: "Does usually she take public transport?"
ru.explanation: Наречие после подлежащего (she), перед смысловым глаголом.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 2-mashq: xatoni tuzating: "Does usually she take public transport?"
uz.explanation: Ravish egadan (she) keyin, asosiy feʼldan oldin keladi.

questions.text: Worksheet Ex.3 (My day): "I ___ at about 7.30 a.m. and get ready for work." (frequency word + verb)

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.3 (Мой день): "I ___ at about 7.30 a.m. and get ready for work." (наречие частотности + глагол)
ru.explanation: Ключ: usually + get up — наречие перед смысловым глаголом.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 3-mashq (Mening kunim): "I ___ at about 7.30 a.m. and get ready for work." (takrorlik soʻzi + feʼl)
uz.explanation: Kalit: usually + get up — ravish asosiy feʼldan oldin keladi.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 3-mashq: "I ___ breakfast because I don't feel hungry in the mornings." (takrorlik soʻzi + feʼl)
uz.explanation: Kalit: never + have — nonushtasiz.

questions.text: Worksheet Ex.3: "I ___ my friend for lunch — normally two or three times a week." (frequency word + verb)
questions.expl: Key: often + meet (two or three times a week → often).

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.3: "I ___ my friend for lunch — normally two or three times a week." (наречие частотности + глагол)

questions.text: Worksheet Ex.3: "I like to keep fit, so I ___ to the gym." (frequency word + verb)

ru.explanation: Ключ: usually + go.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 3-mashq: "I like to keep fit, so I ___ to the gym." (takrorlik soʻzi + feʼl)
uz.explanation: Kalit: usually + go.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 3-mashq: "I also ___ at restaurants ___." (feʼl + takrorlik iborasi)
uz.explanation: Kalit: eat + oyda ikki-uch marta; ishlatilmagan soʻzlar: always, every day, rarely, leave, make.

uz.text: Kirish mashqi (9.10): "I have a lot of friends on social media, but only ___ of them are close friends."
uz.explanation: Kalit: a couple (yoki a few) of them.

questions.text: Lead-in (9.10): "I never watch TV or films on my phone, because the screen isn't ___."

ru.text: Вводное задание (9.10): "I never watch TV or films on my phone, because the screen isn't ___."

uz.text: Kirish mashqi (9.10): "I never watch TV or films on my phone, because the screen isn't ___."

uz.text: Kirish mashqi (9.10): "I like Apple products, but I can't afford them — I think they're ___."

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "Do you spend ___ time on social media?" (much / many)

questions.text: Act.1: "My bedroom is a nice size. There's ___ for a desk." (enough room / plenty of room)

questions.text: Act.1: "I know very ___ people who speak two foreign languages." (few / little)

ru.explanation: people = исчисляемое → very few.

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "I know very ___ people who speak two foreign languages." (few / little)
uz.explanation: people = sanaladi → very few.

questions.text: Act.1: "My brother has downloaded ___ apps onto his new phone." (a lot of / lots of)

ru.explanation: a lot of / lots of взаимозаменяемы перед исчисляемыми во множественном числе (верно).

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "My brother has downloaded ___ apps onto his new phone." (a lot of / lots of)
uz.explanation: a lot of / lots of sanaladigan koʻplik oldida almashinib ishlatiladi (toʻgʻri).

questions.text: Act.1: "I have some cash on me, but not ___." (a lot / a lot of)

ru.explanation: После not, без существительного, используется a lot (без of).

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "I have some cash on me, but not ___." (a lot / a lot of)
uz.explanation: not dan keyin, ot boʻlmaganda, a lot (of siz) ishlatiladi.

questions.text: Act.1: "Their new TV is ___. It hardly fits in the living room." (too much big / too big)

ru.text: Задание 1: "Their new TV is ___. It hardly fits in the living room." (too much big / too big)
ru.explanation: too + прилагательное; too much никогда не ставится перед прилагательным.

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "Their new TV is ___. It hardly fits in the living room." (too much big / too big)
uz.explanation: too + sifat; too much sifatdan oldin hech qachon kelmaydi.

questions.text: Act.1: "___ potatoes. I forgot to buy some." (There aren't any / There are no)

ru.text: Задание 1: "___ potatoes. I forgot to buy some." (There aren't any / There are no)
ru.explanation: aren't any (отрицательный глагол + any) и There are no (no + утвердительный глагол) — оба варианта верны (верно).

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "___ potatoes. I forgot to buy some." (There aren't any / There are no)
uz.explanation: aren't any (inkor feʼl + any) va There are no (no + tasdiq feʼl) — ikkala variant ham toʻgʻri.

questions.text: Act.1: "My niece isn't ___ to play with a games console." (old enough / enough old)

ru.text: Задание 1: "My niece isn't ___ to play with a games console." (old enough / enough old)
ru.explanation: enough ставится после прилагательного — Правило 14.

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "My niece isn't ___ to play with a games console." (old enough / enough old)
uz.explanation: enough sifatdan keyin keladi — 14-qoida.

questions.text: Act.1: "I don't have ___ close friends." (a lot of / many)
questions.expl: Both are possible (many slightly more formal) — tick.

ru.text: Задание 1: "I don't have ___ close friends." (a lot of / many)
ru.explanation: Возможны оба варианта (many чуть более формально) — верно.

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "I don't have ___ close friends." (a lot of / many)
uz.explanation: Ikkala variant ham mumkin (many biroz rasmiyroq) — toʻgʻri.

questions.D: Wrong → "A lot of them!" only correct form
questions.expl: a lot of must be followed by a noun; in short answers use a lot.

ru.text: Задание 2: "'How many presents did you get?' — 'A lot of!'" — правильно или нет?
