questions.text: WS Ex.7 (g): "…so receive ___ moisture" (few / little)
questions.expl: moisture = uncountable → little.

ru.text: WS Ex.7 (g): "…so receive ___ moisture" (few / little)
ru.explanation: moisture — неисчисляемое → little.

uz.text: WS 7-mashq (g): "…so receive ___ moisture" (few / little)
uz.explanation: moisture — sanalmas → little.

questions.text: WS Ex.7 (h): "…that very ___ kinds of life live in deserts" (few / lots)
questions.expl: very few kinds (countable).

ru.text: WS Ex.7 (h): "…that very ___ kinds of life live in deserts" (few / lots)
ru.explanation: very few kinds (исчисляемое).

uz.text: WS 7-mashq (h): "…that very ___ kinds of life live in deserts" (few / lots)
uz.explanation: very few kinds (sanaladigan).

questions.text: WS Ex.7 (i): "in fact there are ___ of plants, animals and insects" (lots / many)
questions.expl: lots of + noun (many would drop "of").

ru.text: WS Ex.7 (i): "in fact there are ___ of plants, animals and insects" (lots / many)
ru.explanation: lots of + существительное (с many «of» бы исчезло).

uz.text: WS 7-mashq (i): "in fact there are ___ of plants, animals and insects" (lots / many)
uz.explanation: lots of + ot (many boʻlsa «of» tushib qoladi).

questions.text: WS Ex.7 (j): "___ desert plants store water in their leaves" (Lots / Many)
questions.expl: Many + noun directly (Lots needs of).

ru.text: WS Ex.7 (j): "___ desert plants store water in their leaves" (Lots / Many)
ru.explanation: Many + существительное напрямую (Lots требует of).

uz.text: WS 7-mashq (j): "___ desert plants store water in their leaves" (Lots / Many)
uz.explanation: Many + ot toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri (Lots uchun of kerak).

questions.text: WS Ex.7 (k): "some desert plants can live for ___ years" (lots / many)
questions.expl: live for many years (no of).

ru.text: WS Ex.7 (k): "some desert plants can live for ___ years" (lots / many)
ru.explanation: live for many years (без of).

uz.text: WS 7-mashq (k): "some desert plants can live for ___ years" (lots / many)
uz.explanation: live for many years («of» yoʻq).

questions.text: WS Ex.7 (l): "They spend ___ time in the sun" (little / a few)
questions.expl: time = uncountable → little.

ru.text: WS Ex.7 (l): "They spend ___ time in the sun" (little / a few)
ru.explanation: time — неисчисляемое → little.

uz.text: WS 7-mashq (l): "They spend ___ time in the sun" (little / a few)
uz.explanation: time — sanalmas → little.

questions.text: WS Ex.7 (m): "There are ___ insects, scorpions and spiders as well as reptiles…" (enough / lots of)
questions.expl: lots of insects… — key: lots of.

ru.text: WS Ex.7 (m): "There are ___ insects, scorpions and spiders as well as reptiles…" (enough / lots of)
ru.explanation: lots of insects… — ключ: lots of.

uz.text: WS 7-mashq (m): "There are ___ insects, scorpions and spiders as well as reptiles…" (enough / lots of)
uz.explanation: lots of insects… — kalit: lots of.

questions.text: WS Ex.7 (n): "They need to spend ___ hours in the sun" (much / many)
questions.expl: hours = countable → many.

ru.text: WS Ex.7 (n): "They need to spend ___ hours in the sun" (much / many)
ru.explanation: hours — исчисляемое → many.

uz.text: WS 7-mashq (n): "They need to spend ___ hours in the sun" (much / many)
uz.explanation: hours — sanaladigan → many.

questions.text: WS Ex.7 (o): "…so they have ___ difficulty living in high temperatures" (a few / little)
questions.expl: difficulty = uncountable → little.

ru.text: WS Ex.7 (o): "…so they have ___ difficulty living in high temperatures" (a few / little)
ru.explanation: difficulty — неисчисляемое → little.

uz.text: WS 7-mashq (o): "…so they have ___ difficulty living in high temperatures" (a few / little)
uz.explanation: difficulty — sanalmas → little.

questions.text: WS Ex.7 (p): "However, ___ of them are cold deserts" (few / little)
questions.expl: them = cold deserts (countable) → few of them.

ru.text: WS Ex.7 (p): "However, ___ of them are cold deserts" (few / little)
ru.explanation: them = холодные пустыни (исчисляемое) → few of them.

uz.text: WS 7-mashq (p): "However, ___ of them are cold deserts" (few / little)
uz.explanation: them = sovuq choʻllar (sanaladigan) → few of them.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "Pour 50 cc of water ___ the test tube."
questions.expl: Movement to the inside of something → into.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "Pour 50 cc of water ___ the test tube."
ru.explanation: Движение внутрь чего-либо → into.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "Pour 50 cc of water ___ the test tube."
uz.explanation: Biror narsaning ichiga harakat → into.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "Put the bottle ___ the shelf."
questions.expl: Movement to a surface → onto.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "Put the bottle ___ the shelf."
ru.explanation: Движение на поверхность → onto.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "Put the bottle ___ the shelf."
uz.explanation: Sirt ustiga harakat → onto.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "Take the probe ___ the liquid."
questions.expl: Movement from the inside → out of.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "Take the probe ___ the liquid."
ru.explanation: Движение изнутри наружу → out of.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "Take the probe ___ the liquid."
uz.explanation: Ichdan tashqariga harakat → out of.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "Take the pan ___ the heat."
questions.expl: Leaving a surface → off.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "Take the pan ___ the heat."
ru.explanation: Уход с поверхности → off.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "Take the pan ___ the heat."
uz.explanation: Sirtdan olib ketish → off.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "Light does not need to travel ___ a medium."
questions.expl: through = from one side to the other INSIDE a 3-D medium; across = on a 2-D surface.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "Light does not need to travel ___ a medium."
ru.explanation: through = с одной стороны на другую ВНУТРИ трёхмерной среды; across = по двумерной поверхности.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "Light does not need to travel ___ a medium."
uz.explanation: through = uch oʻlchamli muhit ICHIDA bir tomondan ikkinchisiga; across = ikki oʻlchamli sirt boʻylab.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "Waves move ___ the stadium." (from one side to the other on a surface)
questions.expl: across = on a surface; through = inside a space.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "Waves move ___ the stadium." (с одной стороны на другую по поверхности)
ru.explanation: across = по поверхности; through = внутри пространства.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "Waves move ___ the stadium." (sirt boʻylab bir tomondan ikkinchisiga)
uz.explanation: across = sirt boʻylab; through = makon ichidan.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "Walk ___ the corridor to the lab."
questions.expl: along = following a line.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "Walk ___ the corridor to the lab."
ru.explanation: along = вдоль линии.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "Walk ___ the corridor to the lab."
uz.explanation: along = chiziq boʻylab.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "The storm is moving ___ the coast." (direction, not necessarily arrival)
questions.expl: towards = direction without necessarily arriving; to = arrival.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "The storm is moving ___ the coast." (направление, необязательно прибытие)
ru.explanation: towards = направление без обязательного прибытия; to = прибытие.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "The storm is moving ___ the coast." (yoʻnalish, yetib borish shart emas)
uz.explanation: towards = yetib borish shartsiz yoʻnalish; to = yetib borish.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "The wave moves ___ its starting point."
questions.expl: away from = movement to a distance.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "The wave moves ___ its starting point."
ru.explanation: away from = отдаление (движение на расстояние).

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "The wave moves ___ its starting point."
uz.explanation: away from = uzoqlashish harakati.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement (time): "___ Tuesday" / "___ 5.30" / "___ winter" — choose the correct series.
questions.expl: on + days, at + clock times, in + months/seasons/years.

ru.text: Предлоги движения (время): "___ Tuesday" / "___ 5.30" / "___ winter" — выберите правильную серию.
ru.explanation: on + дни, at + время на часах, in + месяцы/сезоны/годы.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari (vaqt): "___ Tuesday" / "___ 5.30" / "___ winter" — toʻgʻri ketma-ketlikni tanlang.
uz.explanation: on + kunlar, at + soat vaqtlari, in + oylar/mavsumlar/yillar.

questions.text: Dependent prepositions: "Stereotyping can result ___ prejudice and discrimination."
questions.expl: result in = cause (a result).

ru.text: Зависимые предлоги: "Stereotyping can result ___ prejudice and discrimination."
ru.explanation: result in = приводить к (иметь результатом).

uz.text: Bogʻliq predloglar: "Stereotyping can result ___ prejudice and discrimination."
uz.explanation: result in = natija boʻlmoq (sabab boʻlmoq).

questions.text: Dependent prepositions: "Generalizations are based ___ facts and evidence."
questions.expl: based on facts.

ru.text: Зависимые предлоги: "Generalizations are based ___ facts and evidence."
ru.explanation: based on facts (основано на фактах).

uz.text: Bogʻliq predloglar: "Generalizations are based ___ facts and evidence."
uz.explanation: based on facts (faktlarga asoslangan).

questions.text: Dependent prepositions: "The results from the repeat experiment must tally ___ the first ones."
questions.expl: tally with = match.

ru.text: Зависимые предлоги: "The results from the repeat experiment must tally ___ the first ones."
ru.explanation: tally with = совпадать.

uz.text: Bogʻliq predloglar: "The results from the repeat experiment must tally ___ the first ones."
uz.explanation: tally with = mos kelmoq.

questions.text: Dependent prepositions: "It all depends ___ whether or not they have any vacancies."
questions.expl: depend on.

ru.text: Зависимые предлоги: "It all depends ___ whether or not they have any vacancies."
ru.explanation: depend on (зависеть от).

uz.text: Bogʻliq predloglar: "It all depends ___ whether or not they have any vacancies."
uz.explanation: depend on (bogʻliq boʻlmoq).

questions.text: Dependent prepositions: "A thermometer is used ___ measuring temperature."
questions.expl: be used for + -ing.

ru.text: Зависимые предлоги: "A thermometer is used ___ measuring temperature."
ru.explanation: be used for + -ing (использоваться для чего-либо).

uz.text: Bogʻliq predloglar: "A thermometer is used ___ measuring temperature."
uz.explanation: be used for + -ing (biror narsa uchun ishlatilmoq).

questions.text: Dependent prepositions: "She is ___ charge ___ that project." — choose the correct pair.
questions.expl: be in charge of something.

ru.text: Зависимые предлоги: "She is ___ charge ___ that project." — выберите правильную пару.
ru.explanation: be in charge of something (отвечать за что-либо).

uz.text: Bogʻliq predloglar: "She is ___ charge ___ that project." — toʻgʻri juftlikni tanlang.
uz.explanation: be in charge of something (biror narsaga masʼul boʻlmoq).

questions.text: "The power of numbers": Why did the king have to give the pilgrim so much rice?
questions.A: Because of the doubling agreement — the amount doubled on every square, reaching exponential growth
questions.B: Because the pilgrim was very hungry
questions.C: Because rice was very cheap at the time
questions.D: Because the king wanted to fill the palace
questions.expl: 1 grain, then double on every square: by the 64th square the total exceeded 18 × 10^18 grains.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Почему королю пришлось отдать паломнику так много риса?
ru.explanation: 1 зерно, затем удвоение на каждой клетке: к 64-й клетке общее количество превысило 18 × 10^18 зёрен.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Shoh nima uchun ziyoratchiga bunday koʻp guruch berishga majbur boʻldi?
uz.explanation: 1 don, soʻngra har bir katakda ikki barobar: 64-katakkacha boʻlganda jami 18 × 10^18 donadan oshib ketdi.

questions.text: "The power of numbers": What is Moore's Law?
questions.A: Memory grows by 424 kilobytes every year
questions.C: Computer speed increases by 400,000 instructions per second
questions.D: The power of computer microchips doubles every 18 months
questions.expl: Moore's Law: microchip power doubles every 18 months.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Что такое закон Мура?
ru.explanation: Закон Мура: мощность микрочипов удваивается каждые 18 месяцев.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Mur qonuni nima?
uz.explanation: Mur qonuni: mikrochipning quvvati har 18 oyda ikki barobar oshadi.

questions.text: "The power of numbers": Which has more memory — the first space shuttle computer or a smartphone?
questions.D: The space shuttle — 424 kilobytes is more
questions.expl: The shuttle had 424 KB; a smartphone has over 33,000,000 times more.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": У чего больше памяти — у компьютера первого шаттла или у смартфона?
ru.explanation: У шаттла было 424 KB; у смартфона — более чем в 33,000,000 раз больше.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Qaysi birida xotira koʻp — birinchi kosmik shattl kompyuterida yoki smartfonda?
uz.explanation: Shattlda 424 KB bor edi; smartfonda esa 33,000,000 martadan koʻproq.

questions.text: "The power of numbers": Why is it now quicker to analyse human genes?
questions.A: Because there are fewer genes now
questions.B: Because the Human Genome Project never finished
questions.C: Because of faster computers — what took 13 years now takes a week
questions.expl: The Human Genome Project took 13 years (1990-2003); faster computers now do it in a week.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Почему теперь анализ человеческих генов проходит быстрее?
ru.explanation: Проект «Геном человека» занял 13 лет (1990-2003); теперь более быстрые компьютеры делают это за неделю.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Nima uchun endi inson genlarini tahlil qilish tezroq?
uz.explanation: Inson genomi loyihasi 13 yil vaqt oldi (1990-2003); endi tezkor kompyuterlar buni bir haftada bajaradi.

questions.text: "The power of numbers": How many people now go to university in the UK and in Finland?
questions.expl: About 40% in the UK (vs ~5% in the 1960s) and 80% in Finland.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Сколько людей теперь учится в университетах в Великобритании и в Финляндии?
ru.explanation: Около 40% в Великобритании (против ~5% в 1960-е годы) и 80% в Финляндии.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Endi Buyuk Britaniya va Finlyandiyada necha kishi universitetda oʻqiydi?
uz.explanation: Buyuk Britaniyada taxminan 40% (1960-yillardagi ~5% ga qarshi), Finlyandiyada 80%.

questions.text: "The power of numbers": Why is research now published more quickly?
questions.A: More postgraduate students → more competition for funding → pressure to publish quickly
questions.expl: The cause-effect chain: more students → competition for funding → as a result, pressure to publish quickly.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Почему исследования теперь публикуются быстрее?
ru.explanation: Цепочка причина–следствие: больше студентов → конкуренция за финансирование → в результате, давление в пользу быстрой публикации.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Nima uchun tadqiqotlar endi tezroq nashr etiladi?
uz.explanation: Sabab–natija zanjiri: koʻproq talabalar → mablagʻ uchun raqobat → natijada tez nashr etish bosimi.

questions.text: Cause–effect connectors: "___ the increase in university students, more people now do research." — choose the connector + noun.
questions.expl: because of + noun (because needs a clause).

ru.text: Коннекторы причины–следствия: "___ the increase in university students, more people now do research." — выберите коннектор + существительное.
ru.explanation: because of + существительное (because требует придаточного предложения).

uz.text: Sabab–natija bogʻlovchilari: "___ the increase in university students, more people now do research." — bogʻlovchi + ot juftligini tanlang.
uz.explanation: because of + ot (because esa qoʻshma gap talab qiladi).

questions.text: Cause–effect: "This has created greater competition. ___, there is more pressure on scientists."
questions.expl: As a result — the fixed connector.

ru.text: Причина–следствие: "This has created greater competition. ___, there is more pressure on scientists."
ru.explanation: As a result — устойчивый коннектор.

uz.text: Sabab–natija: "This has created greater competition. ___, there is more pressure on scientists."
uz.explanation: As a result — oʻzgarmas bogʻlovchi.

questions.text: Cause–effect: "This new research then ___ other new discoveries."
questions.expl: lead to = cause.

ru.text: Причина–следствие: "This new research then ___ other new discoveries."
ru.explanation: lead to = приводить к.

uz.text: Sabab–natija: "This new research then ___ other new discoveries."
uz.explanation: lead to = olib boradi (sabab boʻladi).

questions.text: Cause–effect: "___, new technologies are developed more rapidly." — choose the connector meaning "as a result".
questions.expl: as a consequence = as a result.

ru.text: Причина–следствие: "___, new technologies are developed more rapidly." — выберите коннектор со значением «as a result».
ru.explanation: as a consequence = as a result.

uz.text: Sabab–natija: "___, new technologies are developed more rapidly." — «as a result» maʼnosidagi bogʻlovchini tanlang.
uz.explanation: as a consequence = as a result (natijada).

questions.text: Verbs of change: "The power of microchips ___ every 18 months." (trend verb from the text)
questions.expl: double = become twice as much.

ru.text: Глаголы изменения: "The power of microchips ___ every 18 months." (глагол тренда из текста)
ru.explanation: double = становиться вдвое больше.

uz.text: Oʻzgarish feʼllari: "The power of microchips ___ every 18 months." (matndagi trend feʼli)
uz.explanation: double = ikki barobar boʻlmoq.

questions.text: Trend vocabulary: "Student numbers ___ by 75% between 2000 and 2010." — choose the correct verb + preposition.
questions.expl: rise by + amount (rose by 75%).

ru.text: Лексика трендов: "Student numbers ___ by 75% between 2000 and 2010." — выберите правильную пару «глагол + предлог».
ru.explanation: rise by + величина (rose by 75%).

uz.text: Trend lugʻati: "Student numbers ___ by 75% between 2000 and 2010." — toʻgʻri «feʼl + predlog» juftligini tanlang.
uz.explanation: rise by + miqdor (rose by 75%).

questions.text: Trend vocabulary: "Sales ___ in the third quarter" — which verb is the MOST dramatic (worksheet tip)?
questions.expl: Be dramatic: rocketed tells the audience more than increased.

ru.text: Лексика трендов: "Sales ___ in the third quarter" — какой глагол САМЫЙ драматичный (совет из рабочего листа)?
ru.explanation: Будьте драматичны: rocketed сообщает аудитории больше, чем increased.

uz.text: Trend lugʻati: "Sales ___ in the third quarter" — qaysi feʼl ENG dramatik (varaqdagi maslahat)?
uz.explanation: Dramatik boʻling: rocketed tinglovchiga increased dan koʻproq maʼlumot beradi.

questions.text: Trend vocabulary: Which pair describes DOWNWARD movement most dramatically?
questions.expl: slump and plummet are dramatic downward verbs; jump/take off = up; hold steady/settle = stability.

ru.text: Лексика трендов: Какая пара наиболее драматично описывает движение ВНИЗ?
ru.explanation: slump и plummet — драматичные глаголы движения вниз; jump/take off = вверх; hold steady/settle = стабильность.

uz.text: Trend lugʻati: Qaysi juftlik PASTGA harakatni eng dramatik tasvirlaydi?
uz.explanation: slump va plummet — pastga harakatning dramatik feʼllari; jump/take off = yuqoriga; hold steady/settle = barqarorlik.

questions.text: Quantifying change: "…the number of students studying abroad rose ___ 75% ___ 2000 ___ 2010." — choose the correct series.
questions.expl: rose by 75% between 2000 and 2010 (also: from 2000 to 2010).

ru.text: Количественная оценка изменений: "…the number of students studying abroad rose ___ 75% ___ 2000 ___ 2010." — выберите правильную серию.
ru.explanation: rose by 75% between 2000 and 2010 (также: from 2000 to 2010).

uz.text: Oʻzgarishni miqdoriy ifodalash: "…the number of students studying abroad rose ___ 75% ___ 2000 ___ 2010." — toʻgʻri ketma-ketlikni tanlang.
uz.explanation: rose by 75% between 2000 and 2010 (yoki: from 2000 to 2010).

questions.text: Fluctuation: "The exchange rate ___ between 0.33% and 4%." — choose the verb.
questions.expl: fluctuate between X and Y.

ru.text: Колебание: "The exchange rate ___ between 0.33% and 4%." — выберите глагол.
ru.explanation: fluctuate between X and Y (колебаться между X и Y).

uz.text: Tebranish: "The exchange rate ___ between 0.33% and 4%." — feʼlni tanlang.
uz.explanation: fluctuate between X and Y (X va Y orasida tebranmoq).

questions.text: Test 1 format: What is Test 1?
questions.C: A paper-based writing task, 1 hour, worth 10% of the course grade
questions.expl: Test 1: paper-based writing task, 1 hour, 10% of the grade, covering Weeks 1-3.

ru.text: Формат Test 1: Что такое Test 1?
ru.explanation: Test 1: письменное задание на бумаге, 1 час, 10% итоговой оценки, охватывает недели 1-3.

uz.text: Test 1 formati: Test 1 nima?
uz.explanation: Test 1: qogʻoz asosidagi yozma topshiriq, 1 soat, bahoning 10%, 1-3 haftalarni qamrab oladi.

questions.text: Test 1 checklist: When choosing a tense, what is the FIRST question to ask?
questions.A: Is the word long or short?
questions.B: Is it routine/permanent (PS), now/temporary (PC), or a stative meaning (PS)?
questions.C: Is the sentence long or short?
questions.D: Is the subject human or not?
questions.expl: Routine/permanent → present simple; now/temporary → present continuous; stative → present simple.

ru.text: Чек-лист Test 1: Выбирая глагольное время, какой вопрос задаёте ПЕРВЫМ?
ru.explanation: Регулярное/постоянное → present simple; сейчас/временное → present continuous; состояние → present simple.

uz.text: Test 1 tekshiruv roʻyxati: Zamon tanlashda BIRINCHI qanday savol beriladi?
uz.explanation: Muntazam/doimiy → present simple; hozir/vaqtincha → present continuous; holat → present simple.

questions.text: Test 1 checklist: When choosing an article, what should you ask?
questions.B: Always use the with singular nouns
questions.C: Articles are optional in writing tasks
questions.D: First mention or general → a/an; already known, unique or superlative → the; general plural/uncountable → zero
questions.expl: The article decision tree from Weeks 2.

ru.text: Чек-лист Test 1: Выбирая артикль, о чём следует спросить себя?
ru.explanation: Дерево решений для артикля из недели 2.

uz.text: Test 1 tekshiruv roʻyxati: Artikel tanlashda nimadan soʻrash kerak?
uz.explanation: 2-haftadagi artikel boʻyicha qarorlar daraxti.

questions.text: Test 1 checklist: How much time should you leave for checking?
questions.expl: Leave 5 minutes to check verbs and articles — most marks are lost there.

ru.text: Чек-лист Test 1: Сколько времени нужно оставить на проверку?
ru.explanation: Оставьте 5 минут на проверку глаголов и артиклей — именно там теряется больше всего баллов.

uz.text: Test 1 tekshiruv roʻyxati: Tekshirish uchun qancha vaqt qoldirish kerak?
uz.explanation: Feʼllar va artikelni tekshirish uchun 5 daqiqa qoldiring — aynan shu yerda koʻp ball yoʻqoladi.

questions.text: Test 1 checklist: What sentence type does the answer key convention reward?
questions.A: Long paragraphs without the target grammar
questions.C: Complete sentences with the justified grammatical form
questions.expl: Write complete sentences, not notes — a full sentence with the justified form.

ru.text: Чек-лист Test 1: Какой тип предложения поощряется конвенцией ключа ответов?
ru.explanation: Пишите полные предложения, а не заметки — полное предложение с обоснованной формой.

uz.text: Test 1 tekshiruv roʻyxati: Javoblar kaliti anʼanasi qanday gap turini ragʻbatlantiradi?
uz.explanation: Toʻliq gaplar yozing, qisqa yozuvlar emas — asoslangan shakl bilan toʻliq gap.

tests.title: English for Engineering I — Weeks 5-7: Complete Test

questions.text: The passive is formed with ___.
questions.expl: The passive is formed with be + past participle: «A lot of films are shot on location.»

en.text: The passive is formed with ___.
en.explanation: The passive is formed with be + past participle: «A lot of films are shot on location.»

ru.text: Пассивный залог образуется с помощью ___.
ru.explanation: Пассив образуется по формуле be + причастие прошедшего времени: «A lot of films are shot on location».

uz.text: Passiv ___ yordamida hosil qilinadi.
uz.explanation: Passiv be + oʻtgan sifatdosh (past participle) bilan hosil boʻladi: «A lot of films are shot on location».

questions.text: We find oil and gas beneath the ground or sea. → Oil and gas ___ beneath the ground or sea.
questions.expl: Present simple passive = am/is/are + past participle, for processes that are generally true: «Oil and gas are found beneath the ground or sea.»

en.text: We find oil and gas beneath the ground or sea. → Oil and gas ___ beneath the ground or sea.
en.explanation: Present simple passive = am/is/are + past participle, for processes that are generally true: «Oil and gas are found beneath the ground or sea.»

ru.text: Преобразуйте: «We find oil and gas beneath the ground or sea.» → «Oil and gas ___ beneath the ground or sea.»
ru.explanation: Present simple passive = am/is/are + past participle — для процессов, которые верны в целом: «Oil and gas are found beneath the ground or sea».

uz.text: Aylantiring: «We find oil and gas beneath the ground or sea.» → «Oil and gas ___ beneath the ground or sea.»
uz.explanation: Present simple passive = am/is/are + past participle — umumiy rost jarayonlar uchun: «Oil and gas are found beneath the ground or sea».

questions.text: The college ___ in the 16th century.
questions.expl: Past simple passive = was/were + past participle, for finished events: «The college was built in the 16th century.»

en.text: The college ___ in the 16th century.
en.explanation: Past simple passive = was/were + past participle, for finished events: «The college was built in the 16th century.»

ru.text: Колледж ___ в XVI веке.
ru.explanation: Past simple passive = was/were + past participle — для завершённых событий: «The college was built in the 16th century».

uz.text: Kollej XVI asrda ___.
uz.explanation: Past simple passive = was/were + past participle — tugallangan voqealar uchun: «The college was built in the 16th century».

questions.text: The police are questioning two men. → Two men ___ by the police.
questions.expl: Present continuous passive = am/is/are being + past participle: «Two men are being questioned by the police.»

en.text: The police are questioning two men. → Two men ___ by the police.
en.explanation: Present continuous passive = am/is/are being + past participle: «Two men are being questioned by the police.»

ru.text: Преобразуйте: «The police are questioning two men.» → «Two men ___ by the police.»
ru.explanation: Present continuous passive = am/is/are being + past participle: «Two men are being questioned by the police».

uz.text: Aylantiring: «The police are questioning two men.» → «Two men ___ by the police.»
uz.explanation: Present continuous passive = am/is/are being + past participle: «Two men are being questioned by the police».

questions.text: Tourism has harmed some countries. → Some countries ___ by tourism.
questions.expl: Present perfect passive = has/have been + past participle: «Some countries have been harmed by tourism.»

en.text: Tourism has harmed some countries. → Some countries ___ by tourism.
en.explanation: Present perfect passive = has/have been + past participle: «Some countries have been harmed by tourism.»

ru.text: Преобразуйте: «Tourism has harmed some countries.» → «Some countries ___ by tourism.»
ru.explanation: Present perfect passive = has/have been + past participle: «Some countries have been harmed by tourism».

uz.text: Aylantiring: «Tourism has harmed some countries.» → «Some countries ___ by tourism.»
uz.explanation: Present perfect passive = has/have been + past participle: «Some countries have been harmed by tourism».

questions.text: We will choose a new class representative on Monday. → A new class representative ___ on Monday.
questions.expl: Will passive = will be + past participle: «A new class representative will be chosen on Monday.»

en.text: We will choose a new class representative on Monday. → A new class representative ___ on Monday.
en.explanation: Will passive = will be + past participle: «A new class representative will be chosen on Monday.»

ru.text: Преобразуйте: «We will choose a new class representative on Monday.» → «A new class representative ___ on Monday.»
ru.explanation: Will passive = will be + past participle: «A new class representative will be chosen on Monday».

uz.text: Aylantiring: «We will choose a new class representative on Monday.» → «A new class representative ___ on Monday.»
uz.explanation: Will passive = will be + past participle: «A new class representative will be chosen on Monday».

questions.text: Why is the passive the standard form for describing scientific and technical processes?
questions.A: Because the passive form is always shorter than the active
questions.B: Because processes always happen in the future
questions.C: Because active verbs cannot describe processes
questions.D: Because the steps of the process matter more than the person who performs them
questions.expl: We often use the passive to talk about processes because the steps matter more than the doer: «Oil and gas are found beneath the ground or sea», «A hole is made using a drill.»

en.text: Why is the passive the standard form for describing scientific and technical processes?

options.A: Because the passive form is always shorter than the active
options.B: Because active verbs cannot describe processes
options.C: Because processes always happen in the future
options.D: Because the steps of the process matter more than the person who performs them

en.explanation: We often use the passive to talk about processes because the steps matter more than the doer: «Oil and gas are found beneath the ground or sea», «A hole is made using a drill.»

ru.text: Почему пассивный залог — стандартная форма для описания научных и технических процессов?
ru.explanation: Пассив часто используется при описании процессов, потому что важны шаги, а не исполнитель: «Oil and gas are found beneath the ground or sea», «A hole is made using a drill».

uz.text: Ilmiy va texnik jarayonlarni tasvirlashda passiv nima uchun standart shakl hisoblanadi?
uz.explanation: Jarayonlar haqida gapirganda passiv koʻp ishlatiladi, chunki bajaruvchi emas, qadamlar muhim: «Oil and gas are found beneath the ground or sea», «A hole is made using a drill».

questions.text: When do we use «by» in a passive sentence?
questions.A: Only when the action happens in the present
questions.B: When it is important to know who or what performed the action
questions.expl: Use by when it is important to know the agent: «Some countries have been harmed by tourism», «Many buildings in the city have been damaged by the earthquake.»

en.text: When do we use «by» in a passive sentence?

options.A: When it is important to know who or what performed the action
options.B: Only when the action happens in the present

en.explanation: Use by when it is important to know the agent: «Some countries have been harmed by tourism», «Many buildings in the city have been damaged by the earthquake.»

ru.text: Когда в пассивном предложении используется предлог «by»?
ru.explanation: By используется, когда важно знать деятеля: «Some countries have been harmed by tourism», «Many buildings in the city have been damaged by the earthquake».

uz.text: Passiv gapda «by» qachon ishlatiladi?
uz.explanation: Bajaruvchini bilish muhim boʻlganda by ishlatiladi: «Some countries have been harmed by tourism», «Many buildings in the city have been damaged by the earthquake».

questions.text: The game was played ___ a ball of solid rubber.
questions.expl: Use with for objects which perform actions (the instrument): «The game was played with a ball of solid rubber.»

en.text: The game was played ___ a ball of solid rubber.
en.explanation: Use with for objects which perform actions (the instrument): «The game was played with a ball of solid rubber.»

ru.text: В эту игру играли ___ мячом из твёрдой резины.
ru.explanation: With используется для предметов, которыми выполняется действие (инструмент): «The game was played with a ball of solid rubber».

uz.text: Bu oʻyin qattiq rezina toʻp ___ oʻynalgan.
uz.explanation: Harakatni bajaruvchi buyumlar (asbob) uchun with ishlatiladi: «The game was played with a ball of solid rubber».

questions.text: Which sentence CANNOT be made passive?
questions.B: I lost my wallet on the way to school.
questions.C: They subtitle a lot of foreign films.
questions.expl: Only transitive verbs (verbs with an object) can be made passive. «Swim» has no object, so «I swim every day» has no passive form.

en.text: Which sentence CANNOT be made passive?

options.C: I lost my wallet on the way to school.
options.D: They subtitle a lot of foreign films.

en.explanation: Only transitive verbs (verbs with an object) can be made passive. «Swim» has no object, so «I swim every day» has no passive form.

ru.text: Какое предложение НЕЛЬЗЯ преобразовать в пассивный залог?
ru.explanation: Только переходные глаголы (с прямым дополнением) образуют пассив. У глагола swim нет дополнения, поэтому пассив невозможен.

uz.text: Qaysi gapni passiv shaklga aylantirib boʻlmaydi?
uz.explanation: Faqat toshtiqqa ega boʻlgan feʼllar passiv boʻla oladi. Swim feʼlida toshtiq yoʻq, shuning uchun uning passiv shakli ham yoʻq.

questions.text: «Artem's bike has been stolen.» This means that ___.
questions.A: the bike is being repaired at the moment
questions.D: somebody has stolen the bike, but we don't know who
questions.expl: In passive sentences the object of the active verb becomes the new subject: «Artem's bike has been stolen» = somebody has stolen Artem's bike, but we don't know who.

en.text: «Artem's bike has been stolen.» This means that ___.

options.A: the bike is being repaired at the moment
options.D: somebody has stolen the bike, but we don't know who

en.explanation: In passive sentences the object of the active verb becomes the new subject: «Artem's bike has been stolen» = somebody has stolen Artem's bike, but we don't know who.

ru.text: «Artem's bike has been stolen.» Это означает, что ___.
ru.explanation: В пассивном предложении дополнение активного глагола становится новым подлежащим: велосипед Артёма украли, но кто именно — неизвестно.

uz.text: «Artem's bike has been stolen.» Bu ___ degan maʼnoni anglatadi.
uz.explanation: Passiv gapda feʼlning toshtigʻi yangi egaga aylanadi: Artemning velosipedini kimdir oʻgʻirlagan, lekin kim ekanligi maʼlum emas.

questions.text: The costumes for the show ___ by hand.
questions.expl: The costumes undergo the action, so the present continuous passive is correct: «The costumes for the show are being made by hand.»

en.text: The costumes for the show ___ by hand.
en.explanation: The costumes undergo the action, so the present continuous passive is correct: «The costumes for the show are being made by hand.»

ru.text: Костюмы для шоу ___ вручную (сейчас шьют).
ru.explanation: Костюмы подвергаются действию, поэтому верна форма present continuous passive: «The costumes for the show are being made by hand».

uz.text: Koʻrgazma uchun liboslar qoʻlda ___ (hozir tayyorlanmoqda).
uz.explanation: Liboslar harakatga duchor boʻlmoqda, shuning uchun present continuous passive toʻgʻri: «are being made».

questions.text: The story ___ him to make a film.
questions.expl: The story performs the action (it inspired him), so the active form is correct.

en.text: The story ___ him to make a film.
en.explanation: The story performs the action (it inspired him), so the active form is correct.

ru.text: Эта история ___ его снять фильм.
ru.explanation: История сама выполняет действие (она вдохновила его), поэтому нужен активный залог.

uz.text: Bu hikoya uni film suratga olishga ___.
uz.explanation: Hikoya harakatni oʻzi bajaradi (ilhomlantirdi), shuning uchun faol nisbat toʻgʻri.

questions.text: The film will ___ in the autumn.
questions.expl: Will passive = will be + past participle: «The film will be shot in the autumn.»

en.text: The film will ___ in the autumn.
en.explanation: Will passive = will be + past participle: «The film will be shot in the autumn.»

ru.text: Фильм ___ осенью.
ru.explanation: Will passive = will be + past participle: «The film will be shot in the autumn».

uz.text: Film kuzda ___.
uz.explanation: Will passive = will be + past participle: «The film will be shot in the autumn».

questions.text: Someone is repairing my laptop at the moment. → My laptop ___ at the moment.
questions.expl: Present continuous passive: «My laptop is being repaired at the moment.»

en.text: Someone is repairing my laptop at the moment. → My laptop ___ at the moment.
en.explanation: Present continuous passive: «My laptop is being repaired at the moment.»

ru.text: Преобразуйте: «Someone is repairing my laptop at the moment.» → «My laptop ___ at the moment.»
ru.explanation: Present continuous passive: «My laptop is being repaired at the moment».

uz.text: Aylantiring: «Someone is repairing my laptop at the moment.» → «My laptop ___ at the moment.»
uz.explanation: Present continuous passive: «My laptop is being repaired at the moment».

questions.text: They won't finish the film until the spring. → The film ___ until the spring.
questions.expl: Will passive: «The film won't be finished until the spring.» The general subject «they» is left out because it is unnecessary.

en.text: They won't finish the film until the spring. → The film ___ until the spring.
en.explanation: Will passive: «The film won't be finished until the spring.» The general subject «they» is left out because it is unnecessary.

ru.text: Преобразуйте: «They won't finish the film until the spring.» → «The film ___ until the spring.»
ru.explanation: Will passive: «The film won't be finished until the spring». Обобщённое подлежащее «they» опускается как ненужное.

uz.text: Aylantiring: «They won't finish the film until the spring.» → «The film ___ until the spring.»
uz.explanation: Will passive: «The film won't be finished until the spring». Umumiy ega «they» ortiqcha boʻlgani uchun tushiriladi.

questions.text: Damien Chazelle directed La La Land. → La La Land ___ Damien Chazelle.
questions.expl: «La La Land was directed by Damien Chazelle.» By is necessary here because the director's name is the point of the sentence.

en.text: Damien Chazelle directed La La Land. → La La Land ___ Damien Chazelle.
en.explanation: «La La Land was directed by Damien Chazelle.» By is necessary here because the director's name is the point of the sentence.

ru.text: Преобразуйте: «Damien Chazelle directed La La Land.» → «La La Land ___ Damien Chazelle.»
ru.explanation: «La La Land was directed by Damien Chazelle». Здесь нужен by, потому что имя режиссёра — суть предложения.

uz.text: Aylantiring: «Damien Chazelle directed La La Land.» → «La La Land ___ Damien Chazelle.»
uz.explanation: «La La Land was directed by Damien Chazelle». Bu yerda by zarur, chunki gapning asosiy maqsadi — rejissyor ismi.

questions.text: Morse code ___ by an American called Samuel Morse.
questions.expl: Past simple passive (a finished past event): «Morse code was invented by an American called Samuel Morse.»

en.text: Morse code ___ by an American called Samuel Morse.
en.explanation: Past simple passive (a finished past event): «Morse code was invented by an American called Samuel Morse.»

ru.text: Азбука Морзе ___ американцем по имени Сэмюэл Морзе.
ru.explanation: Past simple passive (завершённое событие прошлого): «Morse code was invented by an American called Samuel Morse» (рабочий лист, упр. 1).

uz.text: Morse kodi Samuel Morse ismli amerikalik tomonidan ___.
uz.explanation: Oʻtgan oddiy passiv (tugallangan oʻtgan voqea): «Morse code was invented by an American called Samuel Morse» (ish varagʻi, 1-mashq).

questions.text: The world's first television images ___ to scientists in Scotland in 1926.
questions.expl: Past simple passive with a plural subject: images → were + past participle.

en.text: The world's first television images ___ to scientists in Scotland in 1926.
en.explanation: Past simple passive with a plural subject: images → were + past participle.

ru.text: Первые в мире телевизионные изображения ___ учёным в Шотландии в 1926 году.
ru.explanation: Past simple passive с подлежащим во множественном числе: images → were + past participle.

uz.text: Dunyodagi ilk televideniye tasvirlari 1926-yilda Shotlandiya olimlariga ___.
uz.explanation: Koʻplik egali oʻtgan oddiy passiv: images → were + past participle.

questions.text: The first English dictionary ___ by Robert Cawdrey in 1604.
questions.expl: The passive needs the past participle «written», not the past form «wrote»: «The first English dictionary was written by Robert Cawdrey in 1604.»

en.text: The first English dictionary ___ by Robert Cawdrey in 1604.
en.explanation: The passive needs the past participle «written», not the past form «wrote»: «The first English dictionary was written by Robert Cawdrey in 1604.»

ru.text: Первый словарь английского языка ___ Робертом Кодри в 1604 году.
ru.explanation: В пассиве используется причастие прошедшего времени «written», а не форма прошедшего времени «wrote».

uz.text: Birinchi ingliz lugʻati 1604-yilda Robert Cawdrey tomonidan ___.
uz.explanation: Passivda oʻtgan zamon shakli «wrote» emas, oʻtgan sifatdosh «written» ishlatiladi.

questions.text: One such project which ___ is the Freedom Ship.
questions.expl: The plans already exist at the time of writing, so the present perfect passive is used (Worksheet, Ex. 3).

en.text: One such project which ___ is the Freedom Ship.
en.explanation: The plans already exist at the time of writing, so the present perfect passive is used (Worksheet, Ex. 3).

ru.text: Один из таких проектов, который ___, — «Корабль свободы» (Freedom Ship).
ru.explanation: Планы уже существуют к моменту написания, поэтому используется present perfect passive (рабочий лист, упр. 3).

uz.text: Bunday loyihalardan biri ___ — bu Freedom Ship.
uz.explanation: Yozilayotgan paytga qadar rejalar allaqachon mavjud, shuning uchun present perfect passive ishlatiladi (ish varagʻi, 3-mashq).

questions.text: According to the plans, this huge ship ___ from smaller units.
questions.expl: Everything that will happen once the ship is built takes the will passive (Worksheet, Ex. 3).

en.text: According to the plans, this huge ship ___ from smaller units.
en.explanation: Everything that will happen once the ship is built takes the will passive (Worksheet, Ex. 3).

ru.text: Согласно планам, этот огромный корабль ___ из меньших блоков.
ru.explanation: Всё, что произойдёт после постройки корабля, передаётся формой will passive (рабочий лист, упр. 3).

uz.text: Rejalarga koʻra, bu ulkan kema kichikroq bloklardan ___.
uz.explanation: Kema qurilgandan keyin roʻy beradigan hamma narsa will passive bilan ifodalanadi (ish varagʻi, 3-mashq).

questions.text: In London, the Docklands ___ since the 1980s.
questions.expl: «Since the 1980s» points to the present perfect passive: «the Docklands has been transformed since the 1980s» (Worksheet, Ex. 5).

en.text: In London, the Docklands ___ since the 1980s.
en.explanation: «Since the 1980s» points to the present perfect passive: «the Docklands has been transformed since the 1980s» (Worksheet, Ex. 5).

ru.text: В Лондоне район Доклендс ___ с 1980-х годов.
ru.explanation: «Since the 1980s» указывает на present perfect passive: «the Docklands has been transformed since the 1980s» (рабочий лист, упр. 5).

uz.text: Londonda Docklands hududi 1980-yillardan beri ___.
uz.explanation: «Since the 1980s» iborasi present perfect passivega ishora qiladi: «the Docklands has been transformed since the 1980s» (ish varagʻi, 5-mashq).

questions.text: The docks ___ in the 19th century, when London was a busy port (before the 1980s).
questions.expl: The docks were built before the 1980s, so the past perfect passive is used: «had been built» (Worksheet, Ex. 5).

en.text: The docks ___ in the 19th century, when London was a busy port (before the 1980s).
en.explanation: The docks were built before the 1980s, so the past perfect passive is used: «had been built» (Worksheet, Ex. 5).

ru.text: Доки ___ в XIX веке, когда Лондон был оживлённым портом (до 1980-х).
ru.explanation: Доки построены до 1980-х годов, поэтому используется past perfect passive: «had been built» (рабочий лист, упр. 5).

uz.text: Doklar XIX asrda, London gavj port boʻlgan paytda (1980-yillardan oldin) ___.
uz.explanation: Doklar 1980-yillardan oldin qurilgani uchun past perfect passive ishlatiladi: «had been built» (ish varagʻi, 5-mashq).

questions.text: People developed the steam ship in the 19th century. → The steam ship ___ in the 19th century.
questions.expl: Rewriting without «people»: past simple passive — «The steam ship was developed in the 19th century» (Worksheet, Ex. 6A).

en.text: People developed the steam ship in the 19th century. → The steam ship ___ in the 19th century.
en.explanation: Rewriting without «people»: past simple passive — «The steam ship was developed in the 19th century» (Worksheet, Ex. 6A).

ru.text: Преобразуйте: «People developed the steam ship in the 19th century.» → «The steam ship ___ in the 19th century.»
ru.explanation: Переписывание без «people»: past simple passive — «The steam ship was developed in the 19th century» (рабочий лист, упр. 6A).

uz.text: Aylantiring: «People developed the steam ship in the 19th century.» → «The steam ship ___ in the 19th century.»
uz.explanation: «People» soʻzisiz qayta yozish: oʻtgan oddiy passiv — «The steam ship was developed in the 19th century» (ish varagʻi, 6A-mashq).

questions.text: «A hole is made using a drill.» This describes the process of ___.
questions.expl: Task 1 of the lecture: a hole is made using a drill → drilling. Every process description is a present simple passive sentence.

en.text: «A hole is made using a drill.» This describes the process of ___.
en.explanation: Task 1 of the lecture: a hole is made using a drill → drilling. Every process description is a present simple passive sentence.

ru.text: «A hole is made using a drill.» Это описание процесса ___.
ru.explanation: Задание 1 лекции: отверстие делается с помощью дрели → drilling (сверление). Каждое описание процесса — предложение в present simple passive.

uz.text: «A hole is made using a drill.» Bu ___ jarayonini tasvirlaydi.
uz.explanation: Maʼruza 1-vazifi: teshik drill yordamida qilinadi → drilling. Jarayon tavsiflarining barchasi present simple passive gaplardir.

questions.text: «Hot liquid material is poured into a container and cooled to make the correct shape.» This process is ___.
questions.expl: Casting: hot liquid material is poured into a container and cooled to make the correct shape.

en.text: «Hot liquid material is poured into a container and cooled to make the correct shape.» This process is ___.
en.explanation: Casting: hot liquid material is poured into a container and cooled to make the correct shape.

ru.text: «Hot liquid material is poured into a container and cooled to make the correct shape.» Этот процесс — ___.
ru.explanation: Casting (литьё): горячий жидкий материал заливается в ёмкость и охлаждается для получения нужной формы.

uz.text: «Hot liquid material is poured into a container and cooled to make the correct shape.» Bu jarayon — ___.
uz.explanation: Casting (quyish): issiq suyuq material idishga quyilib, kerakli shaklni olish uchun sovutiladi.

questions.text: «Two pieces are joined together using very high temperature.» This process is ___.
questions.expl: Welding: two pieces are joined together using very high temperature (bolting joins them with a nut and a bolt).

en.text: «Two pieces are joined together using very high temperature.» This process is ___.
en.explanation: Welding: two pieces are joined together using very high temperature (bolting joins them with a nut and a bolt).

ru.text: «Two pieces are joined together using very high temperature.» Этот процесс — ___.
ru.explanation: Welding (сварка): две детали соединяются с помощью очень высокой температуры (bolting — соединение гайкой и болтом).

uz.text: «Two pieces are joined together using very high temperature.» Bu jarayon — ___.
uz.explanation: Welding (payvandlash): ikkita detal juda yuqori harorat yordamida birlashtiriladi (bolting — gayka va bolt bilan ulash).

questions.text: «A material is turned on a machine called a lathe, and part of the material is removed.» This process is ___.
questions.expl: Turning: a material is turned on a machine called a lathe; part of the material is removed to make the correct shape.

en.text: «A material is turned on a machine called a lathe, and part of the material is removed.» This process is ___.
en.explanation: Turning: a material is turned on a machine called a lathe; part of the material is removed to make the correct shape.

ru.text: «A material is turned on a machine called a lathe, and part of the material is removed.» Этот процесс — ___.
ru.explanation: Turning (точение): материал обрабатывается на станке «lathe» (токарный станок); часть материала снимается для получения нужной формы.

uz.text: «A material is turned on a machine called a lathe, and part of the material is removed.» Bu jarayon — ___.
uz.explanation: Turning (tokarlik ishlovi): material tokar stanogʻi (lathe)da aylantirilib, kerakli shakl uchun bir qismi olib tashlanadi.

questions.text: What verb tense does the speaker use to explain a manufacturing process?
questions.expl: A manufacturing process is described in the present simple passive (is/are + past participle): a hole is made, a surface is covered, the pieces are joined.

en.text: What verb tense does the speaker use to explain a manufacturing process?
en.explanation: A manufacturing process is described in the present simple passive (is/are + past participle): a hole is made, a surface is covered, the pieces are joined.

ru.text: В каком времени говорящий описывает производственный процесс?
ru.explanation: Производственный процесс описывается в present simple passive (is/are + past participle): a hole is made, a surface is covered, the pieces are joined.

uz.text: Notiq ishlab chiqarish jarayonini qaysi feʼl zamonda tushuntiradi?
uz.explanation: Ishlab chiqarish jarayoni present simple passive (is/are + past participle) bilan tasvirlanadi: a hole is made, a surface is covered, the pieces are joined.

questions.text: Which of these is NOT one of the sequencing adverbs used to describe a process?
questions.expl: The sequencing adverbs are firstly, then, next, after that, finally: «Firstly, some energy is removed by the clouds.»

en.text: Which of these is NOT one of the sequencing adverbs used to describe a process?
en.explanation: The sequencing adverbs are firstly, then, next, after that, finally: «Firstly, some energy is removed by the clouds.»

ru.text: Какое из этих слов НЕ является наречием последовательности для описания процесса?
ru.explanation: Наречия последовательности: firstly, then, next, after that, finally: «Firstly, some energy is removed by the clouds».

uz.text: Bularning qaysi biri jarayonni tasvirlashda ishlatiladigan ketma-ketlik ravishlaridan EMAS?
uz.explanation: Ketma-ketlik ravishlari: firstly, then, next, after that, finally: «Firstly, some energy is removed by the clouds».

questions.text: The temperature reaches 100°C. ___, the water in the container begins to boil.
questions.expl: The phrase «at this stage» is used to help create a clear sequence: «The temperature reaches 100°C. At this stage, the water in the container begins to boil.»

en.text: The temperature reaches 100°C. ___, the water in the container begins to boil.
en.explanation: The phrase «at this stage» is used to help create a clear sequence: «The temperature reaches 100°C. At this stage, the water in the container begins to boil.»

ru.text: Температура достигает 100 °C. ___ вода в ёмкости начинает кипеть.
ru.explanation: Фраза «at this stage» («на этом этапе») помогает выстроить чёткую последовательность: «The temperature reaches 100°C. At this stage, the water in the container begins to boil».

uz.text: Harorat 100°C ga yetadi. ___ idishdagi suv qaynashni boshlaydi.
uz.explanation: «At this stage» iborasi aniq ketma-ketlikni yaratishga yordam beradi: «The temperature reaches 100°C. At this stage, the water in the container begins to boil».

questions.text: In the solar radiation text: «Around 25% is then ___ by the upper atmosphere and clouds, while a further 20% is absorbed by them.»
questions.expl: Around 25% is then reflected by the upper atmosphere and clouds, while a further 20% is absorbed by them; 5% is reflected from the Earth's surface.

en.text: In the solar radiation text: «Around 25% is then ___ by the upper atmosphere and clouds, while a further 20% is absorbed by them.»
en.explanation: Around 25% is then reflected by the upper atmosphere and clouds, while a further 20% is absorbed by them; 5% is reflected from the Earth's surface.

ru.text: В тексте о солнечной радиации: «Around 25% is then ___ by the upper atmosphere and clouds, while a further 20% is absorbed by them.»
ru.explanation: Около 25% отражается верхними слоями атмосферы и облаками, а ещё 20% ими поглощается; 5% отражается от поверхности Земли.

uz.text: Quyosh radiatsiyasi matnida: «Around 25% is then ___ by the upper atmosphere and clouds, while a further 20% is absorbed by them.»
uz.explanation: Taxminan 25% yuqori atmosfera va bulutlar tomonidan aks etadi, yana 20% esa ular tomonidan soʻriladi; 5% Yer yuzasidan aks etadi.

questions.text: In the solar radiation text: «Finally, 50% ___ by the Earth's surface.»
questions.expl: Finally, 50% is absorbed by the Earth's surface; around 10% of this heat radiates from the surface, and the remaining 40% moves to the clouds and atmosphere.

en.text: In the solar radiation text: «Finally, 50% ___ by the Earth's surface.»
en.explanation: Finally, 50% is absorbed by the Earth's surface; around 10% of this heat radiates from the surface, and the remaining 40% moves to the clouds and atmosphere.

ru.text: В тексте о солнечной радиации: «Finally, 50% ___ by the Earth's surface.»
ru.explanation: Наконец, 50% поглощается поверхностью Земли; около 10% этого тепла излучается с поверхности, а оставшиеся 40% переходят к облакам и атмосфере.

uz.text: Quyosh radiatsiyasi matnida: «Finally, 50% ___ by the Earth's surface.»
uz.explanation: Oxir-oqibat, 50% Yer yuzasi tomonidan soʻriladi; bu issiqlikning taxminan 10% yuzadan nurlanadi, qolgan 40% esa bulutlar va atmosferaga oʻtadi.

questions.text: In the article «How Is Tea Made?», «to pluck» means ___.
questions.A: to make a hot drink by pouring hot water onto tea leaves
questions.B: to lose water and become soft and weak
questions.C: to damage the surface of something by pressing or hitting it
questions.D: to pick leaves or flowers from a plant
questions.expl: Vocabulary of the tea article: pluck = to pick leaves or flowers from a plant; brew = make a hot drink; wither = lose water and become soft; bruise = damage the surface.

en.text: In the article «How Is Tea Made?», «to pluck» means ___.

options.A: to make a hot drink by pouring hot water onto tea leaves
options.B: to damage the surface of something by pressing or hitting it
options.C: to pick leaves or flowers from a plant
options.D: to lose water and become soft and weak

en.explanation: Vocabulary of the tea article: pluck = to pick leaves or flowers from a plant; brew = make a hot drink; wither = lose water and become soft; bruise = damage the surface.

ru.text: В статье «How Is Tea Made?» глагол «to pluck» означает ___.
ru.explanation: Словарь статьи о чае: pluck = срывать листья или цветки с растения; brew = заваривать напиток; wither = терять воду и становиться мягким; bruise = повреждать поверхность.

uz.text: «How Is Tea Made?» maqolasida «to pluck» feʼli ___ degan maʼnoni anglatadi.
uz.explanation: Choy maqolasining lugʻati: pluck = oʻsimlikdan barg yoki gullarni terish; brew = issiq ichimlik tayyorlash; wither = suvni yoʻqotib yumshash; bruise = sirtini shikastlash.

questions.text: During withering, the tea leaves ___.
questions.A: lose their moisture and become soft and weak
questions.B: are packed into a large wooden box
questions.C: are crushed, torn and curled into granules
questions.D: react with the air and change colour from green to brown
questions.expl: Withering: the leaves lose water (their moisture) and become soft and weak — the stage takes several hours, not a few minutes.

en.text: During withering, the tea leaves ___.

options.A: react with the air and change colour from green to brown
options.B: are crushed, torn and curled into granules
options.C: are packed into a large wooden box
options.D: lose their moisture and become soft and weak

en.explanation: Withering: the leaves lose water (their moisture) and become soft and weak — the stage takes several hours, not a few minutes.

ru.text: Во время завяливания (withering) чайные листья ___.
ru.explanation: Завяливание: листья теряют воду (влагу) и становятся мягкими и вялыми — этот этап занимает несколько часов, а не минут.

uz.text: Withering (soʻlitish) bosqichida choy barglari ___.
uz.explanation: Withering: barglar suvini (namligini) yoʻqotib, yumshoq va boʻshashadi — bu bosqich bir necha daqiqa emas, bir necha soat davom etadi.

questions.text: «Oxidation» is ___.
questions.A: a large wooden box used to store and transport tea
questions.B: the small amount of water inside something
questions.C: a process in which something reacts with the air and changes colour
questions.D: to put things in order by size, type or quality
questions.expl: Oxidation is a process in which something reacts with the air and changes colour: during this stage the leaves change colour from green to brown.

en.text: «Oxidation» is ___.

options.A: to put things in order by size, type or quality
options.B: a process in which something reacts with the air and changes colour
options.C: the small amount of water inside something
options.D: a large wooden box used to store and transport tea

en.explanation: Oxidation is a process in which something reacts with the air and changes colour: during this stage the leaves change colour from green to brown.

ru.text: «Окисление» (oxidation) — это ___.
ru.explanation: Окисление — процесс, при котором вещество реагирует с воздухом и меняет цвет: листья меняют цвет с зелёного на коричневый.

uz.text: «Oxidation» (oksidlanish) — bu ___.
uz.explanation: Oksidlanish — nimadir havo bilan reaksiyaga kirib, rangini oʻzgartiradigan jarayon: bu bosqichda barglar rangini yashildan jigarrangga oʻzgartiradi.

questions.text: The four stages of the orthodox method are ___.
questions.expl: The orthodox method has four stages: withering, rolling, oxidation and drying — after drying, the tea is graded and packed.

en.text: The four stages of the orthodox method are ___.
en.explanation: The orthodox method has four stages: withering, rolling, oxidation and drying — after drying, the tea is graded and packed.

ru.text: Четыре этапа традиционного (orthodox) способа обработки чая — это ___.
ru.explanation: Традиционный способ обработки включает четыре этапа: завяливание, скручивание, окисление и сушку; после сушки чай сортируют и упаковывают.

uz.text: Orthodox (anʼanaviy) usulning toʻrt bosqichi — ___.
uz.explanation: Anʼanaviy usul toʻrt bosqichdan iborat: soʻlitish (withering), oʻrash (rolling), oksidlanish (oxidation) va quritish (drying); quritilgach choy saralanadi va qadoqlanadi.

questions.text: In the CTC method the leaves are ___.
questions.A: heated so that the enzymes stop working
questions.B: crushed, torn and curled into small granules
questions.C: graded and packed immediately after plucking
questions.expl: In the orthodox method the leaves are rolled into twisted pieces; in the CTC method they are crushed, torn and curled by machines into small granules, so more tea fits into a sack.

en.text: In the CTC method the leaves are ___.

options.A: crushed, torn and curled into small granules
options.B: heated so that the enzymes stop working
options.C: graded and packed immediately after plucking

en.explanation: In the orthodox method the leaves are rolled into twisted pieces; in the CTC method they are crushed, torn and curled by machines into small granules, so more tea fits into a sack.

ru.text: При методе CTC чайные листья ___.
ru.explanation: При традиционном способе листья скручиваются, а при методе CTC машины раздавливают, рвут и скручивают их в мелкие гранулы, поэтому в мешок помещается больше чая.

uz.text: CTC usulida barglar ___.
uz.explanation: Anʼanaviy usulda barglar burilgan boʻlaklarga oʻraladi, CTC usulida esa mashinalar ularni mayda donalarga ezadi, yirtadi va buriladi — shuning uchun xaltaga koʻproq choy sigʻadi.

questions.text: Quick Check: «Solar power is highly dependent on the weather, making it an ___ energy source.»
questions.expl: Intermittent = not continuous; stopping and starting at irregular intervals — renewable energy from wind and solar is intermittent because it depends on the weather.

en.text: Quick Check: «Solar power is highly dependent on the weather, making it an ___ energy source.»
en.explanation: Intermittent = not continuous; stopping and starting at irregular intervals — renewable energy from wind and solar is intermittent because it depends on the weather.

ru.text: Быстрая проверка: «Solar power is highly dependent on the weather, making it an ___ energy source.»
ru.explanation: Intermittent = прерывистый, с нерегулярными остановками: энергия ветра и солнца прерывиста, потому что зависит от погоды.

uz.text: Tezkor savol: «Solar power is highly dependent on the weather, making it an ___ energy source.»
uz.explanation: Intermittent — davomiy boʻlmagan, oraliqlarda toʻxtab-qaytuvchi: shamol va quyosh energiyasi ob-havoga bogʻliq boʻlgani uchun intermittent hisoblanadi.

questions.text: What is a pie chart?
questions.A: A circle divided into segments from the middle to show how the total is divided up
questions.B: A grid with columns and rows of numbers
questions.C: A diagram in which different amounts are represented by thin vertical or horizontal bars
questions.D: A diagram which indicates the stages of a process
questions.expl: A pie chart is a circle divided into segments from the middle (like slices of a cake); a key or legend shows what each segment represents.

en.text: What is a pie chart?

options.A: A grid with columns and rows of numbers
options.B: A diagram in which different amounts are represented by thin vertical or horizontal bars
options.C: A diagram which indicates the stages of a process
options.D: A circle divided into segments from the middle to show how the total is divided up

en.explanation: A pie chart is a circle divided into segments from the middle (like slices of a cake); a key or legend shows what each segment represents.

ru.text: Что такое круговая диаграмма (pie chart)?
ru.explanation: Круговая диаграмма — круг, разделённый на сегменты от центра (как куски торта); ключ (легенда) показывает, что представляет каждый сегмент.

uz.text: «Pie chart» (doira diagramma) nima?
uz.explanation: Doira diagramma — markazdan segmentlarga boʻlingan doira (tort boʻlaklari kabi); kalit (legenda) har bir segment nimani anglatishini koʻrsatadi.

questions.text: What is a bar chart?
questions.A: A diagram which indicates the stages of a process
questions.B: A circle divided into segments from the middle
questions.C: A grid with columns and rows of numbers
questions.D: A diagram in which different amounts are represented by thin vertical or horizontal bars of the same width
questions.expl: A bar chart uses thin vertical or horizontal bars which have the same width but vary in height or length.

en.text: What is a bar chart?

options.A: A grid with columns and rows of numbers
options.B: A diagram in which different amounts are represented by thin vertical or horizontal bars of the same width
options.C: A circle divided into segments from the middle
options.D: A diagram which indicates the stages of a process

en.explanation: A bar chart uses thin vertical or horizontal bars which have the same width but vary in height or length.

ru.text: Что такое столбчатая диаграмма (bar chart)?
ru.explanation: Столбчатая диаграмма использует тонкие вертикальные или горизонтальные полосы одинаковой ширины, но разной высоты или длины.

uz.text: «Bar chart» (ustunli diagramma) nima?
uz.explanation: Ustunli diagrammada miqdorlar bir xil kenglikdagi, lekin balandligi yoki uzunligi har xil boʻlgan ingichka vertikal yoki gorizontal ustunlar bilan ifodalanadi.

questions.text: How is a histogram different from a bar chart?
questions.A: In a histogram the bar width also varies to indicate different values
questions.B: A histogram shows the stages of a process
questions.C: A histogram has no axes at all
questions.D: A histogram is always drawn as a circle
questions.expl: A histogram is a kind of bar chart, but the bar width also varies to indicate different values.

en.text: How is a histogram different from a bar chart?

options.A: A histogram has no axes at all
options.B: A histogram is always drawn as a circle
options.C: In a histogram the bar width also varies to indicate different values
options.D: A histogram shows the stages of a process

en.explanation: A histogram is a kind of bar chart, but the bar width also varies to indicate different values.

ru.text: Чем гистограмма отличается от столбчатой диаграммы?
ru.explanation: Гистограмма — разновидность столбчатой диаграммы, но у неё ширина столбцов тоже меняется, показывая разные значения.

uz.text: Gistogramma ustunli diagrammadan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
uz.explanation: Gistogramma — ustunli diagrammaning bir turi, lekin unda ustunlarning kengligi ham turli qiymatlarni koʻrsatish uchun oʻzgaradi.

questions.text: The best type of diagram to present the different stages in a research project is ___.
questions.expl: A flowchart is a diagram which indicates the stages of a process.

en.text: The best type of diagram to present the different stages in a research project is ___.
en.explanation: A flowchart is a diagram which indicates the stages of a process.

ru.text: Лучший тип диаграммы для представления этапов исследовательского проекта — это ___.
ru.explanation: Блок-схема (flowchart) — диаграмма, показывающая этапы процесса.

uz.text: Tadqiqot loyihasining turli bosqichlarini koʻrsatish uchun eng qulay diagramma turi — ___.
uz.explanation: Blok-sxema (flowchart) — jarayon bosqichlarini koʻrsatadigan diagramma.

questions.text: The best type of diagram to present the different layers of rock in the Grand Canyon is ___.
questions.expl: A cross-section is something cut across the middle so that you can see the inside; a cross-section of the rock shows the different layers, with a label for each part.

en.text: The best type of diagram to present the different layers of rock in the Grand Canyon is ___.
en.explanation: A cross-section is something cut across the middle so that you can see the inside; a cross-section of the rock shows the different layers, with a label for each part.

ru.text: Лучший тип диаграммы для показа различных слоёв породы в Гранд-Каньоне — это ___.
ru.explanation: Поперечный разрез (cross-section) показывает внутреннее строение: на разрезе породы видны разные слои, каждый со своей подписью.

uz.text: Buyuk kanyondagi turli qatlam jinslarini koʻrsatish uchun eng qulay diagramma — ___.
uz.explanation: Cross-section (koʻndalang kesim) — ichini koʻrish uchun oʻrtasidan kesilgan narsa; jinslar kesimida har biri yorliqli boʻlgan turli qatlamlar koʻrinadi.

questions.text: What is another name for a legend in a diagram?
questions.expl: A key or legend shows what each segment of a pie chart represents.

en.text: What is another name for a legend in a diagram?
en.explanation: A key or legend shows what each segment of a pie chart represents.

ru.text: Как ещё называется легенда на диаграмме?
ru.explanation: Ключ (key), или легенда, показывает, что представляет каждый сегмент круговой диаграммы.

uz.text: Diagrammadagi legendaning boshqa nomi nima?
uz.explanation: Kalit (key) yoki legenda doira diagrammaning har bir segmenti nimani anglatishini koʻrsatadi.

questions.text: How do we correctly refer to a diagram called Table 4?
questions.expl: Common mistake: don't use the definite article (the) when referring to a specific diagram — «See Table 4» (NOT «See the Table 4»). Diagrams in academic articles are labelled Fig. 1, Fig. 2, etc.

en.text: How do we correctly refer to a diagram called Table 4?
en.explanation: Common mistake: don't use the definite article (the) when referring to a specific diagram — «See Table 4» (NOT «See the Table 4»). Diagrams in academic articles are labelled Fig. 1, Fig. 2, etc.

ru.text: Как правильно сослаться на диаграмму под названием Table 4?
ru.explanation: Типичная ошибка: не используйте определённый артикль (the) со ссылкой на конкретную диаграмму — «See Table 4» (а не «See the Table 4»). Диаграммы в статьях обозначаются Fig. 1, Fig. 2 и т. д.

uz.text: Table 4 deb atalgan diagrammaga qanday toʻgʻri murojaat qilinadi?
uz.explanation: Keng tarqalgan xato: aniq diagrammaga murojaat qilganda aniqlik artikli (the) ishlatilmaydi — «See Table 4» («See the Table 4» emas). Maqolalardagi diagrammalar Fig. 1, Fig. 2 deb belgilanadi.

questions.text: What do two lines on a graph do if they run parallel to each other?
questions.expl: Lines that run parallel to one another never intersect; lines that intersect cross each other at a point.

en.text: What do two lines on a graph do if they run parallel to each other?
en.explanation: Lines that run parallel to one another never intersect; lines that intersect cross each other at a point.

ru.text: Что делают две линии на графике, если они идут параллельно друг другу?
ru.explanation: Параллельные линии никогда не пересекаются; пересекающиеся линии пересекаются в точке.

uz.text: Grafikdagi ikkita chiziq parallel yursa, ular nima qiladi?
uz.explanation: Parallel yuruvchi chiziqlar hech qachon kesishmaydi; kesishuvchi chiziqlar esa bir nuqtada kesishadi.

questions.text: The population of the city has increased ___ 10%.
questions.expl: The verbs increase and decrease are followed by by (the size of the change): «The population of the city has increased by 10%.»

en.text: The population of the city has increased ___ 10%.
en.explanation: The verbs increase and decrease are followed by by (the size of the change): «The population of the city has increased by 10%.»

ru.text: Население города увеличилось ___ 10%.
ru.explanation: После глаголов increase и decrease используется предлог by (размер изменения): «The population of the city has increased by 10%».

uz.text: Shahar aholisi 10% ___ oshgan.
uz.explanation: Increase va decrease feʼllaridan keyin oʻzgarish miqdorini koʻrsatuvchi by predlogi ishlatiladi: «The population of the city has increased by 10%».

questions.text: Which sentence is correct?
questions.A: There was an increase in 12% of smart phone sales last year.
questions.B: There was an increase at 12% of smart phone sales last year.
questions.C: There was an increase of 12% in smart phone sales last year.
questions.D: There was an increase on 12% in smart phone sales last year.
questions.expl: The noun increase takes of for the size of the change and in for what is rising: an increase of 12% in smart phone sales.

en.text: Which sentence is correct?

options.A: There was an increase of 12% in smart phone sales last year.
options.B: There was an increase in 12% of smart phone sales last year.
options.C: There was an increase on 12% in smart phone sales last year.
options.D: There was an increase at 12% of smart phone sales last year.

en.explanation: The noun increase takes of for the size of the change and in for what is rising: an increase of 12% in smart phone sales.

ru.text: Какое предложение правильное?
ru.explanation: Существительное increase использует of для размера изменения и in для того, что растёт: an increase of 12% in smart phone sales.

uz.text: Qaysi gap toʻgʻri?
uz.explanation: Increase otida oʻzgarish miqdori uchun of, oʻsayotgan narsa uchun in ishlatiladi: an increase of 12% in smart phone sales.

questions.text: «Soar» means to increase very quickly and by a large amount. Its opposite is ___.
questions.expl: soar = increase very quickly and by a large amount; opposite = plummet. (halve is the opposite of double; depreciate is the opposite of appreciate.)

en.text: «Soar» means to increase very quickly and by a large amount. Its opposite is ___.
en.explanation: soar = increase very quickly and by a large amount; opposite = plummet. (halve is the opposite of double; depreciate is the opposite of appreciate.)

ru.text: «Soar» означает «очень быстро и сильно расти». Его противоположность — ___.
ru.explanation: soar = очень быстро и сильно увеличиваться; противоположность — plummet (резко падать). halve — противоположность double; depreciate — противоположность appreciate.

uz.text: «Soar» — juda tez va katta miqdorda oshishni anglatadi. Uning antonimi — ___.
uz.explanation: soar = juda tez va katta miqdorda oshish; antonimi — plummet (keskin tushish). halve — double ning antonimi; depreciate — appreciate ning antonimi.

questions.text: «Double» means to increase to twice the number or amount. Its opposite is ___.
questions.expl: double = increase to twice the number or amount; opposite = halve.

en.text: «Double» means to increase to twice the number or amount. Its opposite is ___.
en.explanation: double = increase to twice the number or amount; opposite = halve.

ru.text: «Double» означает «вырасти до двойного числа/количества». Его противоположность — ___.
ru.explanation: double = увеличиться до вдвое большего числа или количества; противоположность — halve (уменьшиться вдвое).

uz.text: «Double» — ikki barobar oshishni anglatadi. Uning antonimi — ___.
uz.explanation: double = son yoki miqdorning ikki barobariga oshish; antonimi — halve (ikki baravar kamayish).

questions.text: The average family car in the UK ___ in value by 20% per year.

en.text: The average family car in the UK ___ in value by 20% per year.
en.explanation: Activity 4: «goes down in value» → depreciates (appreciate = go up in value: a typical piece of land on the edge of the city appreciates by 15% per year).

ru.text: Средний семейный автомобиль в Великобритании ___ в цене на 20% в год.
ru.explanation: Упражнение 4: «goes down in value» → depreciates (терять в цене). appreciate = расти в цене: участок земли на окраине города дорожает на 15% в год.

uz.text: Buyuk Britaniyadagi oʻrtacha oilaviy avtomobil yiliga 20% ga qiymatidan ___.
uz.explanation: 4-mashq: «goes down in value» → depreciates (qiymatini yoʻqotish). appreciate = qiymati oshish: shahar chekkasidagi yer uchastkasi yiliga 15% qadrlanadi.

questions.text: «Exceed» means ___.

questions.C: to increase to greater than a particular number or amount
questions.D: to increase to a very large number
questions.expl: exceed = increase to greater than a particular number or amount (The temperature exceeded 45°C); opposite = fall below (the child mortality rate fell below 60 deaths per 1,000).

options.B: to increase to a very large number

uz.text: «Exceed» feʼli ___ degan maʼnoni anglatadi.

questions.text: Populations of some bird species in South Asia have ___ by 97% in recent years.

ru.text: Популяции некоторых видов птиц в Южной Азии ___ на 97% за последние годы.
ru.explanation: Упражнение 4: «have crashed by 97%» → have plummeted by 97% (резко сократились; plummet — антоним soar); число случаев смерти от отравления резко выросло (has soared).

uz.text: Janubiy Osiyodagi baʼzi qush turlari populyatsiyasi soʻnggi yillarda 97% ga ___.
uz.explanation: 4-mashq: «have crashed by 97%» → have plummeted by 97% (keskin kamaydi; plummet — soar ning antonimi); zaharlanishdan oʻlim holatlari soni keskin oshdi (has soared).

questions.text: In the pocket-money example, the amount received reaches a peak at the age of ___.

en.explanation: From the graph we can see that the amount received reaches a peak at the age of 18 and then starts to decline; 15-year-olds receive twice as much pocket money as 13-year-olds.

ru.text: В примере с карманными деньгами получаемая сумма достигает пика в возрасте ___ лет.
ru.explanation: Из графика видно, что сумма достигает пика к 18 годам, а затем начинает снижаться; 15-летние получают вдвое больше карманных денег, чем 13-летние.

uz.text: Choʻntak puli misolida olinadigan summa ___ yoshda choʻqqiga yetadi.
uz.explanation: Grafikdan koʻrinadiki, olinadigan summa 18 yoshda choʻqqiga yetadi va keyin kamaya boshlaydi; 15 yoshlilar 13 yoshlilarga qaraganda ikki baravar koʻp choʻntak puli oladi.

questions.text: Investment rose ___ during the first quarter.

uz.text: Investitsiyalar birinchi chorakda ___ oshdi.

questions.text: «The explosion was triggered by the heat.» «Trigger» means ___.

questions.text: Which preposition follows the nouns «effect» and «impact»?

ru.explanation: Запомните предлог on: «The effect/impact of the film on the audience was very powerful»; «The impact of global warming on the polar ice caps…».

questions.text: What is the main topic of the TED talk «How to Spot a Misleading Graph»?
questions.A: How to make graphs using computer software
questions.B: The history of statistics in advertising
questions.C: How graphs can mislead people, and how to spot it
questions.D: Why politicians and advertisers should not use numbers
questions.expl: The talk is about how graphs can mislead: people tend to trust graphs more than a plain claim even though they can be manipulated — look carefully at the labels, numbers, scale and context.

en.text: What is the main topic of the TED talk «How to Spot a Misleading Graph»?

options.A: The history of statistics in advertising
options.B: Why politicians and advertisers should not use numbers
options.C: How graphs can mislead people, and how to spot it
options.D: How to make graphs using computer software

en.explanation: The talk is about how graphs can mislead: people tend to trust graphs more than a plain claim even though they can be manipulated — look carefully at the labels, numbers, scale and context.

ru.text: Какова главная тема TED-выступления «How to Spot a Misleading Graph»?
ru.explanation: Речь о том, как графики могут вводить в заблуждение: люди склонны доверять графикам больше, чем простым утверждениям, хотя графики можно манипулировать — внимательно смотрите на подписи, числа, масштаб и контекст.

uz.text: «How to Spot a Misleading Graph» TED maʼruzasining asosiy mavzusi nima?
uz.explanation: Maʼruza grafiklar qanday aldashi va buni qanday sezish haqida: odamlar grafiklarga oddiy daʼvoga qaraganda koʻproq ishonishadi, garchi ular manipulyatsiya qilinishi mumkin — yorliqlar, raqamlar, masshtab va kontekstga eʼtiborli qarang.

questions.text: «In today's lecture I'd like to look at a number of theories related to motivation…» This signposting phrase gives ___.

ru.text: «In today's lecture I'd like to look at a number of theories related to motivation…» Эта навигационная фраза даёт ___.

uz.text: «In today's lecture I'd like to look at a number of theories related to motivation…» Bu ishora beruvchi ibora ___.

uz.text: «Then, we'll move on to look at one of the most famous theories of motivation.» Bu ibora ___ uchun ishlatiladi.
