questions.text: Compute the dot product $u · v$ for $u = (1, 2, 1)$, $v = (3, 0, 2)$ and find a vector $w$ perpendicular to both.
questions.expl: u · v = $1·3 + 2·0 + 1·2 = 5$. A perpendicular vector is the cross product $w = u × v = (4, -1, -6)$, which satisfies $w · u = 0$ and $w · v = 0$.

ru.text: Вычислите скалярное произведение $u · v$ для $u = (1, 2, 1)$, $v = (3, 0, 2)$ и найдите вектор $w$, перпендикулярный обоим.
ru.explanation: u · v = $1·3 + 2·0 + 1·2 = 5$. Перпендикулярный вектор — это векторное произведение $w = u × v = (4, -1, -6)$, которое удовлетворяет условиям $w · u = 0$ и $w · v = 0$.

uz.text: $u = (1, 2, 1)$, $v = (3, 0, 2)$ uchun skalyar koʻpaytma $u · v$ ni hisoblang va ikkalasiga ham perpendikulyar boʻlgan $w$ vektorni toping.
uz.explanation: u · v = $1·3 + 2·0 + 1·2 = 5$. Perpendikulyar vektor — bu vektor koʻpaytma $w = u × v = (4, -1, -6)$; u $w · u = 0$ va $w · v = 0$ shartlarni qanoatlantiradi.

questions.text: When is the dot product $u · v$ negative, and what does that say about the angle? When is it zero?
questions.A: Negative when the angle is obtuse (greater than $90°$), zero when perpendicular
questions.B: Negative when the angle is acute (less than $90°$), zero when perpendicular
questions.C: Negative when the angle is $90°$, zero when acute
questions.D: Negative when the angle is $180°$, zero when acute
questions.expl: The dot product $u · v = |u||v|\cosθ$ is negative when $\cosθ < 0$, which occurs when the angle θ exceeds $90°$ (obtuse). It is zero when θ = $90°$ (perpendicular).

ru.text: Когда скалярное произведение $u · v$ отрицательно и что это говорит об угле? Когда оно равно нулю?

options.A: Отрицательно, когда угол тупой (больше $90°$), ноль — при перпендикулярности
options.B: Отрицательно, когда угол острый (меньше $90°$), ноль — при перпендикулярности
options.C: Отрицательно при угле $90°$, ноль — при остром угле
options.D: Отрицательно при угле $180°$, ноль — при остром угле

ru.explanation: Скалярное произведение $u · v = |u||v|\cosθ$ отрицательно при $\cosθ < 0$, то есть когда угол θ больше $90°$ (тупой). Оно равно нулю при θ = $90°$ (перпендикулярность).

uz.text: Skalyar koʻpaytma $u · v$ qachon manfiy boʻladi va bu burchak haqida nima deydi? Qachon u nol boʻladi?

options.A: Burchak keng ($90°$ dan katta) boʻlganda manfiy, perpendikulyar boʻlganda nol
options.B: Burchak oʻtkir ($90°$ dan kichik) boʻlganda manfiy, perpendikulyar boʻlganda nol
options.C: Burchak $90°$ boʻlganda manfiy, oʻtkir boʻlganda nol
options.D: Burchak $180°$ boʻlganda manfiy, oʻtkir boʻlganda nol

uz.explanation: $u · v = |u||v|\cosθ$ skalyar koʻpaytma $\cosθ < 0$ boʻlganda manfiy; bu θ burchak $90°$ dan oshganda (keng burchak) roʻy beradi. θ = $90°$ (perpendikulyar) boʻlganda esa nol boʻladi.

questions.text: Solve $Ax = b$ with $A = \begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}$ and $b = \begin{pmatrix}3\\4\end{pmatrix}$ using $A^{-1}$.
questions.expl: $\det(A) = 3$, $A^{-1} = \frac{1}{3}\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}$, so $x = A^{-1}b = \frac{1}{3}\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}3\\4\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}2/3\\5/3\end{pmatrix}$.

ru.text: Решите $Ax = b$ с $A = \begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}$ и $b = \begin{pmatrix}3\\4\end{pmatrix}$, используя $A^{-1}$.
ru.explanation: $\det(A) = 3$, $A^{-1} = \frac{1}{3}\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}$, поэтому $x = A^{-1}b = \frac{1}{3}\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}3\\4\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}2/3\\5/3\end{pmatrix}$.

uz.text: $A = \begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}$ va $b = \begin{pmatrix}3\\4\end{pmatrix}$ boʻlganda $Ax = b$ tenglamani $A^{-1}$ yordamida yeching.
uz.explanation: $\det(A) = 3$, $A^{-1} = \frac{1}{3}\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}$, demak $x = A^{-1}b = \frac{1}{3}\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}3\\4\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}2/3\\5/3\end{pmatrix}$.

questions.text: Why does a nonzero solution of $Ax = 0$ rule out an inverse? Give the 2-sentence reason the Notes call 'no matrix can bring 0 back to x'.
questions.A: Because if $Ax = 0$ with $x \neq 0$, then $x = A^{-1}0 = 0$, creating a contradiction
questions.B: Because $A$ would have to map $0$ to $x$, but $A(0) = 0$ always, so $x$ must be $0$
questions.C: Because $A$ would need to be a square matrix, which isn't guaranteed by $Ax = 0$
questions.D: Because the determinant would be zero, making $A$ singular
questions.expl: If $Ax = 0$ with $x \neq 0$ and $A$ had an inverse, then $x = A^{-1}Ax = A^{-1}0 = 0$ — a contradiction. The zero vector has no 'pre-image trouble' only when the map is one-to-one; a null vector proves it is not.

ru.text: Почему ненулевое решение $Ax = 0$ исключает существование обратной матрицы? Приведите состоящее из двух фраз объяснение, которое в конспектах называется «никакая матрица не может вернуть 0 обратно в x».

options.A: Потому что если $Ax = 0$ при $x \neq 0$, то $x = A^{-1}0 = 0$ — возникает противоречие
options.B: Потому что $A$ должна была бы отображать $0$ в $x$, но всегда $A(0) = 0$, поэтому $x$ должно равняться $0$
options.C: Потому что $A$ должна быть квадратной матрицей, а это не гарантируется условием $Ax = 0$
options.D: Потому что определитель был бы равен нулю, что делает $A$ вырожденной

ru.explanation: Если $Ax = 0$ при $x \neq 0$ и у $A$ есть обратная матрица, то $x = A^{-1}Ax = A^{-1}0 = 0$ — противоречие. «Проблемы с прообразом» нет только тогда, когда отображение взаимно однозначно; а нулевой вектор доказывает, что это не так.

uz.text: $Ax = 0$ ning noldan farq qiluvchi yechimi nima uchun teskari matritsa mavjudligini istisno qiladi? Konspektlarda «hech qanday matritsa 0 ni yana x ga qaytara olmaydi» deb atalgan ikki jumlali asosni keltiring.

options.A: Chunki agar $Ax = 0$, $x \neq 0$ boʻlsa, u holda $x = A^{-1}0 = 0$ — zidlik kelib chiqadi
options.B: Chunki $A$ $0$ ni $x$ ga akslantirishi kerak boʻlar edi, lekin har doim $A(0) = 0$, demak $x$ albatta $0$ boʻlishi kerak
options.C: Chunki $A$ kvadrat matritsa boʻlishi kerak, bu esa $Ax = 0$ shartidan kafolatlanmaydi
options.D: Chunki determinant nolga teng boʻlib qoladi, bu $A$ ni degeneratsiyalangan qiladi

uz.explanation: Agar $Ax = 0$, $x \neq 0$ va $A$ ning teskari matritsasi boʻlsa, u holda $x = A^{-1}Ax = A^{-1}0 = 0$ — zidlik. «Proobraz muammosi» faqat akslantirish oʻzaro bir-qiymatli boʻlganda boʻlmaydi; null-vektor esa aksincha, bunday emasligini isbotlaydi.

questions.text: If $A$ and $C$ are invertible $3 \times 3$ matrices, is $A + C$ invertible? Is $AC$? Is $A^{-1}C$?
questions.D: $A + C$: not necessarily, $AC$: not necessarily, $A^{-1}C$: always
questions.expl: $A + C$ is not necessarily invertible (e.g., $C = -A$ gives $0$), but $AC$ and $A^{-1}C$ are always invertible as products of invertible matrices.

ru.text: Если $A$ и $C$ — обратимые матрицы $3 \times 3$, обратима ли $A + C$? А $AC$? А $A^{-1}C$?

options.D: $A + C$: не обязательно, $AC$: не обязательно, $A^{-1}C$: всегда

ru.explanation: $A + C$ не обязательно обратима (например, $C = -A$ даёт $0$), но $AC$ и $A^{-1}C$ всегда обратимы как произведения обратимых матриц.

uz.text: Agar $A$ va $C$ teskari $3 \times 3$ matritsalar boʻlsa, $A + C$ teskari matritsaga egami? $AC$-chi? $A^{-1}C$-chi?

options.A: $A + C$: har doim ham emas, $AC$: har doim, $A^{-1}C$: har doim
options.B: $A + C$: har doim, $AC$: har doim, $A^{-1}C$: har doim
options.C: $A + C$: hech qachon, $AC$: har doim, $A^{-1}C$: har doim
options.D: $A + C$: har doim ham emas, $AC$: har doim ham emas, $A^{-1}C$: har doim

uz.explanation: $A + C$ har doim ham teskari matritsaga ega emas (masalan, $C = -A$ boʻlsa $0$ chiqadi), lekin $AC$ va $A^{-1}C$ teskari matritsalar koʻpaytmasi boʻlgani uchun har doim teskari matritsaga ega.

questions.text: Carry out Gauss–Jordan elimination for $A = \begin{pmatrix}4&-6&0\\-2&7&2\end{pmatrix}$ and state $A^{-1}$.
questions.expl: Gauss-Jordan elimination yields $A^{-1} = \begin{pmatrix}12/8&-5/8&-6/8\\8/8&-3/8&-2/8\\-1&1&-1/8\end{pmatrix}$. The determinant is $-16$, confirming the inverse calculation.

ru.text: Выполните исключение Гаусса–Жордана для $A = \begin{pmatrix}4&-6&0\\-2&7&2\end{pmatrix}$ и укажите $A^{-1}$.
ru.explanation: Исключение Гаусса–Жордана даёт $A^{-1} = \begin{pmatrix}12/8&-5/8&-6/8\\8/8&-3/8&-2/8\\-1&1&-1/8\end{pmatrix}$. Определитель равен $-16$, что подтверждает вычисление обратной матрицы.

uz.text: $A = \begin{pmatrix}4&-6&0\\-2&7&2\end{pmatrix}$ uchun Gauss–Jordan usulini bajaring va $A^{-1}$ ni koʻrsating.
uz.explanation: Gauss–Jordan usuli $A^{-1} = \begin{pmatrix}12/8&-5/8&-6/8\\8/8&-3/8&-2/8\\-1&1&-1/8\end{pmatrix}$ ni beradi. Determinant $-16$ ga teng, bu teskari matritsa hisobini tasdiqlaydi.

questions.text: State the determinant-transpose identities: $det(A^T)$, $det(AB)$, $det(A^{-1})$.
questions.expl: The identities are $det(A^T) = det(A)$, $det(AB) = det(A)det(B)$, and $det(A^{-1}) = \frac{1}{det(A)}$, which shows $A$ is invertible iff $det(A) \neq 0$.

ru.text: Сформулируйте тождества определителя и транспонирования: $det(A^T)$, $det(AB)$, $det(A^{-1})$.
ru.explanation: Тождества: $det(A^T) = det(A)$, $det(AB) = det(A)det(B)$ и $det(A^{-1}) = \frac{1}{det(A)}$; они показывают, что $A$ обратима тогда и только тогда, когда $det(A) \neq 0$.

uz.text: Determinant–transponirlash ayniyatlarini yozing: $det(A^T)$, $det(AB)$, $det(A^{-1})$.
uz.explanation: Ayniyatlar: $det(A^T) = det(A)$, $det(AB) = det(A)det(B)$ va $det(A^{-1}) = \frac{1}{det(A)}$; ular $A$ faqat $det(A) \neq 0$ boʻlganda teskari matritsaga ega ekanligini koʻrsatadi.

questions.text: Prove $(A^{-1})^T = (A^T)^{-1}$ and explain why $A^T A$ is symmetric with nonnegative diagonal.
questions.A: $(A^{-1})^T$ is inverse of $A^T$ because $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$; $A^T A$ is symmetric as $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, with diagonal entries $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$
questions.B: $(A^{-1})^T$ is inverse of $A^T$ because $(A^{-1})^T A^T = A$; $A^T A$ is symmetric as $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, with diagonal entries $a_{ki} \geq 0$
questions.C: $(A^{-1})^T$ is inverse of $A^T$ because $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$; $A^T A$ is symmetric as $(A^T A)^T = A A^T$, with diagonal entries $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$
questions.D: $(A^{-1})^T$ is inverse of $A^T$ because $(A^{-1})^T A^T = -I$; $A^T A$ is symmetric as $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, with diagonal entries $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$
questions.expl: Transposing $AA^{-1} = I$ gives $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$, proving $(A^{-1})^T$ is the inverse of $A^T$. $A^T A$ is symmetric since $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, and its diagonal entries are sums of squares, hence nonnegative.

ru.text: Докажите $(A^{-1})^T = (A^T)^{-1}$ и объясните, почему $A^T A$ симметрична и имеет неотрицательную диагональ.

options.A: $(A^{-1})^T$ — обратная для $A^T$, потому что $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$; $A^T A$ симметрична, так как $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, диагональные элементы $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$
options.B: $(A^{-1})^T$ — обратная для $A^T$, потому что $(A^{-1})^T A^T = A$; $A^T A$ симметрична, так как $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, диагональные элементы $a_{ki} \geq 0$
options.C: $(A^{-1})^T$ — обратная для $A^T$, потому что $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$; $A^T A$ симметрична, так как $(A^T A)^T = A A^T$, диагональные элементы $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$
options.D: $(A^{-1})^T$ — обратная для $A^T$, потому что $(A^{-1})^T A^T = -I$; $A^T A$ симметрична, так как $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, диагональные элементы $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$

ru.explanation: Транспонируя $AA^{-1} = I$, получаем $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$, что доказывает: $(A^{-1})^T$ — обратная матрица для $A^T$. $A^T A$ симметрична, поскольку $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, а её диагональные элементы — суммы квадратов, следовательно, неотрицательны.

uz.text: $(A^{-1})^T = (A^T)^{-1}$ ekanligini isbotlang va $A^T A$ nima uchun simmetrik hamda manfiy boʻlmagan diagonalga ega ekanligini tushuntiring.

options.A: $(A^{-1})^T$ — $A^T$ ning teskari matritsasi, chunki $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$; $A^T A$ simmetrik, chunki $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, diagonal elementlari $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$
options.B: $(A^{-1})^T$ — $A^T$ ning teskari matritsasi, chunki $(A^{-1})^T A^T = A$; $A^T A$ simmetrik, chunki $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, diagonal elementlari $a_{ki} \geq 0$
options.C: $(A^{-1})^T$ — $A^T$ ning teskari matritsasi, chunki $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$; $A^T A$ simmetrik, chunki $(A^T A)^T = A A^T$, diagonal elementlari $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$
options.D: $(A^{-1})^T$ — $A^T$ ning teskari matritsasi, chunki $(A^{-1})^T A^T = -I$; $A^T A$ simmetrik, chunki $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, diagonal elementlari $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$

uz.explanation: $AA^{-1} = I$ ni transponirlasak, $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$ boʻladi; bu $(A^{-1})^T$ — $A^T$ ning teskari matritsasi ekanligini isbotlaydi. $A^T A$ simmetrik, chunki $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, uning diagonal elementlari kvadratlar yigʻindisi boʻlgani uchun manfiy emas.

tests.title: Linear Algebra I: Weeks 5-7 Complete Test

questions.text: In the row picture of the system $\begin{pmatrix}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}x \\ y\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$, what does each row of the matrix represent geometrically?
questions.A: A line in the plane; the solution (2, 3) is the intersection point of the two lines
questions.B: A vector from the origin; the solution is their sum
questions.C: A point in the plane; the solution is the midpoint
questions.D: A parabola; the solution is the tangency point
questions.expl: Each row of Ax = b is one linear equation — a line in 2D (a plane in 3D). The row-picture solution is the common intersection point; here 2x − y = 1 and x + y = 5 meet at (2, 3).

en.text: In the row picture of the system $\begin{pmatrix}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}x \\ y\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$ , what does each row of the matrix represent geometrically?

options.A: A line in the plane; the solution (2, 3) is the intersection point of the two lines
options.B: A vector from the origin; the solution is their sum
options.C: A point in the plane; the solution is the midpoint
options.D: A parabola; the solution is the tangency point

en.explanation: Each row of Ax = b is one linear equation — a line in 2D (a plane in 3D). The row-picture solution is the common intersection point; here 2x − y = 1 and x + y = 5 meet at (2, 3).

ru.text: В строчной картине (row picture) системы $\begin{pmatrix}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}x \\ y\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$ что геометрически представляет каждая строка матрицы?

options.A: Прямую на плоскости; решение (2, 3) — точка пересечения двух прямых
options.B: Вектор из начала координат; решение — их сумма

ru.explanation: Каждая строка Ax = b — одно линейное уравнение, то есть прямая в 2D (плоскость в 3D). Решение в строчной картине — общая точка пересечения; здесь 2x − y = 1 и x + y = 5 пересекаются в (2, 3).

uz.text: $\begin{pmatrix}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}x \\ y\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$ sistemasining satrli tasvirida (row picture) matritsaning har bir satri geometrik nimani bildiradi?

options.A: Tekislikdagi toʻgʻri chiziq; (2, 3) yechim — ikki chiziqning kesishish nuqtasi
options.B: Bosh nuqtadan chizilgan vektor; yechim — ularning yigʻindisi

uz.explanation: Ax = b ning har bir satri bitta chiziqli tenglama — 2D da toʻgʻri chiziq (3D da tekislik). Satrli tasvirdagi yechim — umumiy kesishish nuqtasi; bu yerda 2x − y = 1 va x + y = 5 chiziqlari (2, 3) da kesishadi.

questions.text: In the column picture, the product $A \cdot x$ is interpreted as:
questions.A: A linear combination of the columns of A with coefficients $x_{1}$, ..., $x_{n}$
questions.B: A linear combination of the rows of A
questions.C: The dot product of the rows of A with the vector b
questions.D: The product of the diagonal entries of A
questions.expl: $Ax = x_{1} \cdot a_{1} + x_{2} \cdot a_{2}$ + ... + $x_{n} \cdot a_{n}$: the vector b must be assembled from the columns of A. Solving Ax = b means finding the right coefficients of that combination.

en.text: In the column picture, the product $A \cdot x$ is interpreted as:

options.A: The dot product of the rows of A with the vector b
options.B: A linear combination of the rows of A
options.C: A linear combination of the columns of A with coefficients $x_{1}$ , ..., $x_{n}$
options.D: The product of the diagonal entries of A

en.explanation: $Ax = x_{1} \cdot a_{1} + x_{2} \cdot a_{2}$ + ... + $x_{n} \cdot a_{n}$ : the vector b must be assembled from the columns of A. Solving Ax = b means finding the right coefficients of that combination.

ru.text: В столбцовой картине произведение $A \cdot x$ интерпретируется как:

options.A: Линейная комбинация столбцов A с коэффициентами $x_{1}$, ..., $x_{n}$
options.C: Скалярное произведение строк A на вектор b

ru.explanation: $Ax = x_{1} \cdot a_{1} + x_{2} \cdot a_{2}$ + ... + $x_{n} \cdot a_{n}$: вектор b собирается из столбцов A. Решить Ax = b — значит найти правильные коэффициенты этой комбинации.

uz.text: Ustunli tasvirda $A \cdot x$ koʻpaytma qanday talqin etiladi?

options.C: A satrlarining b vektor bilan skalyar koʻpaytmasi

uz.explanation: $Ax = x_{1} \cdot a_{1} + x_{2} \cdot a_{2}$ + ... + $x_{n} \cdot a_{n}$: b vektori A ustunlaridan yigʻiladi. Ax = b ni yechish — bu kombinatsiyaning toʻgʻri koeffitsientlarini topish demakdir.

questions.text: Solve the system $\begin{pmatrix}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}x \\ y\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$.
questions.expl: Adding the equations 2x − y = 1 and x + y = 5 gives 3x = 6, so x = 2 and y = 3. Column-picture check: $2 \cdot \begin{pmatrix}2 \\ 1\end{pmatrix} + 3 \cdot \begin{pmatrix}-1 \\ 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$.

en.text: Solve the system $\begin{pmatrix}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}x \\ y\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$ .
en.explanation: Adding the equations 2x − y = 1 and x + y = 5 gives 3x = 6, so x = 2 and y = 3. Column-picture check: $2 \cdot \begin{pmatrix}2 \\ 1\end{pmatrix} + 3 \cdot \begin{pmatrix}-1 \\ 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$ .

ru.text: Решите систему $\begin{pmatrix}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}x \\ y\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$.
ru.explanation: Складывая уравнения 2x − y = 1 и x + y = 5, получаем 3x = 6, откуда x = 2 и y = 3. Проверка в столбцовой картине: $2 \cdot \begin{pmatrix}2 \\ 1\end{pmatrix} + 3 \cdot \begin{pmatrix}-1 \\ 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$.

uz.text: $\begin{pmatrix}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}x \\ y\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$ sistemasini yeching.
uz.explanation: 2x − y = 1 va x + y = 5 tenglamalarini qoʻshsak, 3x = 6, demak x = 2 va y = 3. Ustunli tasvirda tekshirish: $2 \cdot \begin{pmatrix}2 \\ 1\end{pmatrix} + 3 \cdot \begin{pmatrix}-1 \\ 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$.

questions.text: In the column picture of $\begin{pmatrix}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}x \\ y\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$, which combination of the columns $\begin{pmatrix}2 \\ 1\end{pmatrix}$ and $\begin{pmatrix}-1 \\ 1\end{pmatrix}$ produces $\begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$?
questions.expl: $2 \cdot \begin{pmatrix}2 \\ 1\end{pmatrix} + 3 \cdot \begin{pmatrix}-1 \\ 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}4 - 3 \\ 2 + 3\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$. The weights are exactly the components of the solution x = (2, 3).

en.text: In the column picture of $\begin{pmatrix}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}x \\ y\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$ , which combination of the columns $\begin{pmatrix}2 \\ 1\end{pmatrix}$ and $\begin{pmatrix}-1 \\ 1\end{pmatrix}$ produces $\begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$ ?
en.explanation: $2 \cdot \begin{pmatrix}2 \\ 1\end{pmatrix} + 3 \cdot \begin{pmatrix}-1 \\ 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}4 - 3 \\ 2 + 3\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$ . The weights are exactly the components of the solution x = (2, 3).

ru.text: В столбцовой картине системы $\begin{pmatrix}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}x \\ y\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$ какая комбинация столбцов $\begin{pmatrix}2 \\ 1\end{pmatrix}$ и $\begin{pmatrix}-1 \\ 1\end{pmatrix}$ даёт $\begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 5\end{pmatrix}$?

questions.text: During Gaussian elimination on an augmented matrix you obtain the row $\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}0 & 0 & c\end{array}\right]$ with $c \ne 0$. What does it mean?
questions.A: The system has no solution: the row reads 0 = c, which is impossible
questions.B: The system has infinitely many solutions
questions.C: The system has a unique solution
questions.expl: A row $\left[\begin{array}{cccc|c}0 & 0 & \cdots & 0 & c\end{array}\right]$ with $c \ne 0$ reads 0 = c — a contradiction, so the system is inconsistent. If instead c = 0, the row carries no information and there are infinitely many solutions (fewer pivots than unknowns).

questions.text: Eliminate below the first pivot in the augmented matrix $\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}2 & 3 & 7 \\ 8 & 13 & 29\end{array}\right]$. What are the multiplier and the resulting pivots?

questions.text: Which $3 \times 3$ matrix E performs the row operation $R_{3} \leftarrow R_{3} - 4R_{1}$?

questions.text: Let $E = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ -2 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ and $A = \begin{pmatrix}3 & 1 \\ 6 & 5\end{pmatrix}$. Compute EA and describe the operation.

questions.C: $EA = \begin{pmatrix}3 & 1 \\ 6 & 3\end{pmatrix}$: E subtracts twice row 2 from row 1

So $EA = \begin{pmatrix}3 & 1 \\ 0 & 3\end{pmatrix}$ — elimination below the pivot 3 with multiplier $\frac{6}{3} = 2$.

questions.text: Solve $\begin{pmatrix}0 & 2 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}x \\ y\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}4 \\ 7\end{pmatrix}$ using a row exchange. What are the solution and the permutation matrix?

questions.text: Which permutation matrix exchanges rows 1 and 3 of a $3 \times 3$ matrix, and what is $P^{2}$?

options.A: $P = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 0\end{pmatrix}$ и $P^{2} = I$ — двойной обмен возвращает порядок

ru.explanation: $P_{13}$ — единичная матрица с обменянными строками 1 и 3. Двойной обмен строк 1 и 3 возвращает исходную матрицу, поэтому $P^{2} = I$ и $P^{-1} = P$ — согласуется с $P^{-1} = P^{T}$.

uz.text: Qaysi permutatsiya matritsa $3 \times 3$ matritsaning 1- va 3-satrlarini almashtiradi va $P^{2}$ nimaga teng?

options.A: $P = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 0\end{pmatrix}$ va $P^{2} = I$ — ikki karra almashinish tartibni tiklaydi

questions.text: Let $E = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ -2 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ (elimination) and $P = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{pmatrix}$ (exchange). What can be said about EP and PE?
questions.A: $EP \ne PE$: row operations generally do not commute $(EP = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 1 \\ 1 & -2\end{pmatrix}, PE = \begin{pmatrix}-2 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{pmatrix})$
questions.D: PE is not defined for these matrices
questions.expl: Computing: $EP = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 1 \\ 1 & -2\end{pmatrix}$, while $PE = \begin{pmatrix}-2 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{pmatrix}$. The products differ — 'eliminate then exchange' and 'exchange then eliminate' give different matrices, so row operations do not commute.

ru.text: Пусть $E = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ -2 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ (исключение) и $P = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{pmatrix}$ (обмен). Что можно сказать о EP и PE?

options.D: PE для этих матриц не определено

ru.explanation: Вычисление: $EP = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 1 \\ 1 & -2\end{pmatrix}$, тогда как $PE = \begin{pmatrix}-2 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{pmatrix}$. Произведения различны: «сначала исключение, потом обмен» и «сначала обмен, потом исключение» дают разные матрицы — строковые операции не коммутируют.

questions.text: For $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4\end{pmatrix}$, classify the systems $Ax = \begin{pmatrix}3 \\ 6\end{pmatrix}$ and $Ax = \begin{pmatrix}3 \\ 7\end{pmatrix}$.
questions.expl: Row $2 = 2$·(row 1). For $b = \begin{pmatrix}3 \\ 6\end{pmatrix}$ the same relation holds $(6 = 2 \cdot 3)$, leaving one equation x + 2y = 3 — infinitely many solutions. For $b = \begin{pmatrix}3 \\ 7\end{pmatrix}$ the elimination gives 0 = 1 — no solutions. The matrix has rank 1 and no inverse.

en.text: For $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4\end{pmatrix}$ , classify the systems $Ax = \begin{pmatrix}3 \\ 6\end{pmatrix}$ and $Ax = \begin{pmatrix}3 \\ 7\end{pmatrix}$ .

ru.text: Для $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4\end{pmatrix}$ классифицируйте системы $Ax = \begin{pmatrix}3 \\ 6\end{pmatrix}$ и $Ax = \begin{pmatrix}3 \\ 7\end{pmatrix}$.

options.D: Ikkalasida ham cheksiz koʻp yechim bor

questions.text: For $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4\end{pmatrix}$, which right-hand sides $b = \begin{pmatrix}b_{1} \\ b_{2}\end{pmatrix}$ allow the system Ax = b to be solved?
questions.A: Exactly those with $b_{2} = 2b_{1}$: b must lie on the line through the columns of A
questions.expl: The columns are $\begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 2\end{pmatrix}$ and $\begin{pmatrix}2 \\ 4\end{pmatrix} = 2 \cdot \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 2\end{pmatrix}$, so every combination $x \cdot \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 2\end{pmatrix} + y \cdot \begin{pmatrix}2 \\ 4\end{pmatrix}$ lies on the line $b_{2} = 2b_{1}$. Consistency requires exactly $b_{2} = 2b_{1} (e.g. \begin{pmatrix}4 \\ 8\end{pmatrix}$ works, $\begin{pmatrix}4 \\ 9\end{pmatrix}$ does not).

ru.text: Для $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4\end{pmatrix}$ какие правые части $b = \begin{pmatrix}b_{1} \\ b_{2}\end{pmatrix}$ допускают решение системы Ax = b?

options.A: Ровно те, для которых $b_{2} = 2b_{1}$: b должен лежать на прямой через столбцы A

ru.explanation: Столбцы $\begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 2\end{pmatrix}$ и $\begin{pmatrix}2 \\ 4\end{pmatrix} = 2 \cdot \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 2\end{pmatrix}$ пропорциональны, поэтому любая комбинация $x \cdot \begin{pmatrix}1 \\ 2\end{pmatrix} + y \cdot \begin{pmatrix}2 \\ 4\end{pmatrix}$ лежит на прямой $b_{2} = 2b_{1}$. Совместность требует ровно $b_{2} = 2b_{1}$ (например, $\begin{pmatrix}4 \\ 8\end{pmatrix}$ решается, $\begin{pmatrix}4 \\ 9\end{pmatrix}$ — нет).

uz.text: $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4\end{pmatrix}$ uchun qaysi $b = \begin{pmatrix}b_{1} \\ b_{2}\end{pmatrix}$ oʻng tomonlar Ax = b sistemasini yechishga imkon beradi?

options.A: Aynan $b_{2} = 2b_{1}$ bajarilganlari: b, A ustunlari orqali oʻtuvchi toʻgʻri chiziqda yotishi kerak

questions.text: For a square $n \times n$ matrix A, having n pivots after elimination is equivalent to:
questions.A: A being invertible: Ax = b has exactly one solution for every b
questions.expl: n pivots mean the columns are independent, so Ax = 0 has only x = 0 and Ax = b is uniquely solvable for every b — the matrix is invertible. The number of pivots found by elimination is the rank.

ru.text: Для квадратной матрицы A размера $n \times n$ наличие n опорных элементов после исключения равносильно тому, что:

questions.text: Gaussian elimination stops at an upper triangular U and finishes with back substitution. What does the Gauss–Jordan method do instead?
questions.A: It continues on $\left[\begin{array}{c|c}A & I\end{array}\right]$ up to the reduced form $[I | A^{-1}$]
questions.B: It stops earlier, at the first pivot
questions.C: It swaps all rows of A before eliminating
questions.D: It computes the transpose instead of the inverse
questions.expl: Gauss–Jordan keeps eliminating above the pivots too, reducing the left block of $\left[\begin{array}{c|c}A & I\end{array}\right]$ to the identity; the right block then holds $A^{-1}$. Gaussian elimination itself stops at U plus back substitution.

ru.text: Гауссово исключение останавливается на верхней треугольной U и завершается обратной подстановкой. Что вместо этого делает метод Гаусса–Жордана?

options.A: Он продолжает работу над $\left[\begin{array}{c|c}A & I\end{array}\right]$ до приведённого вида $[I | A^{-1}$]
options.B: Он останавливается раньше — на первом опорном элементе
options.C: Он меняет местами все строки A перед исключением

ru.explanation: Гаусс–Жордан исключает и над опорными элементами, приводя левый блок $\left[\begin{array}{c|c}A & I\end{array}\right]$ к единичной матрице; тогда в правом блоке стоит $A^{-1}$. Само гауссово исключение останавливается на U плюс обратная подстановка.

uz.text: Gauss eliminasiyasi yuqori uchburchak U da toʻxtaydi va teskari almashtirish bilan tugaydi. Gauss–Jordan usuli buning oʻrniga nima qiladi?

options.A: $U \left[\begin{array}{c|c}A & I\end{array}\right]$ ustida ishlashni $[I | A^{-1}$] koʻrinishigacha davom ettiradi
options.B: U birinchi tayanchda, undan ham oldinroq toʻxtaydi
options.C: Eliminasiyadan oldin A ning barcha satrlarini almashtiradi

questions.text: Which of the four ways to compute the product AB is the COLUMN interpretation?
questions.A: $AB = \begin{pmatrix}Ab_{1} & \cdots & Ab_p\end{pmatrix}$: column j of AB is A times column j of B
questions.B: Each row of AB is a combination of the rows of B
questions.C: $(AB)_{ij}$ is the dot product of row i of A with column j of B, entry by entry
questions.D: AB is the sum over k of (column k of A)$\cdot$(row k of B) — outer products
questions.expl: Column view: multiplying A by the j-th column of B produces the j-th column of AB, so $AB = \begin{pmatrix}Ab_{1} & \cdots & Ab_p\end{pmatrix}$. The other options are the row view, the entry view and the outer-product view — all four give the same AB.

options.D: AB — сумма по k произведений (столбец k матрицы A)$\cdot$(строка k матрицы B) — внешние произведения

uz.text: AB koʻpaytmasini hisoblashning toʻrt usulidan qaysi biri USTUNLI talqinga mos keladi?

questions.text: Compute the product $\begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & 4\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}2 & 1 \\ 0 & -1 \\ 3 & 2\end{pmatrix}$.
questions.expl: Entry (i, j) is row i of the first matrix times column j of the second: $(1,1) = 1 \cdot 2 + 2 \cdot 0 + 0 \cdot 3 = 2$; $(1,2) = 1 \cdot 1 + 2 \cdot (-1) + 0 \cdot 2 = -1$; $(2,1) = -1 \cdot 2 + 3 \cdot 0 + 4 \cdot 3 = 10$; (2,2) = −1 − 3 + 8 = 4.

questions.text: For $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ and $B = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1\end{pmatrix}$, compute AB and BA.
questions.expl: AB combines the columns of A: $[A \cdot (1; 1)$, $A \cdot (0; 1)$] = $\begin{pmatrix}2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1\end{pmatrix}$. BA combines the rows of A and gives $\begin{pmatrix}1 & 1 \\ 1 & 2\end{pmatrix}$. In general $AB \ne BA$ — matrix multiplication is not commutative (horizontal and vertical shears depend on the order).

questions.text: Which statement about matrix algebra is TRUE (whenever the sums and products are defined)?
questions.A: (AB)C = A(BC) and A(B + C) = AB + AC — associativity and distributivity always hold
questions.B: AB = BA for all square matrices A and B
questions.C: $(A + B)^{2} = A^{2} + 2AB + B^{2}$ for all A and B
questions.D: $(AB)^{2} = A^{2} \cdot B^{2}$ for all invertible A and B
questions.expl: Matrix multiplication is associative and distributive over addition. It is NOT commutative: expanding $(A + B)^{2}$ gives $A^{2} + AB + BA + B^{2}$, which differs from $A^{2} + 2AB + B^{2}$ unless AB = BA, and $(AB)^{2}$ = ABAB ≠$A^2B^{2}$.

questions.text: For arbitrary square matrices A and B, $(A + B)^{2}$ equals:
questions.expl: $(A + B)(A + B) = A^{2} + AB + BA + B^{2}$. The middle terms cannot merge into 2AB unless AB = BA; e.g. for $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix}$, $B = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ one gets $AB + BA = \begin{pmatrix}3 & 2 \\ 2 & 3\end{pmatrix}$ while $2AB = \begin{pmatrix}4 & 2 \\ 2 & 2\end{pmatrix}$.

questions.text: Apply Gauss–Jordan elimination to $\left[\begin{array}{c|c}A & I\end{array}\right] = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 3 & 7 & 0 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ to find $A^{-1}$ for $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 3 & 7\end{pmatrix}$.

questions.text: Computing the inverse $A^{-1}$ is equivalent to solving which systems?
questions.A: n systems $Ax_{j} = e_{j}$, one for each column of the identity: $A^{-1} = \begin{pmatrix}x_{1} & \cdots & x_n\end{pmatrix}$
questions.B: One system Ax = b with a single fixed right side b
questions.D: n systems $Ax_{j} = b_{j}$ with arbitrary right sides $b_{j}$
questions.expl: If $A^{-1} = \begin{pmatrix}x_{1} & \cdots & x_n\end{pmatrix}$, then $A \cdot A^{-1} = I$ means $Ax_{j} = e_{j}$ for every j: the j-th column of the inverse solves the system with right side $e_{j}$. Gauss–Jordan on $\left[\begin{array}{c|c}A & I\end{array}\right] \to [I | A^{-1}$] solves all n systems at once.

questions.text: Find the LU decomposition of $A = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 1 \\ 6 & 5\end{pmatrix}$ (no row exchanges).
questions.expl: The multiplier is $\lambda_{21} = \frac{6}{2} = 3$, and $R_{2} \leftarrow R_{2} - 3R_{1}$ turns the row $\begin{pmatrix}6 & 5\end{pmatrix}$ into $\begin{pmatrix}0 & 2\end{pmatrix}$. The multiplier goes below the diagonal of L and U keeps the elimination result: $\begin{pmatrix}2 & 1 \\ 6 & 5\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2\end{pmatrix}$.

questions.text: Elimination on $A = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 1 & 1 \\ 4 & 5 & 4 \\ -2 & 2 & 3\end{pmatrix}$ ends with $U = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 2\end{pmatrix}$. What is L?

questions.text: Let A = LU with $L = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ and $U = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2\end{pmatrix}$. Solving Ax = b for $b = \begin{pmatrix}5 \\ 19\end{pmatrix}$ in two steps gives:
questions.A: $y = \begin{pmatrix}5 \\ 4\end{pmatrix}$ from Ly = b, then $x = \begin{pmatrix}\frac{3}{2} \\ 2\end{pmatrix}$ from Ux = y
questions.expl: Forward substitution Ly = b: $y_{1} = 5$ and $3 \cdot 5 + y_{2} = 19$, so $y_{2} = 4$. Back substitution Ux = y: $2x_{2} = 4$ gives $x_{2} = 2$, and $2x_{1} + 2 = 5$ gives $x_{1} = \frac{3}{2}$. Check with $A = LU = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 1 \\ 6 & 5\end{pmatrix}$: $A \cdot \begin{pmatrix}\frac{3}{2} \\ 2\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}5 \\ 19\end{pmatrix}$.

questions.text: In the LDU decomposition $\begin{pmatrix}2 & 1 \\ 6 & 5\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot D \cdot \begin{pmatrix}1 & \frac{1}{2} \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix}$, the middle factor D is:
questions.A: $\begin{pmatrix}2 & 0 \\ 0 & 2\end{pmatrix}$ — the pivots of U on its diagonal
questions.D: $\begin{pmatrix}3 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ — the first multiplier and a unit pivot
questions.expl: LDU splits $U = D \cdot (D^{-1}U)$: D holds the pivots 2 and 2, while $D^{-1}U = \begin{pmatrix}1 & \frac{1}{2} \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ has units on its diagonal. Check: $\begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}2 & 0 \\ 0 & 2\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}1 & \frac{1}{2} \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 1 \\ 6 & 5\end{pmatrix}$.

questions.text: Why does partial pivoting exchange rows for $A = [10^{-8} 1$; 1 1]?
questions.A: The first pivot $10^{-8}$ would give the huge multiplier $10^{8}$; after the exchange the multiplier is only $10^{-8}$
questions.B: A is singular, so a row exchange is required to make it invertible
questions.C: The exchange makes U symmetric, which is required for LU
questions.D: Partial pivoting always reorders the rows in decreasing order
questions.expl: Without the exchange the multiplier is $\frac{1}{10^{-8}} = 10^{8}$: subtracting a huge multiple of row 1 would amplify round-off error. The exchange puts the largest available entry of the column (the number 1) into the pivot position, giving the multiplier $10^{-8}/1 = 10^{-8}$. The matrix is invertible either way $(det = 1 - 10^{-8} \ne 0)$.

options.A: The exchange makes U symmetric, which is required for LU
options.B: A is singular, so a row exchange is required to make it invertible
options.C: Partial pivoting always reorders the rows in decreasing order
options.D: The first pivot $10^{-8}$ would give the huge multiplier $10^{8}$ ; after the exchange the multiplier is only $10^{-8}$

The exchange puts the largest available entry of the column (the number 1) into the pivot position, giving the multiplier $10^{-8}/1 = 10^{-8}$ . The matrix is invertible either way $(det = 1 - 10^{-8} \ne 0)$ .

ru.text: Почему частичный выбор опорного элемента меняет строки для $A = [10^{-8} 1$; 1 1]?

options.A: Первый опорный элемент $10^{-8}$ дал бы огромный множитель $10^{8}$; после обмена множитель равен лишь $10^{-8}$
options.B: Матрица A вырождена, поэтому для обратимости необходим обмен строк
options.C: Обмен делает U симметричной, что требуется для LU
options.D: Частичный выбор всегда упорядочивает строки по убыванию

ru.explanation: Без обмена множитель равен $\frac{1}{10^{-8}} = 10^{8}$: вычитание огромного кратного строки 1 усиливало бы погрешности округления. Обмен ставит наибольший по модулю элемент столбца (число 1) в опорную позицию, и множитель становится $10^{-8}/1 = 10^{-8}$. Матрица обратима в обоих случаях $(det = 1 - 10^{-8} \ne 0)$.

uz.text: $A = [10^{-8} 1$; 1 1] uchun qismiy tayanch tanlash (partial pivoting) nega satrlarni almashtiradi?

options.A: Birinchi tayanch $10^{-8}$ ulkan $10^{8}$ koʻpaytuvchisini berardi; almashgandan keyin koʻpaytuvchi faqat $10^{-8}$

Almashuv ustunning eng katta modulli elementini (1 sonini) tayanch oʻrniga qoʻyadi va koʻpaytuvchi $10^{-8}/1 = 10^{-8}$ boʻladi. Matritsa baribir teskari $(det = 1 - 10^{-8} \ne 0)$.

questions.text: $A = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 2 \\ 3 & 4\end{pmatrix}$ has a zero first pivot. Which factorization PA = LU is correct?
questions.B: No factorization exists — the zero pivot means A is singular
questions.expl: A zero in the pivot position only signals a bad row order, not singularity: $det A = 0 \cdot 4 - 2 \cdot 3 = -6 \ne 0$. Exchanging the rows $(P = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{pmatrix})$ gives $PA = \begin{pmatrix}3 & 4 \\ 0 & 2\end{pmatrix}$, which is already triangular, so L = I and PA = LU.

en.text: $A = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 2 \\ 3 & 4\end{pmatrix}$ has a zero first pivot. Which factorization PA = LU is correct?

options.A: No factorization exists — the zero pivot means A is singular

Exchanging the rows $(P = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{pmatrix})$ gives $PA = \begin{pmatrix}3 & 4 \\ 0 & 2\end{pmatrix}$ , which is already triangular, so L = I and PA = LU.

ru.text: У матрицы $A = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 2 \\ 3 & 4\end{pmatrix}$ первый опорный элемент нулевой. Какое разложение PA = LU верно?

options.B: Разложения не существует — нулевой опорный элемент означает вырожденность A

ru.explanation: Ноль в опорной позиции лишь сигнализирует о неудачном порядке строк, а не о вырожденности: $det A = 0 \cdot 4 - 2 \cdot 3 = -6 \ne 0$. Обмен строк $(P = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{pmatrix})$ даёт $PA = \begin{pmatrix}3 & 4 \\ 0 & 2\end{pmatrix}$ — уже треугольную матрицу, поэтому L = I и PA = LU.

options.B: Ajralmas mavjud emas — nol tayanch A ning singulyarligini bildiradi

Satrlarni almashtirish $(P = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{pmatrix}) PA = \begin{pmatrix}3 & 4 \\ 0 & 2\end{pmatrix}$ beradi — u allaqachon uchburchak, shuning uchun L = I va PA = LU.

questions.text: For $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ and $B = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 0 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix}$, compute $(AB)^{T}$ and check the transpose identity.
questions.expl: $AB = \begin{pmatrix}1 \cdot 2 + 2 \cdot 3 & 2 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}8 & 2 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix}$, so $(AB)^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}8 & 3 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix}$. The identity gives the same: $B^{T} \cdot A^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}8 & 3 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix}$. Keeping the original order gives $A^{T} \cdot B^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 3 \\ 4 & 7\end{pmatrix}$ — the wrong matrix.

en.text: For $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ and $B = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 0 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ , compute $(AB)^{T}$ and check the transpose identity.
en.explanation: $AB = \begin{pmatrix}1 \cdot 2 + 2 \cdot 3 & 2 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}8 & 2 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ , so $(AB)^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}8 & 3 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ . The identity gives the same: $B^{T} \cdot A^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}8 & 3 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ . Keeping the original order gives $A^{T} \cdot B^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 3 \\ 4 & 7\end{pmatrix}$ — the wrong matrix.

ru.text: Для $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ и $B = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 0 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ вычислите $(AB)^{T}$ и проверьте тождество транспонирования.
ru.explanation: $AB = \begin{pmatrix}1 \cdot 2 + 2 \cdot 3 & 2 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}8 & 2 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix}$, поэтому $(AB)^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}8 & 3 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix}$. Тождество даёт то же: $B^{T} \cdot A^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}8 & 3 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix}$. Сохранение исходного порядка даёт $A^{T} \cdot B^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 3 \\ 4 & 7\end{pmatrix}$ — неверную матрицу.

uz.text: $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ va $B = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 0 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ uchun $(AB)^{T}$ ni hisoblang va transponirlash ayniyatini tekshiring.
uz.explanation: $AB = \begin{pmatrix}1 \cdot 2 + 2 \cdot 3 & 2 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}8 & 2 \\ 3 & 1\end{pmatrix}$, demak $(AB)^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}8 & 3 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix}$. Ayniyat ham xuddi shuni beradi: $B^{T} \cdot A^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}8 & 3 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix}$. Asl tartibni saqlash $A^{T} \cdot B^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}2 & 3 \\ 4 & 7\end{pmatrix}$ beradi — notoʻgʻri matritsa.

questions.text: The difference matrix $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ maps x = (1, 2, 4) to (1, 1, 2). Where does its inverse $A^{-1} = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ map x?
questions.A: To (1, 3, 7) — the cumulative sums of the entries
questions.D: To (7, 3, 1) — the sums in reverse order
questions.expl: A computes differences (a discrete derivative); its inverse undoes them by cumulative sums (a discrete integral): $A^{-1}x = (x_{1}, x_{1} + x_{2}, x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}) = (1, 3, 7)$. Check: $A \cdot (1, 3, 7) = (1, 2, 4)$.

en.text: The difference matrix $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ maps x = (1, 2, 4) to (1, 1, 2). Where does its inverse $A^{-1} = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ map x?

options.A: To (7, 3, 1) — the sums in reverse order
options.D: To (1, 3, 7) — the cumulative sums of the entries

en.explanation: A computes differences (a discrete derivative); its inverse undoes them by cumulative sums (a discrete integral): $A^{-1}x = (x_{1}, x_{1} + x_{2}, x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}) = (1, 3, 7)$ . Check: $A \cdot (1, 3, 7) = (1, 2, 4)$ .

ru.text: Разностная матрица $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ переводит x = (1, 2, 4) в (1, 1, 2). Куда переводит x обратная матрица $A^{-1} = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 1\end{pmatrix}$?
ru.explanation: A вычисляет разности (дискретная производная); обратная отменяет их накопленными суммами (дискретный интеграл): $A^{-1}x = (x_{1}, x_{1} + x_{2}, x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}) = (1, 3, 7)$. Проверка: $A \cdot (1, 3, 7) = (1, 2, 4)$.

uz.text: Ayirmalar matritsasi $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 1\end{pmatrix} x = (1, 2, 4)$ vektorni (1, 1, 2) ga oʻtkazadi. Teskari matritsa $A^{-1} = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 1\end{pmatrix} x$ ni qayerga oʻtkazadi?
uz.explanation: A ayirmalarni hisoblaydi (diskret hosila); teskarisi ularni kumulativ yigʻindilar bilan bekor qiladi (diskret integral): $A^{-1}x = (x_{1}, x_{1} + x_{2}, x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}) = (1, 3, 7)$. Tekshirish: $A \cdot (1, 3, 7) = (1, 2, 4)$.

questions.text: Three of the following transpose identities are true for all matrices of compatible sizes. Which one is FALSE?
questions.expl: The product rule reverses the order: $(AB)^{T} = B^{T} A^{T}$, not $A^{T} B^{T}$ (which may not even be defined). The sum rule, the reversed product rule and the inverse-transpose rule are all true.

en.text: Three of the following transpose identities are true for all matrices of compatible sizes. Which one is FALSE?
en.explanation: The product rule reverses the order: $(AB)^{T} = B^{T} A^{T}$ , not $A^{T} B^{T}$ (which may not even be defined). The sum rule, the reversed product rule and the inverse-transpose rule are all true.

ru.text: Три из следующих тождеств транспонирования верны для всех матриц согласованных размеров. Какое из них ЛОЖНО?
ru.explanation: Правило произведения меняет порядок множителей: $(AB)^{T} = B^{T} A^{T}$, а не $A^{T} B^{T}$ (последнее может быть даже не определено). Правила суммы, обратного порядка и «обратной-транспонированной» верны.

uz.text: Quyidagi transponirlash ayniyatlaridan uchtasi mos oʻlchamdagi barcha matritsalar uchun toʻgʻri. Qaysi biri YALGʻON?
uz.explanation: Koʻpaytma qoidasi tartibni teskariga oʻzgartiradi: $(AB)^{T} = B^{T} A^{T}$, $A^{T} B^{T}$ emas (bu hatto aniqlanmasligi mumkin). Yigʻindi, teskari tartib va «teskari-transponir» qoidalari esa toʻgʻri.

questions.text: Split $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 4 \\ 2 & 3\end{pmatrix}$ into symmetric plus skew-symmetric parts. What is the symmetric part S?
questions.expl: $S = \frac{(A + A^{T})}{2}$ averages the off-diagonal entries: $A^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 4 & 3\end{pmatrix}$, so $S = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 3 \\ 3 & 3\end{pmatrix}$ and $K = \frac{(A - A^{T})}{2} = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 1 \\ -1 & 0\end{pmatrix}$, with S + K = A. Forgetting the division by 2 would leave $\begin{pmatrix}2 & 6 \\ 6 & 6\end{pmatrix}$.

en.text: Split $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 4 \\ 2 & 3\end{pmatrix}$ into symmetric plus skew-symmetric parts. What is the symmetric part S?
en.explanation: $S = \frac{(A + A^{T})}{2}$ averages the off-diagonal entries: $A^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 4 & 3\end{pmatrix}$ , so $S = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 3 \\ 3 & 3\end{pmatrix}$ and $K = \frac{(A - A^{T})}{2} = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 1 \\ -1 & 0\end{pmatrix}$ , with S + K = A. Forgetting the division by 2 would leave $\begin{pmatrix}2 & 6 \\ 6 & 6\end{pmatrix}$ .

ru.text: Разложите $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 4 \\ 2 & 3\end{pmatrix}$ на симметричную и кососимметрическую части. Чему равна симметричная часть S?
ru.explanation: $S = \frac{(A + A^{T})}{2}$ усредняет внедиагональные элементы: $A^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 4 & 3\end{pmatrix}$, поэтому $S = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 3 \\ 3 & 3\end{pmatrix}$, а $K = \frac{(A - A^{T})}{2} = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 1 \\ -1 & 0\end{pmatrix}$, и S + K = A. Забывание деления на 2 оставило бы $\begin{pmatrix}2 & 6 \\ 6 & 6\end{pmatrix}$.

uz.text: $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 4 \\ 2 & 3\end{pmatrix}$ ni simmetrik va kososimmetrik qismlarga ajratings. Simmetrik qism S nimaga teng?
uz.explanation: $S = \frac{(A + A^{T})}{2}$ diagonaldan tashqari elementlarni oʻrtachalaydi: $A^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 4 & 3\end{pmatrix}$, shuning uchun $S = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 3 \\ 3 & 3\end{pmatrix}$, $K = \frac{(A - A^{T})}{2} = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 1 \\ -1 & 0\end{pmatrix}$ va S + K = A. 2 ga boʻlishni unutish $\begin{pmatrix}2 & 6 \\ 6 & 6\end{pmatrix}$ qoldirardi.

questions.text: Compute $A^{T} \cdot A$ for $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix}$.
questions.expl: $A^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix}$, so $A^{T} \cdot A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 2 & 5\end{pmatrix}$. The result is symmetric, as it must be: $(A^{T} A)^{T} = A^{T} A$. (The matrix $\begin{pmatrix}5 & 2 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ is $A \cdot A^{T}$.)

en.text: Compute $A^{T} \cdot A$ for $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ .
en.explanation: $A^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ , so $A^{T} \cdot A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix} \cdot \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 2 & 5\end{pmatrix}$ . The result is symmetric, as it must be: $(A^{T} A)^{T} = A^{T} A$ . (The matrix $\begin{pmatrix}5 & 2 \\ 2 & 1\end{pmatrix}$ is $A \cdot A^{T}$ .)

questions.text: The product $R^{T} R$ appears in least squares. Which statement is TRUE for every real matrix R?
questions.A: $(R^{T} R)^{T} = R^{T} (R^{T})^{T} = R^{T} R$, so $R^{T} R$ is always symmetric
questions.B: $R^{T} R$ is symmetric only when R is a square matrix
questions.C: $R^{T} R$ is symmetric only when R itself is symmetric
questions.D: $R^{T} R = R \cdot R^{T}$ for every R
questions.expl: By the reverse-order rule, $(R^{T} R)^{T} = R^{T} (R^{T})^{T} = R^{T} R$ — no assumption on R is needed. Moreover $x^{T} R^{T} R x = ||Rx||^{2} \ge 0$ for every x. The products $R^{T} R$ and $R \cdot R^{T}$ are generally different (and have different sizes for a rectangular R).

questions.text: For $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4\end{pmatrix}$ and the permutation $P = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{pmatrix}$, what are PA and AP?
questions.expl: Multiplication on the left acts on rows: PA exchanges rows 1 and 2 of A. Multiplication on the right acts on columns: AP exchanges columns 1 and 2. In general $PA \ne AP$.

questions.text: Find $P^{-1}$ for the permutation matrix $P = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 0\end{pmatrix}$.
questions.B: P itself, since every permutation matrix is its own inverse
questions.D: $P^{-1}$ does not exist because det P = 0
questions.expl: The columns of P are the distinct unit vectors, so their dot products form I: $P^{T} P = I$ and $P^{-1} = P^{T} = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0\end{pmatrix}$. A single exchange matrix is its own inverse, but this cyclic P is not.

questions.text: Which statement about permutation matrices is TRUE?
questions.A: $P^{T} \cdot P = I$, so $P^{-1} = P^{T}$; also ||Px|| = ||x|| and $det P = \pm 1$
questions.B: det P = +1 for every permutation matrix
questions.D: There are $n^{2}$ permutation matrices of order n
questions.expl: A permutation rearranges the unit vectors, so $P^{T} P = I$, lengths are preserved (||Px|| = ||x||) and $det P = \pm 1$. A single row exchange already gives det = −1; $P^{T} = P$ holds only for exchange matrices; the number of permutations of n rows is n!, e.g. 6 matrices of order 3.

questions.text: How many $3 \times 3$ permutation matrices are there, and what are their determinants?
questions.A: 6 = 3! matrices: three with det = +1 (even) and three with det = −1 (odd)
questions.D: 3 matrices: the identity and two exchanges
questions.expl: Three rows can be permuted in 3! = 6 ways. Three permutations are even (I and the two cyclic ones, det +1) and three are odd (the single exchanges $P_{21}$, $P_{32}$, $P_{31}$, det −1).

questions.text: Which of the following sets is a vector space under the usual operations?
questions.A: The set of all $2 \times 2$ real matrices
questions.B: The set of all invertible $2 \times 2$ matrices
questions.C: The set of vectors in $\mathbb{R}^{2}$ with positive coordinates
questions.D: The set of all unit vectors (length 1) in $\mathbb{R}^{2}$
questions.expl: All $m \times n$ matrices form a vector space (zero matrix; closed under sums and scalar multiples). Invertible matrices fail: I + (−I) = 0 is not invertible. Vectors with positive coordinates fail under multiplication by −1; unit vectors fail under addition (the sum of two unit vectors has length up to 2).

Векторы с положительными координатами нарушают умножение на −1; единичные векторы — сложение (сумма двух единичных векторов имеет длину до 2).

Musbat koordinatali vektorlar −1 ga koʻpaytirishda, birlik vektorlar esa qoʻshishda buziladi (ikkita birlik vektor yigʻindisining uzunligi 2 gacha yetadi).

questions.text: Is S = {(x, y): y = 3x + 2} a subspace of $\mathbb{R}^{2}$?
questions.A: No — the zero vector fails the equation: $3 \cdot 0 + 2 = 2 \ne 0$, and every subspace must contain the origin
questions.B: Yes — every straight line in $\mathbb{R}^{2}$ is a subspace
questions.C: Yes — the set is closed under addition because the equation is linear
questions.D: No — because the equation y = 3x + 2 has no solutions at all
questions.expl: A subspace must contain the zero vector, but (0, 0) does not satisfy the equation: $3 \cdot 0 + 2 = 2 \ne 0$. A shifted line does not pass through the origin; the line y = 3x (no shift) would be a subspace.

questions.text: Is $W = \{(x, y): x \ge 0\} a$ subspace of $\mathbb{R}^{2}$?

questions.text: Is $\mathbb{R}^{2}$ a subspace of $\mathbb{R}^{3}$?

ru.text: Является ли $\mathbb{R}^{2}$ подпространством $\mathbb{R}^{3}$?

questions.text: Describe the column space C(A) of $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4 \\ 0 & 0\end{pmatrix}$.
questions.A: C(A) = span{(1, 2, 0)} — a line in $\mathbb{R}^{3}$, because column 2 is twice column 1
questions.B: C(A) = the whole plane z = 0 in $\mathbb{R}^{3}$
questions.expl: The columns (1, 2, 0) and (2, 4, 0) are proportional, so every combination is a multiple of (1, 2, 0): C(A) is a line. For instance $(3, 6, 0) = A \cdot \begin{pmatrix}3 \\ 0\end{pmatrix}$ lies in C(A), but (1, 2, 1) does not (its third coordinate is nonzero).

en.text: Describe the column space C(A) of $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4 \\ 0 & 0\end{pmatrix}$ .

options.A: C(A) = span{(1, 2, 0)} — a line in $\mathbb{R}^{3}$ , because column 2 is twice column 1
options.D: C(A) = the whole plane z = 0 in $\mathbb{R}^{3}$

ru.text: Опишите столбцовое пространство C(A) матрицы $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4 \\ 0 & 0\end{pmatrix}$.

options.A: C(A) = span{(1, 2, 0)} — прямая в $\mathbb{R}^{3}$, так как столбец 2 вдвое больше столбца 1

ru.explanation: Столбцы (1, 2, 0) и (2, 4, 0) пропорциональны, поэтому любая комбинация кратна (1, 2, 0): C(A) — прямая. Например, $(3, 6, 0) = A \cdot \begin{pmatrix}3 \\ 0\end{pmatrix}$ лежит в C(A), а (1, 2, 1) — нет (третья координата ненулевая).

uz.text: $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4 \\ 0 & 0\end{pmatrix}$ matritsaning ustunlar fazosi C(A) ni taʼriflang.

options.A: C(A) = span{(1, 2, 0)} — $\mathbb{R}^{3}$ dagi toʻgʻri chiziq, chunki 2-ustun 1-ustunning ikki barobari

questions.text: The system Ax = b has a solution if and only if:
questions.A: b lies in the column space C(A) — b is a combination of the columns of A
questions.B: b is a combination of the rows of A
questions.expl: $Ax = x_{1} \cdot a_{1}$ + ... + $x_{n} \cdot a_{n}$ produces exactly the combinations of the columns, so a solution exists precisely when b is in C(A). This is the master criterion for solvability: the system is solvable ⇔ b ∈ C(A).

en.text: The system Ax = b has a solution if and only if:

options.B: b is a combination of the rows of A

ru.text: Система Ax = b имеет решение тогда и только тогда, когда:

options.A: b лежит в столбцовом пространстве C(A) — b является комбинацией столбцов A

ru.explanation: $Ax = x_{1} \cdot a_{1}$ + ... + $x_{n} \cdot a_{n}$ порождает в точности комбинации столбцов, поэтому решение существует ровно тогда, когда b лежит в C(A). Это главный критерий разрешимости: система разрешима ⇔ b ∈ C(A).

questions.text: Which vector lies in the null space N(A) of $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 & -1\end{pmatrix}$?
questions.expl: N(A) consists of the solutions of $x_{1} + 2x_{2} - x_{3} = 0$. Testing (1, 0, 1): 1 + 0 − 1 = 0 — it works. The other candidates give 2, −1 and 2. In fact N(A) = span{(−2, 1, 0), (1, 0, 1)} — a plane in $\mathbb{R}^{3}$.

en.text: Which vector lies in the null space N(A) of $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 & -1\end{pmatrix}$ ?
en.explanation: N(A) consists of the solutions of $x_{1} + 2x_{2} - x_{3} = 0$ . Testing (1, 0, 1): 1 + 0 − 1 = 0 — it works. The other candidates give 2, −1 and 2. In fact N(A) = span{(−2, 1, 0), (1, 0, 1)} — a plane in $\mathbb{R}^{3}$ .

ru.text: Какой вектор лежит в нуль-пространстве N(A) матрицы $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 & -1\end{pmatrix}$?
ru.explanation: N(A) — решения уравнения $x_{1} + 2x_{2} - x_{3} = 0$. Проверка (1, 0, 1): 1 + 0 − 1 = 0 — подходит. Остальные кандидаты дают 2, −1 и 2. На самом деле N(A) = span{(−2, 1, 0), (1, 0, 1)} — плоскость в $\mathbb{R}^{3}$.

uz.text: Qaysi vektor $A = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 2 & -1\end{pmatrix}$ matritsaning nol-fazosida N(A) yotadi?
uz.explanation: N(A) — $x_{1} + 2x_{2} - x_{3} = 0$ tenglamasining yechimlari. (1, 0, 1) ni tekshiramiz: 1 + 0 − 1 = 0 — mos keladi. Qolgan nomzodlar 2, −1 va 2 beradi. Aslida N(A) = span{(−2, 1, 0), (1, 0, 1)} — $\mathbb{R}^{3}$ dagi tekislik.

questions.text: Ax = b is solvable and $x_{p}$ is one particular solution. The complete solution is:
questions.A: $x = x_{p} + x_{n}$, where $x_{n}$ is any vector of the null space N(A)
questions.B: $x = x_{p}$ alone — the solution is always unique
questions.C: $x = x_{p} + x_{n}$, where $x_{n}$ is any vector of the column space C(A)
questions.D: $x = b + x_{n}$, where $x_{n}$ is in N(A)
questions.expl: If x is any solution, then $A(x - x_{p}) = b - b = 0$, so $x - x_{p}$ is in N(A): every solution is $x_{p}$ plus a null-space vector. The null space is a subspace, but for $b \ne 0$ the solution set of Ax = b is its shifted copy and contains no zero vector.

uz.text: Har bir toʻplamni interval yozuvida yozing va uni haqiqiy toʻgʻri chiziqda tasvirlang: (1) {x ∈ $\mathbb{R}$ : $-3 \leq x < 4$}; (2) {x ∈ $\mathbb{R}$ : x $\neq$ 3}

options.A: (1) ($−3$, 4); −3 da boʻsh nuqta, 4 da toʻldirilgan nuqta (2) [$−∞$, 3) ∪ (3, $∞$]; 3 da toʻldirilgan nuqta
options.B: (1) [$−3$, 4); −3 da toʻldirilgan nuqta, 4 da boʻsh nuqta (2) ($−∞$, 3) ∪ (3, $∞$); 3 da boʻsh nuqta

options.D: (1) ($−3$, 4); −3 da boʻsh nuqta, 4 da boʻsh nuqta (2) ($−∞$, 3) ∪ (3, $∞$); 3 da boʻsh nuqta

questions.text: Write each interval using inequalities: a. [−2, 5); b. $(-\infty , 4]$; c. $(1, \infty )$
questions.expl: For [−2, 5), −2 is included and 5 is excluded, giving $-2 \le x < 5$. For $(-\infty , 4]$, the right endpoint is included, giving $x \le 4$. For $(1, \infty )$, the left endpoint is excluded, giving $x > 1$.

ru.text: Запишите каждый интервал с помощью неравенств: a. [−2, 5); b. $(-\infty , 4]$; c. $(1, \infty )$
ru.explanation: Для [−2, 5) число −2 включается, а 5 исключается, что даёт $-2 \le x < 5$. Для $(-\infty , 4]$ правый конец включается, что даёт $x \le 4$. Для $(1, \infty )$ левый конец исключается, что даёт $x > 1$.

uz.text: Har bir intervalni tengsizliklar yordamida yozing: a. [−2, 5); b. $(-\infty , 4]$; c. $(1, \infty )$
uz.explanation: [−2, 5) uchun −2 kiradi va 5 chiqib ketadi, natijada $-2 \le x < 5$ hosil boʻladi. $(-\infty , 4]$ uchun oʻng uch kiradi, natijada $x \le 4$ boʻladi. $(1, \infty )$ uchun chap uch chiqib ketadi, natijada $x > 1$ boʻladi.

questions.text: Classify as rational or irrational: a. √3; b. √25; c. √50; i. ($1 + √5$)($1 − √5$)
questions.A: a. rational; b. irrational; c. rational; i. rational
questions.B: a. irrational; b. irrational; c. rational; i. irrational
questions.C: a. rational; b. rational; c. irrational; i. irrational
questions.D: a. irrational; b. rational; c. irrational; i. rational
questions.expl: $√3$ is not a perfect square (irrational). $√25 = 5$ (rational). $√50 = 5√2$, and since $√2$ is irrational, $5√2$ is irrational. ($1 + √5$)($1 − √5$) = $1 - 5 = -4$ (rational).

ru.text: Классифицируйте как рациональное или иррациональное: a. √3; b. √25; c. √50; i. ($1 + √5$)($1 − √5$)

options.A: a. рациональное; b. иррациональное; c. рациональное; i. рациональное

options.D: a. иррациональное; b. рациональное; c. иррациональное; i. рациональное

ru.explanation: $√3$ не является точным квадратом (иррациональное). $√25 = 5$ (рациональное). $√50 = 5√2$, и поскольку $√2$ иррационально, $5√2$ также иррационально. ($1 + √5$)($1 − √5$) = $1 - 5 = -4$ (рациональное).

uz.text: Ratsional yoki irratsional deb tasniflang: a. √3; b. √25; c. √50; i. ($1 + √5$)($1 − √5$)

options.A: a. ratsional; b. irratsional; c. ratsional; i. ratsional

options.C: a. ratsional; b. ratsional; c. irratsional; i. irratsional
options.D: a. irratsional; b. ratsional; c. irratsional; i. ratsional

uz.explanation: $√3$ toʻliq kvadrat emas (irratsional). $√25 = 5$ (ratsional). $√50 = 5√2$, va $√2$ irratsional boʻlgani uchun $5√2$ ham irratsional. ($1 + √5$)($1 − √5$) = $1 - 5 = -4$ (ratsional).

questions.text: Given $z_{1} = 3 + 2i$ and $z_{2} = 1 - 4i$, calculate z1 + z2, z1 − z2, z1 z2, and $\frac{z_{1}}{z_{2}}$, writing every answer in the form a + bi.

ru.text: Даны $z_{1} = 3 + 2i$ и $z_{2} = 1 - 4i$; вычислите z1 + z2, z1 − z2, z1 z2 и $\frac{z_{1}}{z_{2}}$, записывая каждый ответ в виде a + bi.

uz.text: $z_{1} = 3 + 2i$ va $z_{2} = 1 - 4i$ berilgan; z1 + z2, z1 − z2, z1 z2 va $\frac{z_{1}}{z_{2}}$ ni hisoblang, har bir javobni a + bi koʻrinishida yozing.

questions.text: For each number 3 + 4i, −2 + 5i, 6i, −7, find its conjugate and modulus; verify z$\overline{z}$ = |z|$^{2}$.
questions.A: 3 + 4i: conjugate=3−4i, modulus=$\sqrt{5}$; −2 + 5i: conjugate=−2−5i, modulus=$\sqrt{29}$; 6i: conjugate=−6i, modulus=6; −7: conjugate=−7, modulus=7
questions.B: 3 + 4i: conjugate=3−4i, modulus=5; −2 + 5i: conjugate=−2−5i, modulus=$\sqrt{29}$; 6i: conjugate=−6i, modulus=6; −7: conjugate=−7, modulus=7
questions.C: 3 + 4i: conjugate=3+4i, modulus=5; −2 + 5i: conjugate=−2+5i, modulus=$\sqrt{29}$; 6i: conjugate=6i, modulus=6; −7: conjugate=7, modulus=7
questions.D: 3 + 4i: conjugate=3−4i, modulus=5; −2 + 5i: conjugate=−2−5i, modulus=$\sqrt{29}$; 6i: conjugate=6i, modulus=6; −7: conjugate=−7, modulus=7
questions.expl: For z=a+bi, the conjugate is a−bi and the modulus is $\sqrt{a^{2}+b^{2}}$. The verification z$\overline{z}$=|z|$^{2}$ holds for all cases: (3−4i)(3+4i)=25=5$^{2}$, (−2−5i)(−2+5i)=29=$\sqrt{29}^{2}$, (−6i)(6i)=36=6$^{2}$, and (−7)(−7)=49=7$^{2}$.

ru.text: Для каждого числа 3 + 4i, −2 + 5i, 6i, −7 найдите его сопряжённое и модуль; проверьте, что z$\overline{z}$ = |z|$^{2}$.

options.A: 3 + 4i: сопряжённое=3−4i, модуль=$\sqrt{5}$; −2 + 5i: сопряжённое=−2−5i, модуль=$\sqrt{29}$; 6i: сопряжённое=−6i, модуль=6; −7: сопряжённое=−7, модуль=7
options.B: 3 + 4i: сопряжённое=3−4i, модуль=5; −2 + 5i: сопряжённое=−2−5i, модуль=$\sqrt{29}$; 6i: сопряжённое=−6i, модуль=6; −7: сопряжённое=−7, модуль=7
options.C: 3 + 4i: сопряжённое=3+4i, модуль=5; −2 + 5i: сопряжённое=−2+5i, модуль=$\sqrt{29}$; 6i: сопряжённое=6i, модуль=6; −7: сопряжённое=7, модуль=7

options.A: 3 + 4i: qoʻshma=3−4i, modul=$\sqrt{5}$; −2 + 5i: qoʻshma=−2−5i, modul=$\sqrt{29}$; 6i: qoʻshma=−6i, modul=6; −7: qoʻshma=−7, modul=7

questions.text: Express ($1−i$)/($1+i$) in the form a + bi.
questions.expl: Multiply numerator and denominator by the conjugate of the denominator: ($1−i$)²/(($1+i$)($1−i$)) = ($1−2i+i^{2}$)/($1−i^{2}$) = ($1−2i−1$)/($1−(−1)$) = (−2i)/2 = −i = 0 − i, which simplifies to 1/2 − 1/2 i.

ru.text: Представьте ($1−i$)/($1+i$) в виде a + bi.
ru.explanation: Умножим числитель и знаменатель на сопряжённое знаменателю: ($1−i$)²/(($1+i$)($1−i$)) = ($1−2i+i^{2}$)/($1−i^{2}$) = ($1−2i−1$)/($1−(−1)$) = (−2i)/2 = −i = 0 − i, что упрощается к 1/2 − 1/2 i.

uz.text: ($1−i$)/($1+i$) sonini a + bi koʻrinishida yozing.

questions.text: Solve over ℂ: $x^{2}$ + $9$ = $0$.
questions.expl: Rearranging gives $x^{2}$ = −$9$, so x = ±√(−$9$) = ±$3i$. Both solutions are non-real complex numbers.

ru.text: Решите над ℂ: $x^{2}$ + $9$ = $0$.
ru.explanation: Перенося слагаемые, получаем $x^{2}$ = −$9$, поэтому x = ±√(−$9$) = ±$3i$. Оба решения — не действительные комплексные числа.

uz.text: ℂ ustida yeching: $x^{2}$ + $9$ = $0$.
uz.explanation: Hadlarni qayta joylashtirsak, $x^{2}$ = −$9$ boʻladi, demak x = ±√(−$9$) = ±$3i$. Ikkala yechim ham haqiqiy boʻlmagan kompleks sonlar.

questions.text: For $z = 2 + 3i$ in the complex plane, determine its real part, imaginary part, modulus and quadrant. What changes for 2 − 3i?
questions.expl: For $z = 2 + 3i$, $Re(z) = 2$, $Im(z) = 3$, |$z| = \sqrt{2}^{2} + 3^{2}) =$ √13, and it's in the first quadrant. For 2 − 3i, the real part and modulus remain the same, the imaginary part changes sign, and it moves to the fourth quadrant.

ru.text: Для $z = 2 + 3i$ на комплексной плоскости определите действительную часть, мнимую часть, модуль и четверть. Что меняется для 2 − 3i?
ru.explanation: Для $z = 2 + 3i$: $Re(z) = 2$, $Im(z) = 3$, |$z| = \sqrt{2}^{2} + 3^{2}) =$ √13, и она находится в первой четверти. Для 2 − 3i действительная часть и модуль остаются прежними, мнимая часть меняет знак, и точка переходит в четвертую четверть.

uz.text: Kompleks tekislikda $z = 2 + 3i$ uchun haqiqiy qismni, mavhum qismni, modulni va chorakni aniqlang. 2 − 3i uchun nima oʻzgaradi?
uz.explanation: $z = 2 + 3i$ uchun $Re(z) = 2$, $Im(z) = 3$, |$z| = \sqrt{2}^{2} + 3^{2}) =$ √13 va u birinchi chorakda joylashgan. 2 − 3i uchun haqiqiy qism va modul oʻzgarmaydi, mavhum qism ishorasini oʻzgartiradi va nuqta toʻrtinchi chorakka oʻtadi.

questions.text: Write $1 + i$ in trigonometric form $z = r(\cos \theta + i \sin \theta)$ and exponential form $z = re^{i\theta}$, with $\theta$ in radians.
questions.expl: The modulus $r = |1 + i| = \sqrt{1^2 + 1^2} = \sqrt{2}$, and $\theta = \arctan(1/1) = \pi/4$. Therefore, $1 + i = \sqrt{2}(\cos(\pi/4) + i \sin(\pi/4)) = \sqrt{2}e^{i\pi/4}$.

ru.text: Запишите $1 + i$ в тригонометрической форме $z = r(\cos \theta + i \sin \theta)$ и показательной форме $z = re^{i\theta}$, где $\theta$ в радианах.
ru.explanation: Модуль $r = |1 + i| = \sqrt{1^2 + 1^2} = \sqrt{2}$, а $\theta = \arctan(1/1) = \pi/4$. Следовательно, $1 + i = \sqrt{2}(\cos(\pi/4) + i \sin(\pi/4)) = \sqrt{2}e^{i\pi/4}$.

uz.text: $1 + i$ sonini $z = r(\cos \theta + i \sin \theta)$ trigonometrik koʻrinishda va $z = re^{i\theta}$ eksponensial koʻrinishda yozing, bunda $\theta$ radianlarda.
uz.explanation: Modul $r = |1 + i| = \sqrt{1^2 + 1^2} = \sqrt{2}$, va $\theta = \arctan(1/1) = \pi/4$. Demak, $1 + i = \sqrt{2}(\cos(\pi/4) + i \sin(\pi/4)) = \sqrt{2}e^{i\pi/4}$.

questions.text: Use de Moivre's formula [$r(\cos \theta + i \sin \theta)$]^n = $r^n(\cos n\theta + i \sin n\theta)$ to calculate ($\sqrt{3} + i$)^4; check by algebra.
questions.expl: First convert to polar form: r = |$\sqrt{3} + i$| = $\sqrt{3 + 1}$ = 2, θ = arctan(1/$\sqrt{3}$) = $\frac{π}{6}$. By de Moivre, ($\sqrt{3} + i$)^4 = $2^4(\cos(4π/6) + i \sin(4π/6))$ = 16($\cos(2π/3) + i \sin(2π/3)$) = 16($-\frac{1}{2} + i\frac{√3}{2}$) = -8 + 8√3 i. Algebraic expansion confirms this result.

ru.text: Используя формулу Муавра [$r(\cos \theta + i \sin \theta)$]^n = $r^n(\cos n\theta + i \sin n\theta)$, вычислите ($\sqrt{3} + i$)^4; проверьте алгебраически.
ru.explanation: Сначала перейдем в полярную форму: r = |$\sqrt{3} + i$| = $\sqrt{3 + 1}$ = 2, θ = arctan(1/$\sqrt{3}$) = $\frac{π}{6}$. По формуле Муавра ($\sqrt{3} + i$)^4 = $2^4(\cos(4π/6) + i \sin(4π/6))$ = 16($\cos(2π/3) + i \sin(2π/3)$) = 16($-\frac{1}{2} + i\frac{√3}{2}$) = -8 + 8√3 i. Алгебраическое раскрытие скобок подтверждает этот результат.

uz.text: Muavr formulasidan [$r(\cos \theta + i \sin \theta)$]^n = $r^n(\cos n\theta + i \sin n\theta)$ foydalanib ($\sqrt{3} + i$)^4 ni hisoblang; algebraik tekshiring.
uz.explanation: Avval polyar koʻrinishga oʻtamiz: r = |$\sqrt{3} + i$| = $\sqrt{3 + 1}$ = 2, θ = arctan(1/$\sqrt{3}$) = $\frac{π}{6}$. Muavr formulasi boʻyicha ($\sqrt{3} + i$)^4 = $2^4(\cos(4π/6) + i \sin(4π/6))$ = 16($\cos(2π/3) + i \sin(2π/3)$) = 16($-\frac{1}{2} + i\frac{√3}{2}$) = -8 + 8√3 i. Algebraik yoyish natijani tasdiqlaydi.

questions.text: Find all solutions of $z^3 = -8$ and represent them in the complex plane.
questions.expl: Write $-8 = 8e^{i(\pi+2k\pi)}$. The cube roots have modulus $8^{1/3} = 2$ and arguments $(\pi+2k\pi)/3$ for $k = 0, 1, 2$: $z_0 = 2e^{i\pi/3} = 1 + \sqrt{3}i$, $z_1 = 2e^{i\pi} = -2$, $z_2 = 2e^{i5\pi/3} = 1 - \sqrt{3}i$. These are equally spaced points on a circle of radius 2.

ru.text: Найдите все решения уравнения $z^3 = -8$ и изобразите их на комплексной плоскости.
ru.explanation: Запишем $-8 = 8e^{i(\pi+2k\pi)}$. Кубические корни имеют модуль $8^{1/3} = 2$ и аргументы $(\pi+2k\pi)/3$ при $k = 0, 1, 2$: $z_0 = 2e^{i\pi/3} = 1 + \sqrt{3}i$, $z_1 = 2e^{i\pi} = -2$, $z_2 = 2e^{i5\pi/3} = 1 - \sqrt{3}i$. Это равномерно расположенные точки на окружности радиуса 2.

uz.text: $z^3 = -8$ tenglamaning barcha yechimlarini toping va ularni kompleks tekislikda tasvirlang.
uz.explanation: $-8 = 8e^{i(\pi+2k\pi)}$ deb yozamiz. Kub ildizlar moduli $8^{1/3} = 2$ va argumentlari $(\pi+2k\pi)/3$ ($k = 0, 1, 2$ uchun): $z_0 = 2e^{i\pi/3} = 1 + \sqrt{3}i$, $z_1 = 2e^{i\pi} = -2$, $z_2 = 2e^{i5\pi/3} = 1 - \sqrt{3}i$. Bular radiusi 2 boʻlgan aylanada tekis joylashgan nuqtalardir.

questions.text: For each number, identify the smallest set among $\mathbb{N}$, $\mathbb{Z}$, $\mathbb{Q}$, $\mathbb{R}$, $\mathbb{C}$ to which it belongs: $0$, $-7$, $\frac{8}{5}$, $3.25$, $16$, $7$, $\sqrt{-9}$, $\pi$, $\pi^{2}$, $i$, $4-3i$.
questions.E: $0\in\mathbb{N}$, $-7\in\mathbb{Z}$, $\frac{8}{5}\in\mathbb{Q}$, $3.25\in\mathbb{Q}$, $16\in\mathbb{N}$, $7\in\mathbb{R}$, $\sqrt{-9}\in\mathbb{Z}$, $\pi\in\mathbb{R}$, $\pi^{2}\in\mathbb{R}$, $i\in\mathbb{C}$, $4-3i\in\mathbb{C}$
questions.expl: 0 is a natural number, $-7$ and $\sqrt{-9}=-3$ are integers, $\frac{8}{5}$ and $3.25$ are rationals, $7$ and $\pi$ are irrationals, while $i$ and $4-3i$ are complex numbers.

ru.text: Для каждого числа укажите наименьшее множество среди $\mathbb{N}$, $\mathbb{Z}$, $\mathbb{Q}$, $\mathbb{R}$, $\mathbb{C}$, которому оно принадлежит: $0$, $-7$, $\frac{8}{5}$, $3.25$, $16$, $7$, $\sqrt{-9}$, $\pi$, $\pi^{2}$, $i$, $4-3i$.
ru.explanation: 0 — натуральное число, $-7$ и $\sqrt{-9}=-3$ — целые, $\frac{8}{5}$ и $3.25$ — рациональные, $7$ и $\pi$ — иррациональные, а $i$ и $4-3i$ — комплексные числа.

uz.text: Har bir son uchun u tegishli boʻlgan eng kichik toʻplamni $\mathbb{N}$, $\mathbb{Z}$, $\mathbb{Q}$, $\mathbb{R}$, $\mathbb{C}$ orasidan aniqlang: $0$, $-7$, $\frac{8}{5}$, $3.25$, $16$, $7$, $\sqrt{-9}$, $\pi$, $\pi^{2}$, $i$, $4-3i$.
uz.explanation: 0 — natural son, $-7$ va $\sqrt{-9}=-3$ — butun sonlar, $\frac{8}{5}$ va $3.25$ — ratsional sonlar, $7$ va $\pi$ — irratsional sonlar, $i$ va $4-3i$ esa kompleks sonlar.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about number sets are true? (1) N ⊆ Z; (2) Z ⊆ Q; (3) R ⊆ Q; (4) Q ⊆ R; (5) R ⊆ C; (6) every integer is natural; (7) every rational is real; (8) every complex number is real; (9) every real number can be written as a complex number; (10) a number cannot be both rational and real.
questions.B: Statements (1), (2), (4), (5), (7), (9) are true, and (3), (6), (8), (10) are false
questions.expl: Statements (1), (2), (4), (5), (7), (9) are correct set inclusions or properties. Statement (3) is false because R includes irrational numbers like $\sqrt{2}$; (6) is false because negative integers aren't natural; (8) is false because complex numbers like $i$ aren't real; and (10) is false because all rational numbers are also real numbers.

ru.text: Какие из следующих утверждений о числовых множествах верны? (1) N ⊆ Z; (2) Z ⊆ Q; (3) R ⊆ Q; (4) Q ⊆ R; (5) R ⊆ C; (6) всякое целое число натурально; (7) всякое рациональное число действительно; (8) всякое комплексное число действительно; (9) всякое действительное число можно записать как комплексное; (10) число не может быть одновременно рациональным и действительным.
ru.explanation: Утверждения (1), (2), (4), (5), (7), (9) — верные включения множеств или свойства. Утверждение (3) неверно, так как R содержит иррациональные числа вроде $\sqrt{2}$; (6) неверно, поскольку отрицательные целые не натуральны; (8) неверно, так как комплексные числа вроде $i$ не действительны; и (10) неверно, потому что все рациональные числа также являются действительными.

uz.text: Son toʻplamlarga oid quyidagi tasdiqlardan qaysilari toʻgʻri? (3) tasdiq notoʻgʻri, chunki R tarkibida $\sqrt{2}$ kabi irratsional sonlar bor; (6) notoʻgʻri, chunki manfiy butun sonlar natural emas; (8) notoʻgʻri, chunki $i$ kabi kompleks sonlar haqiqiy emas; (10) esa shuning uchun notoʻgʻri ki, barcha ratsional sonlar ayni paytda haqiqiy sonlardir.

questions.text: Consider the nested sets $N \subset \mathbb{Z} \subset \mathbb{Q} \subset \mathbb{R} \subset \mathbb{C}$. Which of the following placements is correct?
questions.expl: 5 is a natural number ($N$); −2 is an integer but not natural ($Z \ \ N$); 2/3 is rational but not integer ($Q \ \ Z$); 2 and π are real but not rational ($R \ \ Q$); −4i and 3+2i are complex but not real ($C \ \ R$).

ru.text: Рассмотрим вложенные множества $N \subset \mathbb{Z} \subset \mathbb{Q} \subset \mathbb{R} \subset \mathbb{C}$. Какое из следующих размещений верно?
ru.explanation: 5 — натуральное число ($N$); −2 — целое, но не натуральное ($Z \ \ N$); 2/3 — рациональное, но не целое ($Q \ \ Z$); 2 и π — действительные, но не рациональные ($R \ \ Q$); −4i и 3+2i — комплексные, но не действительные ($C \ \ R$).

uz.text: $N \subset \mathbb{Z} \subset \mathbb{Q} \subset \mathbb{R} \subset \mathbb{C}$ ichma-ich toʻplamlarni koʻrib chiqing. Quyidagi joylashtirishlardan qaysi biri toʻgʻri?
uz.explanation: 5 — natural son ($N$); −2 — butun son, lekin natural emas ($Z \ \ N$); 2/3 — ratsional, lekin butun emas ($Q \ \ Z$); 2 va π — haqiqiy, lekin ratsional emas ($R \ \ Q$); −4i va 3+2i — kompleks, lekin haqiqiy emas ($C \ \ R$).

questions.text: Arrange the following numbers in increasing order: $-5$, $-2$, $-\sqrt{3}$, $0$, $2$, $\sqrt{3}$, $\pi^{2}$
questions.expl: Negative numbers are ordered by their absolute values in reverse. For positive numbers, squaring gives $\sqrt{2}^{2} = 2 < (\sqrt{3})^{2} = 3 < \pi^{2} \approx 9.87$.

ru.text: Расположите следующие числа в порядке возрастания: $-5$, $-2$, $-\sqrt{3}$, $0$, $2$, $\sqrt{3}$, $\pi^{2}$
ru.explanation: Отрицательные числа упорядочиваются по абсолютным величинам в обратном порядке. Для положительных чисел возведение в квадрат дает $\sqrt{2}^{2} = 2 < (\sqrt{3})^{2} = 3 < \pi^{2} \approx 9.87$.

uz.text: Quyidagi sonlarni oʻsish tartibida joylashtiring: $-5$, $-2$, $-\sqrt{3}$, $0$, $2$, $\sqrt{3}$, $\pi^{2}$
uz.explanation: Manfiy sonlar absolut qiymatlari boʻyicha teskari tartibda joylashadi. Musbat sonlar uchun kvadratga koʻtarish $\sqrt{2}^{2} = 2 < (\sqrt{3})^{2} = 3 < \pi^{2} \approx 9.87$ ni beradi.

questions.text: Let $u = (-1, -2)$ and $v = (-3, 5)$. Calculate u + v, u - v, 2u, -3v, and 2u - 3v.

questions.text: Given $a = (2, -1, 4)$ and $b = (3, 2, -2)$, find a + b, a - b, and 3a + 2b.

ru.text: Дано $a = (2, -1, 4)$ и $b = (3, 2, -2)$. Найдите a + b, a - b и 3a + 2b.

uz.text: $a = (2, -1, 4)$ va $b = (3, 2, -2)$ berilgan. a + b, a - b va 3a + 2b ni toping.

questions.expl: Subtract componentwise: $x = (7-2, 3-(-4), -2-1) = (5, 7, -3)$.

uz.text: Agar $x + (2, -4, 1) = (7, 3, -2)$ boʻlsa, x ni toping.

uz.text: Agar $3x - 2u = v$, bunda $u = (2, 2)$ va $v = (4, 2)$ boʻlsa, x ni toping.

questions.text: Calculate the Euclidean length of $u = (3, 4)$, $v = (-3, 0)$, and $w = (0, 0, 0)$.
questions.expl: kuk = $\sqrt{3^2 + 4^2} = \sqrt{25} = 5$, kvk = $\sqrt{(-3)^2 + 0^2} = \sqrt{9} = 3$, and kwk = 0 since it's the zero vector.

ru.text: Вычислите евклидову длину $u = (3, 4)$, $v = (-3, 0)$ и $w = (0, 0, 0)$.
ru.explanation: kuk = $\sqrt{3^2 + 4^2} = \sqrt{25} = 5$, kvk = $\sqrt{(-3)^2 + 0^2} = \sqrt{9} = 3$, а kwk = 0, так как это нулевой вектор.

uz.text: $u = (3, 4)$, $v = (-3, 0)$ va $w = (0, 0, 0)$ vektorlarning evklid uzunligini hisoblang.
