ru.explanation: f непрерывна всюду; f(0) = 0 − cos 0 = −1 < 0 и $f( \frac{\pi}{2}) = \frac{\pi}{2} - 0 = \frac{\pi}{2} > 0$. Так как $f(0) \cdot f( \frac{\pi}{2}) < 0$, по IVT найдётся ноль c ∈ $(0, \frac{\pi}{2})$.

uz.text: f(x) = x − cos x funksiyasining kamida bitta noli borligini koʻrsatish uchun qaysi oraliq va qaysi teorema ishlatiladi?

options.A: [0, $\frac{\pi}{2}$] va oraliq qiymat teoremasi: f(0) = −1 < 0 va $f( \frac{\pi}{2}) = \frac{\pi}{2} > 0$

uz.explanation: f hamma joyda uzluksiz; f(0) = 0 − cos 0 = −1 < 0 va $f( \frac{\pi}{2}) = \frac{\pi}{2} - 0 = \frac{\pi}{2} > 0$. $f(0) \cdot f( \frac{\pi}{2}) < 0$ boʻlgani uchun IVT boʻyicha c ∈ $(0, \frac{\pi}{2})$ nol mavjud.

questions.text: For $f(x) = \frac{1}{x}$ we have f(−1) = −1 < 0 and f(1) = 1 > 0. Can we conclude that f has a zero on [−1, 1]?
questions.A: No: f is not continuous on [−1, 1] (infinite discontinuity at x = 0), so the IVT does not apply
questions.B: Yes: whenever the endpoint values have different signs, there is a zero
questions.D: No: because [−1, 1] is not a closed interval
questions.expl: The IVT requires continuity on the whole interval. $f(x) = \frac{1}{x}$ has an infinite discontinuity at x = 0 (it is undefined there), so the theorem does not apply — and indeed $\frac{1}{x}$ is never 0.

en.text: For $f(x) = \frac{1}{x}$ we have f(−1) = −1 < 0 and f(1) = 1 > 0. Can we conclude that f has a zero on [−1, 1]?

options.A: No: because [−1, 1] is not a closed interval
options.B: No: f is not continuous on [−1, 1] (infinite discontinuity at x = 0), so the IVT does not apply
options.C: Yes: whenever the endpoint values have different signs, there is a zero

en.explanation: The IVT requires continuity on the whole interval. $f(x) = \frac{1}{x}$ has an infinite discontinuity at x = 0 (it is undefined there), so the theorem does not apply — and indeed $\frac{1}{x}$ is never 0.

ru.text: Для $f(x) = \frac{1}{x}$ имеем f(−1) = −1 < 0 и f(1) = 1 > 0. Можно ли заключить, что f имеет ноль на [−1, 1]?

options.A: Нет: f не непрерывна на [−1, 1] (бесконечный разрыв в нуле), поэтому IVT неприменима
options.B: Да: если значения на концах разных знаков, ноль обязательно есть
options.D: Нет: потому что [−1, 1] — не замкнутый интервал

ru.explanation: IVT требует непрерывности на всём интервале. $f(x) = \frac{1}{x}$ имеет бесконечный разрыв в точке x = 0 (там она не определена), поэтому теорема неприменима — и действительно, $\frac{1}{x}$ никогда не равна 0.

uz.text: $f(x) = \frac{1}{x}$ uchun f(−1) = −1 < 0 va f(1) = 1 > 0. f ning [−1, 1] da noli bor degan xulosa chiqarish mumkinmi?

options.A: Yoʻq: f [−1, 1] da uzluksiz emas (x = 0 da cheksiz uzilish), shuning uchun IVT qoʻllanmaydi
options.B: Ha: chegaradagi qiymatlar ishorasi farq qilsa, nol albatta bor

uz.explanation: IVT butun oraliqda uzluksizlikni talab qiladi. $f(x) = \frac{1}{x}$ funksiyasi x = 0 da cheksiz uzilishga ega (u yerda aniqlanmagan), shuning uchun teorema qoʻllanmaydi — va haqiqatdan ham $\frac{1}{x}$ hech qachon 0 ga teng emas.

questions.text: What does the Extreme Value Theorem (Weierstrass' theorem) state?
questions.A: If f is continuous on a closed bounded interval [a, b], then f attains its absolute maximum and minimum on [a, b]
questions.B: If f is continuous on [a, b], then f takes every value between f(a) and f(b)
questions.C: If f is differentiable on (a, b), then f′ = 0 at an interior maximum point
questions.D: A function continuous on all of R always has a maximum
questions.expl: Weierstrass' theorem guarantees that a continuous function on a closed bounded interval actually attains (reaches) its absolute maximum and minimum there. The statement about intermediate values is the IVT, not the EVT.

en.text: What does the Extreme Value Theorem (Weierstrass' theorem) state?

options.A: A function continuous on all of R always has a maximum
options.B: If f is continuous on [a, b], then f takes every value between f(a) and f(b)
options.C: If f is continuous on a closed bounded interval [a, b], then f attains its absolute maximum and minimum on [a, b]
options.D: If f is differentiable on (a, b), then f′ = 0 at an interior maximum point

en.explanation: Weierstrass' theorem guarantees that a continuous function on a closed bounded interval actually attains (reaches) its absolute maximum and minimum there. The statement about intermediate values is the IVT, not the EVT.

ru.text: Что утверждает теорема Вейерштрасса (о экстремальных значениях)?

options.A: Если f непрерывна на замкнутом ограниченном интервале [a, b], то f достигает абсолютных максимума и минимума на [a, b]
options.B: Если f непрерывна на [a, b], то f принимает каждое значение между f(a) и f(b)
options.C: Если f дифференцируема на (a, b), то f′ = 0 во внутренней точке максимума
options.D: Функция, непрерывная на всей R, всегда имеет максимум

ru.explanation: Теорема Вейерштрасса гарантирует, что непрерывная на замкнутом ограниченном интервале функция фактически достигает своих абсолютных максимума и минимума на этом интервале. Утверждение о промежуточных значениях — это IVT, а не теорема Вейерштрасса.

uz.text: Weierstrass teoremasi (ekstremal qiymatlar teoremasi) nimani aytadi?

options.A: Agar f yopiq chekli [a, b] oraliqda uzluksiz boʻlsa, f [a, b] da absolyut maksimum va minimumiga erishadi
options.B: Agar f [a, b] da uzluksiz boʻlsa, f f(a) va f(b) orasidagi har qanday qiymatni qabul qiladi
options.C: Agar f (a, b) da differensiallansa, ichki maksimum nuqtada f′ = 0
options.D: Butun R da uzluksiz funksiya har doim maksimumga ega

uz.explanation: Weierstrass teoremasi yopiq chekli oraliqda uzluksiz funksiya oʻz absolyut maksimum va minimumiga haqiqatan erishishini kafolatlaydi. Oraliq qiymatlar haqidagi bayonot — bu IVT, Weierstrass teoremasi emas.

questions.text: Consider f(x) = x on the open interval (0, 1). Why does the Extreme Value Theorem not guarantee a maximum or a minimum here?
questions.A: The interval is not closed: f approaches 0 and 1 but never attains them
questions.D: The theorem actually does guarantee a maximum on (0, 1)
questions.expl: f is continuous and the interval is bounded, but (0, 1) is open. The function gets arbitrarily close to 0 and 1 without reaching them, so no absolute maximum or minimum exists — both hypotheses of the theorem must hold.

en.text: Consider f(x) = x on the open interval (0, 1). Why does the Extreme Value Theorem not guarantee a maximum or a minimum here?

options.B: The theorem actually does guarantee a maximum on (0, 1)
options.C: The interval is not closed: f approaches 0 and 1 but never attains them

en.explanation: f is continuous and the interval is bounded, but (0, 1) is open. The function gets arbitrarily close to 0 and 1 without reaching them, so no absolute maximum or minimum exists — both hypotheses of the theorem must hold.

ru.text: Рассмотрим f(x) = x на открытом интервале (0, 1). Почему теорема Вейерштрасса здесь не гарантирует ни максимума, ни минимума?

options.A: Интервал не замкнут: f приближается к 0 и 1, но не достигает их
options.D: Теорема на самом деле гарантирует максимум на (0, 1)

ru.explanation: f непрерывна и интервал ограничен, но (0, 1) открыт. Функция сколь угодно близко подходит к 0 и 1, не достигая их, поэтому абсолютных экстремумов нет — должны выполняться оба условия теоремы.

uz.text: f(x) = x funksiyasini ochiq (0, 1) oraliqda qaraymiz. Nega Weierstrass teoremasi bu yerda maksimum yoki minimumni kafolatlamaydi?

options.A: Oraliq yopiq emas: f 0 va 1 ga yaqinlashadi, lekin ularga erishmaydi

uz.explanation: f uzluksiz va oraliq chekli, lekin (0, 1) ochiq. Funksiya 0 va 1 ga ixtiyoriy darajada yaqin boradi, lekin erishmaydi, shuning uchun absolyut ekstremumlar yoʻq — teoremaning ikkala sharti bajarilishi kerak.

questions.text: A protection controller outputs $u(T) = \begin{cases}T, & \text{if } 0 \le T < 100 \\ 0, & \text{if } T = 100\end{cases}$ on [0, 100]. Does u attain an absolute maximum?
questions.A: No: u is discontinuous at $T = 100 (\lim_{T \to 100^-} u(T) = 100 \ne 0 = u(100))$, so the EVT does not apply
questions.B: Yes: by the EVT, since [0, 100] is closed and bounded
questions.D: No: because the domain is unbounded
questions.expl: The domain is closed and bounded, but u is discontinuous at T = 100: the values approach 100 yet never equal it. One hypothesis of the EVT fails, so no maximum is guaranteed — and indeed none is attained.

en.text: A protection controller outputs $u(T) = \begin{cases}T, & \text{if } 0 \le T < 100 \\ 0, & \text{if } T = 100\end{cases}$ on [0, 100]. Does u attain an absolute maximum?

options.A: No: because the domain is unbounded
options.B: No: u is discontinuous at $T = 100 (\lim_{T \to 100^-} u(T) = 100 \ne 0 = u(100))$ , so the EVT does not apply
options.D: Yes: by the EVT, since [0, 100] is closed and bounded

en.explanation: The domain is closed and bounded, but u is discontinuous at T = 100: the values approach 100 yet never equal it. One hypothesis of the EVT fails, so no maximum is guaranteed — and indeed none is attained.

ru.text: Контроллер защиты имеет выход $u(T) = \begin{cases}T, & \text{если } 0 \le T < 100 \\ 0, & \text{если } T = 100\end{cases}$ на [0, 100]. Достигает ли u абсолютного максимума?

options.A: Нет: u разрывна при $T = 100 (\lim_{T \to 100^-} u(T) = 100 \ne 0 = u(100))$, поэтому теорема Вейерштрасса неприменима
options.B: Да: по теореме Вейерштрасса, так как [0, 100] замкнут и ограничен
options.D: Нет: потому что область определения не ограничена

ru.explanation: Область определения замкнута и ограничена, но u разрывна в точке T = 100: значения приближаются к 100, никогда не достигая её. Одно из условий теоремы нарушено, поэтому максимум не гарантируется — и действительно не достигается.

uz.text: Himoya boshqaruvchisi [0, 100] $da u(T) = \begin{cases}T, & \text{agar } 0 \le T < 100 \\ 0, & \text{agar } T = 100\end{cases}$ chiqishiga ega. u absolyut maksimumga erishadimi?

options.A: Yoʻq: u T = 100 da uzluksiz emas $(\lim_{T \to 100^-} u(T) = 100 \ne 0 = u(100))$, shuning uchun Weierstrass teoremasi qoʻllanmaydi
options.B: Ha: [0, 100] yopiq va chekli boʻlgani uchun Weierstrass teoremasi boʻyicha

uz.explanation: Taʼrif sohasi yopiq va chekli, lekin u T = 100 da uzluksiz emas: qiymatlar 100 ga yaqinlashadi, lekin hech qachon unga teng boʻlmaydi. Teoremaning bir sharti buzilgan, shuning uchun maksimum kafolatlanmaydi — va haqiqatan ham erishilmaydi.

questions.text: Find the inverse of f(x) = 3x + 2.
questions.expl: Solve y = 3x + 2 for x: $x = \frac{(y - 2)}{3}$. Note that $f^{-1}$ does not mean $\frac{1}{f}$ — the notation $f^{-1}$ never denotes the reciprocal.

questions.text: An actuator displacement is $x(V) = 0.5 \cdot V + 2$ for $0 \le V \le 10$. Find the inverse function V(x) and its domain.
questions.expl: Solving $x = 0.5 \cdot V + 2$ for V gives V = 2(x − 2) = 2x − 4. The range of x is [x(0), x(10)] = [2, 7], and it becomes the domain of the inverse.

uz.text: Aktuatorning siljishi $x(V) = 0.5 \cdot V + 2$, $0 \le V \le 10$. Teskari V(x) funksiyasini va uning taʼrif sohasini toping.

questions.text: A thermistor is modeled by $R(T) = 100 \cdot e^(-0.02 \cdot T)$ for $T \ge 0 (R$ in kΩ, T in $^{\circ}C$). Find the inverse T(R) and the temperature when R = 40 kΩ.
questions.A: $T(R) = -50 \cdot \ln (\frac{R}{100})$; at R = 40 the temperature is about $45.8^{\circ}C$
questions.B: $T(R) = 50 \cdot \ln (\frac{R}{100})$; at R = 40 the temperature is about $-45.8^{\circ}C$
questions.C: $T(R) = -50 \cdot \ln (\frac{100}{R})$; at R = 40 the temperature is about $-45.8^{\circ}C$
questions.D: $T(R) = -0.02 \cdot \ln (\frac{R}{100})$; at R = 40 the temperature is about $0.02^{\circ}C$
questions.expl: From $R = 100 \cdot e^(-0.02 \cdot T)$: $\frac{R}{100} = e^(-0.02 \cdot T)$, so $\ln (\frac{R}{100}) = -0.02 \cdot T$ and $T = -50 \cdot \ln (\frac{R}{100})$. At R = 40: $T = -50 \cdot \ln (0.4) \approx 45.8^{\circ}C$.

questions.text: The derivative of a function f at a point a is defined as:
questions.expl: The derivative is the limit of the difference quotient (the slope of the secant line) as $h \to 0$; when the limit exists, it is the slope of the tangent line at the point (a, f(a)).

en.text: The derivative of a function f at a point a is defined as:
en.explanation: The derivative is the limit of the difference quotient (the slope of the secant line) as $h \to 0$ ; when the limit exists, it is the slope of the tangent line at the point (a, f(a)).

ru.text: Производная функции f в точке a определяется как:
ru.explanation: Производная — это предел разностного отношения (наклона секущей) при $h \to 0$; когда предел существует, он равен наклону касательной в точке (a, f(a)).

uz.text: f funksiyaning a nuqtadagi hosilasi quyidagicha taʼriflanadi:

questions.text: Using the definition of the derivative, find f′(2) for $f(x) = x^{2} + 3x$.
questions.A: 7 — the slope of the tangent at the point (2, 10)
questions.B: 10 — the value of the function at x = 2
questions.C: 4 — the average rate of change on [0, 2]
questions.D: 2x + 3 — the general formula, not a number
questions.expl: f(2) = 10 and $f(2 + h) = 10 + 7h + h^{2}$, so $f'(2) = \lim_{h \to 0} \frac{(7h + h^{2})}{h} = \lim_{h \to 0} (7 + h) = 7$ — the slope of the tangent at (2, 10).

en.text: Using the definition of the derivative, find f′(2) for $f(x) = x^{2} + 3x$ .

options.A: 2x + 3 — the general formula, not a number
options.B: 10 — the value of the function at x = 2
options.C: 7 — the slope of the tangent at the point (2, 10)
options.D: 4 — the average rate of change on [0, 2]

en.explanation: f(2) = 10 and $f(2 + h) = 10 + 7h + h^{2}$ , so $f'(2) = \lim_{h \to 0} \frac{(7h + h^{2})}{h} = \lim_{h \to 0} (7 + h) = 7$ — the slope of the tangent at (2, 10).

ru.text: По определению производной найдите f′(2) для $f(x) = x^{2} + 3x$.
ru.explanation: f(2) = 10 и $f(2 + h) = 10 + 7h + h^{2}$, поэтому $f'(2) = \lim_{h \to 0} \frac{(7h + h^{2})}{h} = \lim_{h \to 0} (7 + h) = 7$ — наклон касательной в точке (2, 10).

uz.text: Hosila taʼrifi boʻyicha $f(x) = x^{2} + 3x$ uchun f′(2) ni toping.
uz.explanation: f(2) = 10 va $f(2 + h) = 10 + 7h + h^{2}$, shuning uchun $f'(2) = \lim_{h \to 0} \frac{(7h + h^{2})}{h} = \lim_{h \to 0} (7 + h) = 7$ — (2, 10) nuqtadagi urinma qiyaligi.

questions.text: Compute $\frac{d}{dx} (x^{10})$.
questions.expl: By the power rule $\frac{d}{dx} (x^{n}) = n \cdot x^{n-1}$: the exponent becomes the coefficient and the power drops by one. Note that the power rule applies to $x^{n}$, not to functions like $3^{x}$.

en.text: Compute $\frac{d}{dx} (x^{10})$ .
en.explanation: By the power rule $\frac{d}{dx} (x^{n}) = n \cdot x^{n-1}$ : the exponent becomes the coefficient and the power drops by one. Note that the power rule applies to $x^{n}$ , not to functions like $3^{x}$ .

ru.text: Вычислите $\frac{d}{dx} (x^{10})$.
ru.explanation: По степенному правилу $\frac{d}{dx} (x^{n}) = n \cdot x^{n-1}$: показатель становится коэффициентом, степень понижается на 1. Степенное правило применимо к $x^{n}$, но не к функциям вида $3^{x}$.

uz.text: $\frac{d}{dx} (x^{10})$ ni hisoblang.
uz.explanation: Daraja qoidasi boʻyicha $\frac{d}{dx} (x^{n}) = n \cdot x^{n-1}$: koʻrsatkich koeffitsientga aylanadi, daraja bittaga kamayadi. Daraja qoidasi $x^{n}$ ga qoʻllanadi, $3^{x}$ kabi funksiyalarga emas.

questions.text: State the product rule for differentiating $f(x) \cdot g(x)$.
questions.expl: The derivative of a product is f′g + g′f — not the product of the derivatives (for $x \cdot x$ that would give 1, while the true derivative of $x^{2}$ is 2x).

en.text: State the product rule for differentiating $f(x) \cdot g(x)$ .
en.explanation: The derivative of a product is f′g + g′f — not the product of the derivatives (for $x \cdot x$ that would give 1, while the true derivative of $x^{2}$ is 2x).

ru.text: Сформулируйте правило произведения для дифференцирования $f(x) \cdot g(x)$.
ru.explanation: Производная произведения равна f′g + g′f — а не произведению производных (для $x \cdot x$ оно дало бы 1, тогда как настоящая производная $x^{2}$ равна 2x).

uz.text: $f(x) \cdot g(x)$ ni differensiallash uchun koʻpaytma qoidasini yozing.
uz.explanation: Koʻpaytmaning hosilasi f′g + g′f — hosilalar koʻpaytmasi emas $(x \cdot x$ uchun u 1 berardi, holbuki $x^{2}$ ning haqiqiy hosilasi 2x).

questions.text: A student writes $\frac{d}{dx} (x^{2} \cdot x^{3}) = (2x) \cdot (3x^{2}) = 6x^{3}$. What is the correct derivative?
questions.expl: Multiplying the derivatives is wrong. Either apply the product rule — $(2x) \cdot x^{3} + x^{2} \cdot (3x^{2}) = 2x^{4} + 3x^{4}$ — or simplify first: $x^{2} \cdot x^{3} = x^{5}$, so the derivative is $5x^{4}$.

en.text: A student writes $\frac{d}{dx} (x^{2} \cdot x^{3}) = (2x) \cdot (3x^{2}) = 6x^{3}$ . What is the correct derivative?
en.explanation: Multiplying the derivatives is wrong. Either apply the product rule — $(2x) \cdot x^{3} + x^{2} \cdot (3x^{2}) = 2x^{4} + 3x^{4}$ — or simplify first: $x^{2} \cdot x^{3} = x^{5}$ , so the derivative is $5x^{4}$ .

ru.text: Студент пишет: $\frac{d}{dx} (x^{2} \cdot x^{3}) = (2x) \cdot (3x^{2}) = 6x^{3}$. Какова правильная производная?

uz.text: Talaba $\frac{d}{dx} (x^{2} \cdot x^{3}) = (2x) \cdot (3x^{2}) = 6x^{3}$ deb yozdi. Toʻgʻri hosila qanday?
uz.explanation: Hosilalarni koʻpaytirish notoʻgʻri. Yoki koʻpaytma qoidasini qoʻllang — $(2x) \cdot x^{3} + x^{2} \cdot (3x^{2}) = 2x^{4} + 3x^{4}$, — yoki avval soddalashtiring: $x^{2} \cdot x^{3} = x^{5}$, demak hosila $5x^{4}$.

questions.text: Differentiate $f(x) = \frac{(x^{2} + 1)}{(x + 1)}$, $x \ne -1$.
questions.expl: By the quotient rule $f' = \frac{(f'g - g'f)}{g^{2}} = \frac{(2x(x + 1) - (x^{2} + 1))}{(x + 1)^{2}} = \frac{(x^{2} + 2x - 1)}{(x + 1)^{2}}$. The derivative of a quotient is not the quotient of the derivatives.

en.text: Differentiate $f(x) = \frac{(x^{2} + 1)}{(x + 1)}$ , $x \ne -1$ .
en.explanation: By the quotient rule $f' = \frac{(f'g - g'f)}{g^{2}} = \frac{(2x(x + 1) - (x^{2} + 1))}{(x + 1)^{2}} = \frac{(x^{2} + 2x - 1)}{(x + 1)^{2}}$ . The derivative of a quotient is not the quotient of the derivatives.

ru.text: Продифференцируйте $f(x) = \frac{(x^{2} + 1)}{(x + 1)}$, $x \ne -1$.
ru.explanation: По правилу частного $f' = \frac{(f'g - g'f)}{g^{2}} = \frac{(2x(x + 1) - (x^{2} + 1))}{(x + 1)^{2}} = \frac{(x^{2} + 2x - 1)}{(x + 1)^{2}}$. Производная частного — не частное производных.

uz.text: $f(x) = \frac{(x^{2} + 1)}{(x + 1)}$, $x \ne -1$ funksiyasini differensiallang.
uz.explanation: Nisbat qoidasi boʻyicha $f' = \frac{(f'g - g'f)}{g^{2}} = \frac{(2x(x + 1) - (x^{2} + 1))}{(x + 1)^{2}} = \frac{(x^{2} + 2x - 1)}{(x + 1)^{2}}$. Nisbatning hosilasi hosilalar nisbati emas.

questions.text: A student writes $\frac{d}{dx} (7x^{3} + 5) = 21x^{2} + 5$. What is the correct answer and which rule was misused?
questions.A: $21x^{2}$ — the derivative of a constant is 0
questions.B: $21x^{2} + 5$ — the sum rule was applied correctly
questions.C: $21x^{2} + 5x$ — the power rule requires adding an x
questions.D: $7x^{2}$ — the constant multiple rule divides by 3
questions.expl: By the sum rule, $\frac{d}{dx} (7x^{3} + 5) = 21x^{2} + 0$: the derivative of the constant 5 is 0 (constant rule), so the answer is $21x^{2}$.

options.B: $21x^{2} + 5x$ — the power rule requires adding an x

options.D: $21x^{2}$ — the derivative of a constant is 0

en.explanation: By the sum rule, $\frac{d}{dx} (7x^{3} + 5) = 21x^{2} + 0$ : the derivative of the constant 5 is 0 (constant rule), so the answer is $21x^{2}$ .

questions.text: Compute $\frac{d}{dx} (\frac{6}{x^{2}})$.
questions.expl: Rewrite as a power: $\frac{6}{x^{2}} = 6x^{-2}$, so the derivative is $6 \cdot (-2) \cdot x^{-3} = -\frac{12}{x^{3}}$. Rewriting fractions as powers is often easier than the quotient rule.

en.text: Compute $\frac{d}{dx} (\frac{6}{x^{2}})$ .
en.explanation: Rewrite as a power: $\frac{6}{x^{2}} = 6x^{-2}$ , so the derivative is $6 \cdot (-2) \cdot x^{-3} = -\frac{12}{x^{3}}$ . Rewriting fractions as powers is often easier than the quotient rule.

ru.text: Вычислите $\frac{d}{dx} (\frac{6}{x^{2}})$.
ru.explanation: Перепишите как степень: $\frac{6}{x^{2}} = 6x^{-2}$, поэтому производная равна $6 \cdot (-2) \cdot x^{-3} = -\frac{12}{x^{3}}$. Переписывание дробей степенями часто проще правила частного.

uz.text: $\frac{d}{dx} (\frac{6}{x^{2}})$ ni hisoblang.
uz.explanation: Daraja shaklida yozing: $\frac{6}{x^{2}} = 6x^{-2}$, shuning uchun hosila $6 \cdot (-2) \cdot x^{-3} = -\frac{12}{x^{3}}$. Kasrlarni daraja shaklida yozish koʻpincha nisbat qoidasidan osonroq.

questions.text: Which statement is true?
questions.A: If f is differentiable at a, then f is continuous at a (the converse is false: |x| at 0)
questions.B: If f is continuous at a, then f is differentiable at a
questions.C: If f′(a) = 0, then f is a constant function
questions.D: If both one-sided derivatives at a exist and are finite, then f′(a) exists
questions.expl: Differentiability implies continuity (Theorem 3.1), but not conversely: |x| is continuous at 0 yet has no derivative there. For f′(a) to exist, the one-sided derivatives must also be equal, and f′(a) = 0 at a single point does not make f constant.

en.text: Which statement is true?

options.A: If f is differentiable at a, then f is continuous at a (the converse is false: |x| at 0)
options.B: If both one-sided derivatives at a exist and are finite, then f′(a) exists
options.C: If f′(a) = 0, then f is a constant function
options.D: If f is continuous at a, then f is differentiable at a

en.explanation: Differentiability implies continuity (Theorem 3.1), but not conversely: |x| is continuous at 0 yet has no derivative there. For f′(a) to exist, the one-sided derivatives must also be equal, and f′(a) = 0 at a single point does not make f constant.

questions.text: For f(x) = |x|, find the one-sided derivatives at 0.
questions.A: $f'_-(0) = -1$ and $f'_+(0) = 1$, so f′(0) does not exist (a kink)
questions.expl: The difference quotient is |$h|/h$, which equals −1 for h < 0 and 1 for h > 0. The one-sided limits differ, so f′(0) does not exist — the graph has a corner (kink) at the origin.

questions.text: The function $f(x) = x^{\frac{1}{3}}$ (cube root of x) is continuous at x = 0. What happens to its derivative there?
questions.A: The difference quotient $\frac{1}{h^{\frac{2}{3}}} \to + \infty$ from both sides: a vertical tangent, no finite derivative
questions.expl: $\frac{(h^{\frac{1}{3}} - 0)}{h} = \frac{1}{h^{\frac{2}{3}}} \to + \infty$ from both sides. The graph is continuous but has the vertical tangent line x = 0; no finite derivative exists (informally one writes $f'(0) = + \infty$).

en.text: The function $f(x) = x^{\frac{1}{3}}$ (cube root of x) is continuous at x = 0. What happens to its derivative there?

options.D: The difference quotient $\frac{1}{h^{\frac{2}{3}}} \to + \infty$ from both sides: a vertical tangent, no finite derivative

questions.text: The function $p(x) = |x|^{\frac{2}{3}}$ is continuous at 0. Classify the behavior of its graph at that point.
questions.A: A cusp: the slopes tend to $-\infty$ from the left and $+\infty$ from the right
questions.B: A kink: the slopes are −1 and 1
questions.C: A vertical tangent: $+\infty$ from both sides
questions.expl: |$h|^{\frac{2}{3}}/h \to - \infty$ as $h \to 0^{-}$ and $\to + \infty$ as $h \to 0^{+}$: infinite slopes of opposite signs — a cusp. The function is continuous, but no finite derivative exists at 0.

ru.text: Функция $p(x) = |x|^{\frac{2}{3}}$ непрерывна в нуле. Опишите поведение её графика в этой точке.

uz.text: $p(x) = |x|^{\frac{2}{3}}$ funksiyasi 0 da uzluksiz. Grafikning bu nuqtadagi xatti-harakatini tasniflang.

questions.text: Let $j = f \cdot g$. Given f(2) = 3, f′(2) = −4, g(2) = 1 and g′(2) = 6, compute j′(2).
questions.expl: By the product rule, $j'(2) = f'(2) \cdot g(2) + g'(2) \cdot f(2) = (-4) \cdot 1 + 6 \cdot 3 = -4 + 18 = 14$.

questions.text: Given f(3) = 2 and f′(3) = 5, use the increment formula to estimate f(3.2).

questions.text: A ball is dropped from a height of 64 feet, so $s(t) = -16t^{2} + 64$. What is its instantaneous velocity at the moment it hits the ground?

uz.explanation: Yer s(t) = 0 boʻlganda yetiladi: $t^{2} = 4$, yaʼni t = 2 s. v(t) = s′(t) = −32t boʻlgani uchun urilish tezligi v(2) = −64 fut/$s$ (minus ishorasi pastga harakatni bildiradi).

questions.text: A particle moves along a line with $s(t) = t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 24t + 4$, $t \ge 0$. At what times is the particle at rest?
questions.D: Never: the velocity is always positive
questions.expl: The particle is at rest when v(t) = s′(t) = 0: $3t^{2} - 18t + 24 = 3(t - 2)(t - 4) = 0$ gives t = 2 and t = 4.

en.text: A particle moves along a line with $s(t) = t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 24t + 4$ , $t \ge 0$ . At what times is the particle at rest?

options.C: Never: the velocity is always positive

en.explanation: The particle is at rest when v(t) = s′(t) = 0: $3t^{2} - 18t + 24 = 3(t - 2)(t - 4) = 0$ gives t = 2 and t = 4.

ru.text: Частица движется по оси: $s(t) = t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 24t + 4$, $t \ge 0$. В какие моменты частица покоится?
ru.explanation: Частица покоится, когда v(t) = s′(t) = 0: $3t^{2} - 18t + 24 = 3(t - 2)(t - 4) = 0$ даёт t = 2 и t = 4.

uz.text: Zarracha $s(t) = t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 24t + 4$, $t \ge 0$ qonuni boʻyicha harakatlanadi. Qaysi momentlarda zarracha tinch turadi?

options.D: hech qachon: tezlik har doim musbat

uz.explanation: Zarracha v(t) = s′(t) = 0 boʻlganda tinch turadi: $3t^{2} - 18t + 24 = 3(t - 2)(t - 4) = 0$ dan t = 2 va t = 4 keladi.

questions.text: In a related-rates problem, when should you substitute the known numerical values (such as "when r = 30")?
questions.A: After differentiating the relation with respect to t — substituting earlier would freeze the equation and lose the rates
questions.B: Before differentiating, to simplify the algebra
questions.D: Only after solving explicitly for the unknown function
questions.expl: Numbers substituted before differentiation turn the relation into a constant equation whose derivative is 0 — the rates would be lost. Differentiate the relation first, then substitute the instantaneous snapshot values.

en.text: In a related-rates problem, when should you substitute the known numerical values (such as "when r = 30")?

options.A: Only after solving explicitly for the unknown function
options.B: After differentiating the relation with respect to t — substituting earlier would freeze the equation and lose the rates
options.C: Before differentiating, to simplify the algebra

ru.text: В задаче на связанные скорости когда следует подставлять известные числовые значения (например, «когда r = 30»)?

options.A: После дифференцирования связи по t — подстановка раньше превратила бы уравнение в константу и скорости были бы потеряны
options.D: Только после явного решения относительно неизвестной функции

ru.explanation: Числа, подставленные до дифференцирования, превращают связь в константное уравнение с нулевой производной — скорости теряются. Сначала продифференцируйте связь, затем подставьте мгновенный снимок значений.

uz.text: Oʻzaro bogʻliq tezliklar masalasida maʼlum sonli qiymatlarni (masalan, «r = 30 boʻlganda») qachon qoʻyish kerak?

options.A: Bogʻliqlikni t boʻyicha differensiallagandan keyin — undan oldin qoʻysak tenglama doimiyga aylanib, tezliklar yoʻqoladi
options.D: Faqat nomaʼlum funksiyani ochiq ifodalab yechgandan keyin

questions.text: A spherical balloon is inflated at $800 \frac{cm^{3}}{min}$. How fast is the radius increasing when r = 30 cm? $(V = (\frac{4}{3}) \pi r^{3})$
questions.expl: $\frac{dV}{dt} = 4 \pi r^{2} \cdot (\frac{dr}{dt})$, so $\frac{dr}{dt} = \frac{800}{4 \pi \cdot 30^{2}} = \frac{800}{3600 \pi } = \frac{2}{9 \pi } \approx 0.0707 \frac{cm}{min}$.

en.text: A spherical balloon is inflated at $800 \frac{cm^{3}}{min}$ . How fast is the radius increasing when r = 30 cm? $(V = (\frac{4}{3}) \pi r^{3})$
en.explanation: $\frac{dV}{dt} = 4 \pi r^{2} \cdot (\frac{dr}{dt})$ , so $\frac{dr}{dt} = \frac{800}{4 \pi \cdot 30^{2}} = \frac{800}{3600 \pi } = \frac{2}{9 \pi } \approx 0.0707 \frac{cm}{min}$ .

uz.text: Sferik shar $800 \frac{sm^{3}}{min}$ tezlik bilan puflanmoqda. r = 30 sm boʻlganda radius qanchalik tez oʻsadi? $(V = (\frac{4}{3}) \pi r^{3})$

questions.text: A 10-ft ladder leans against a wall. The bottom slides away from the wall at $1 \frac{ft}{s}$. How fast is the top sliding down the wall when the bottom is 6 ft from the wall?
questions.expl: From $x^{2} + y^{2} = 100$ with x = 6 we get y = 8. Differentiating: $2x \cdot (\frac{dx}{dt}) + 2y \cdot (\frac{dy}{dt}) = 0$, so $\frac{dy}{dt} = -(\frac{6}{8}) \cdot 1 = -\frac{3}{4} \frac{ft}{s}$ — the top slides down at $\frac{3}{4} \frac{ft}{s}$.

en.text: A 10-ft ladder leans against a wall. The bottom slides away from the wall at $1 \frac{ft}{s}$ . How fast is the top sliding down the wall when the bottom is 6 ft from the wall?
en.explanation: From $x^{2} + y^{2} = 100$ with x = 6 we get y = 8. Differentiating: $2x \cdot (\frac{dx}{dt}) + 2y \cdot (\frac{dy}{dt}) = 0$ , so $\frac{dy}{dt} = -(\frac{6}{8}) \cdot 1 = -\frac{3}{4} \frac{ft}{s}$ — the top slides down at $\frac{3}{4} \frac{ft}{s}$ .

ru.text: Лестница длиной 10 футов опирается о стену. Нижний конец скользит по полу от стены со скоростью 1 фут$/$с. Как быстро верхний конец скользит вниз, когда нижний находится в 6 футах от стены?
ru.explanation: Из $x^{2} + y^{2} = 100$ при x = 6 получаем y = 8. Дифференцирование: $2x \cdot (\frac{dx}{dt}) + 2y \cdot (\frac{dy}{dt}) = 0$, откуда $\frac{dy}{dt} = -(\frac{6}{8}) \cdot 1 = -\frac{3}{4}$ фут$/$с — верх скользит вниз со скоростью $\frac{3}{4}$ фут$/$с.

uz.text: 10 fut uzunlikdagi narvon devorga suyangan. Pastki uchi devordan 1 fut/$s$ tezlik bilan sirpanmoqda. Pastki uchi devordan 6 fut masofada boʻlganda yuqori uchi qanchalik tez pastga sirpanadi?
uz.explanation: $x^{2} + y^{2} = 100$ dan x = 6 boʻlganda y = 8 keladi. Differensiallash: $2x \cdot (\frac{dx}{dt}) + 2y \cdot (\frac{dy}{dt}) = 0$, demak $\frac{dy}{dt} = -(\frac{6}{8}) \cdot 1 = -\frac{3}{4}$ fut/$s$ — yuqori uch $\frac{3}{4}$ fut/$s$ tezlik bilan pastga sirpanadi.

questions.text: A 6-ft person walks away from a 15-ft lamppost at $5 \frac{ft}{s}$. How fast is the tip of their shadow moving?
questions.A: $\frac{25}{3} \approx 8.33 \frac{ft}{s}$: by similar triangles $s = (\frac{2}{3})x$, so $L = x + s = (\frac{5}{3})x$ and $\frac{dL}{dt} = (\frac{5}{3}) \cdot 5$
questions.B: $5 \frac{ft}{s}$ — the same speed as the person
questions.expl: Similar triangles give $\frac{15}{(x + s)} = \frac{6}{s}$, so $s = (\frac{2}{3})x$ and $L = x + s = (\frac{5}{3})x$. Hence $\frac{dL}{dt} = (\frac{5}{3}) \cdot (\frac{dx}{dt}) = \frac{25}{3} \frac{ft}{s}$ — independent of the distance from the post.

options.B: $5 \frac{ft}{s}$ — the same speed as the person

en.explanation: Similar triangles give $\frac{15}{(x + s)} = \frac{6}{s}$ , so $s = (\frac{2}{3})x$ and $L = x + s = (\frac{5}{3})x$ . Hence $\frac{dL}{dt} = (\frac{5}{3}) \cdot (\frac{dx}{dt}) = \frac{25}{3} \frac{ft}{s}$ — independent of the distance from the post.

ru.text: Человек ростом 6 футов уходит от 15-футового фонарного столба со скоростью 5 фут$/$с. Как быстро движется кончик его тени?

options.A: $\frac{25}{3} \approx 8.33$ фут$/$с: из подобия $s = (\frac{2}{3})x$, поэтому $L = x + s = (\frac{5}{3})x$ и $\frac{dL}{dt} = (\frac{5}{3}) \cdot 5$
options.B: 5 фут$/$с — с той же скоростью, что и человек

ru.explanation: Подобие треугольников даёт $\frac{15}{(x + s)} = \frac{6}{s}$, откуда $s = (\frac{2}{3})x$ и $L = x + s = (\frac{5}{3})x$. Поэтому $\frac{dL}{dt} = (\frac{5}{3}) \cdot (\frac{dx}{dt}) = \frac{25}{3}$ фут$/$с — не зависит от расстояния до столба.

uz.text: 6 fut boʻyli odam 15 futlik koʻcha chirogʻidan 5 fut/$s$ tezlik bilan uzoqlashmoqda. Soyasi uchi qanchalik tez harakatlanadi?

options.A: $\frac{25}{3} \approx 8.33$ fut/$s$: oʻxshashlikdan $s = (\frac{2}{3})x$, demak $L = x + s = (\frac{5}{3})x$ va $\frac{dL}{dt} = (\frac{5}{3}) \cdot 5$
options.B: 5 fut/$s$ — odam harakatlanayotgan tezlik bilan bir xil

uz.explanation: Oʻxshash uchburchaklar $\frac{15}{(x + s)} = \frac{6}{s}$ beradi, demak $s = (\frac{2}{3})x$ va $L = x + s = (\frac{5}{3})x$. Shuning uchun $\frac{dL}{dt} = (\frac{5}{3}) \cdot (\frac{dx}{dt}) = \frac{25}{3}$ fut/$s$ — ustun masofasiga bogʻliq emas.

questions.text: Water flows INTO an inverted conical tank (height 12 m, top radius 6 m) at $9 \frac{m^{3}}{min}$. The water level rises at $0.2 \frac{m}{min}$ when the depth is 4 m. At what rate is water leaking out?
questions.expl: By similarity $r = \frac{h}{2}$, so $V = ( \frac{\pi}{12})h^{3}$ and the net rate is $\frac{dV}{dt} = ( \frac{\pi h^{2}}{4}) \cdot (\frac{dh}{dt}) = ( \pi \cdot \frac{16}{4}) \cdot 0.2 = 0.8 \pi \approx 2.513 \frac{m^{3}}{min}$. Since net = inflow − leak: leak = $9 - 0.8 \pi \approx 6.49 \frac{m^{3}}{min}$.

en.text: Water flows INTO an inverted conical tank (height 12 m, top radius 6 m) at $9 \frac{m^{3}}{min}$ . The water level rises at $0.2 \frac{m}{min}$ when the depth is 4 m. At what rate is water leaking out?
en.explanation: By similarity $r = \frac{h}{2}$ , so $V = ( \frac{\pi}{12})h^{3}$ and the net rate is $\frac{dV}{dt} = ( \frac{\pi h^{2}}{4}) \cdot (\frac{dh}{dt}) = ( \pi \cdot \frac{16}{4}) \cdot 0.2 = 0.8 \pi \approx 2.513 \frac{m^{3}}{min}$ . Since net = inflow − leak: leak = $9 - 0.8 \pi \approx 6.49 \frac{m^{3}}{min}$ .

ru.text: Вода вливается в перевёрнутый конический бак (высота 12 м, верхний радиус 6 м) со скоростью 9 м$^{3}/$мин. Уровень воды поднимается со скоростью 0.2 м$/$мин при глубине 4 м. С какой скоростью вода вытекает из бака?
ru.explanation: Из подобия $r = \frac{h}{2}$, поэтому $V = ( \frac{\pi}{12})h^{3}$ и чистая скорость $\frac{dV}{dt} = ( \frac{\pi h^{2}}{4}) \cdot (\frac{dh}{dt}) = ( \pi \cdot \frac{16}{4}) \cdot 0.2 = 0.8 \pi \approx 2.513$ м$^{3}/$мин. Так как чистая = приток − утечка: утечка = $9 - 0.8 \pi \approx 6.49$ м$^{3}/$мин.

uz.text: Suv teskari konus shaklidagi bakka (balandligi 12 m, yuqori radiusi 6 m) $9 \frac{m^{3}}{min}$ tezlik bilan quyilmoqda. Chuqurlik 4 m boʻlganda suv sathi $0.2 \frac{m}{min}$ koʻtariladi. Suv qanchalik tez oqib chiqmoqda?

Toza = kirish − oqim boʻlgani uchun: oqim = $9 - 0.8 \pi \approx 6.49 \frac{m^{3}}{min}$.

uz.text: Ikki avtomobil bir nuqtadan yoʻlga chiqadi: biri $60 km/$soat tezlik bilan janubga, ikkinchisi $50 km/$soat bilan gʻarbga ketadi. 2 soatdan keyin ular orasidagi masofa qanchalik tez oʻsadi?
uz.explanation: 2 soatdan keyin: x = 100, y = 120, $z = \sqrt{100}^{2} + 120^{2}) = 20\sqrt{61}$. $z^{2} = x^{2} + y^{2}$ dan: $\frac{dz}{dt} = \frac{(x \cdot (\frac{dx}{dt}) + y \cdot (\frac{dy}{dt}))}{z} = (5000 + 7200)/(20\sqrt{61} = 10\sqrt{61} \approx 78.1 km/$soat.

questions.text: Gravel is poured at $30 \frac{ft^{3}}{min}$, forming a conical pile whose base diameter always equals its height. How fast is the height growing when it is 10 ft?
questions.expl: With 2r = h we have $r = \frac{h}{2}$, so $V = (\frac{1}{3}) \pi (\frac{h}{2})^{2} \cdot h = ( \frac{\pi}{12})h^{3}$ and $\frac{dV}{dt} = ( \frac{\pi h^{2}}{4}) \cdot (\frac{dh}{dt})$. Thus $\frac{dh}{dt} = 4 \cdot \frac{30}{ \pi \cdot 10^{2}} = \frac{120}{100 \pi } = \frac{6}{5 \pi } \approx 0.382 \frac{ft}{min}$.

questions.text: A boat is pulled toward a dock by a rope through a pulley 1 m above the bow. The rope is shortened at $1 \frac{m}{s}$. How fast is the boat approaching the dock when it is 8 m away?
questions.expl: With $l^{2} = x^{2} + 1$ and $\frac{dl}{dt} = -1$: at x = 8 we have $l = \sqrt{65}$, so $\frac{dx}{dt} = (\frac{l}{x}) \cdot (\frac{dl}{dt}) = -\sqrt{65}/8 \approx -1.008 \frac{m}{s}$ — the boat approaches at $\sqrt{65}/8 \frac{m}{s}$.

ru.text: Лодку подтягивают к причалу канатом, продетым через блок на 1 м выше носа лодки. Канат выбирают со скоростью 1 м$/$с. Как быстро лодка приближается к причалу, когда она находится в 8 м от него?

uz.text: Qayiq burnidan 1 m yuqorida joylashgan blokdan oʻtgan arqon bilan qirgʻoqqa tortilmoqda. Arqon $1 \frac{m}{s}$ tezlik bilan qisqartirilmoqda. Qayiq qirgʻoqdan 8 m masofada boʻlganda u qanchalik tez yaqinlashmoqda?

questions.text: A particle moves along the curve $y = \sqrt{x}$ so that its x-coordinate increases at 2 units/$s$. How fast is the y-coordinate changing at the point (4, 2)?
questions.expl: $\frac{dy}{dt} = (\frac{dy}{dx} ) \cdot (\frac{dx}{dt}) = (\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}} \cdot 2$; at x = 4 this is $(\frac{1}{4}) \cdot 2 = \frac{1}{2}$ unit/$s$ — the y-coordinate is increasing.

uz.text: Zarracha $y = \sqrt{x}$ egri chiziq boʻylab harakatlanadi, abssissasi 2 birlik/$s$ tezlik bilan oʻsadi. (4, 2) nuqtada ordinata qanchalik tez oʻzgaradi?
uz.explanation: $\frac{dy}{dt} = (\frac{dy}{dx} ) \cdot (\frac{dx}{dt}) = (\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}} \cdot 2$; x = 4 da bu $(\frac{1}{4}) \cdot 2 = \frac{1}{2}$ birlik/$s$ — ordinata oʻsishda.

questions.text: What are $\frac{d}{dx} (\sin x)$ and $\frac{d}{dx} (\cos x)$?
questions.expl: Theorem 3.8: the derivative of sin is cos, and the derivative of cos is −sin. At the maxima and minima of sin x we have cos x = 0 — the tangent to the sine curve is horizontal there.

en.text: What are $\frac{d}{dx} (\sin x)$ and $\frac{d}{dx} (\cos x)$ ?
en.explanation: Theorem 3.8: the derivative of sin is cos, and the derivative of cos is −sin. At the maxima and minima of sin x we have cos x = 0 — the tangent to the sine curve is horizontal there.

ru.text: Чему равны $\frac{d}{dx} (\sin x)$ и $\frac{d}{dx} (\cos x)$?
ru.explanation: Теорема 3.8: производная синуса — косинус, производная косинуса — минус синус. В точках максимума и минимума sin x имеем cos x = 0 — касательная к синусоиде там горизонтальна.

uz.text: $\frac{d}{dx} (\sin x)$ va $\frac{d}{dx} (\cos x)$ nimaga teng?
uz.explanation: 3.8-teorema: sinusning hosilasi — kosinus, kosinusning hosilasi — minus sinus. sin x ning maksimum va minimum nuqtalarida cos x = 0 — sinus grafigiga urinma u yerda gorizontal.

questions.text: Starting from $\tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x}$, derive $\frac{d}{dx} (\tan x)$.
questions.A: $\sec ^{2} x$, since $\frac{(\cos ^{2} x + \sin ^{2} x)}{\cos ^{2} x} = \frac{1}{\cos ^{2} x}$
questions.expl: By the quotient rule: $\frac{(\cos x \cdot \cos x - (-\sin x) \cdot \sin x)}{\cos ^{2} x} = \frac{(\cos ^{2} x + \sin ^{2} x)}{\cos ^{2} x} = \frac{1}{\cos ^{2} x} = \sec ^{2} x$.

en.text: Starting from $\tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x}$ , derive $\frac{d}{dx} (\tan x)$ .

options.B: $\sec ^{2} x$ , since $\frac{(\cos ^{2} x + \sin ^{2} x)}{\cos ^{2} x} = \frac{1}{\cos ^{2} x}$

en.explanation: By the quotient rule: $\frac{(\cos x \cdot \cos x - (-\sin x) \cdot \sin x)}{\cos ^{2} x} = \frac{(\cos ^{2} x + \sin ^{2} x)}{\cos ^{2} x} = \frac{1}{\cos ^{2} x} = \sec ^{2} x$ .

ru.text: Исходя из $\tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x}$, выведите $\frac{d}{dx} (\tan x)$.

uz.text: $\tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x}$ dan boshlab $\frac{d}{dx} (\tan x)$ ni chiqaring.

questions.text: Compute $\frac{d^{74}}{dx^{7}}4 (\sin x)$.
questions.A: −sin x, since $74 = 4 \cdot 18 + 2$ and the derivatives cycle with period 4
questions.expl: The derivatives of sin cycle: $\sin \to \cos \to -\sin \to -\cos \to \sin$ ... with period 4. Since 74 leaves remainder 2 on division by 4, the 74th derivative equals the 2nd: −sin x.

en.text: Compute $\frac{d^{74}}{dx^{7}}4 (\sin x)$ .

options.C: −sin x, since $74 = 4 \cdot 18 + 2$ and the derivatives cycle with period 4

en.explanation: The derivatives of sin cycle: $\sin \to \cos \to -\sin \to -\cos \to \sin$ ... with period 4. Since 74 leaves remainder 2 on division by 4, the 74th derivative equals the 2nd: −sin x.

options.A: −sin x, так как $74 = 4 \cdot 18 + 2$ и производные цикличны с периодом 4

ru.explanation: Производные синуса цикличны: $\sin \to \cos \to -\sin \to -\cos \to \sin$ ... с периодом 4. Так как 74 даёт остаток 2 при делении на 4, 74-я производная равна 2-й: −sin x.

uz.text: $\frac{d^{74}}{dx^{7}}4 (\sin x)$ ni hisoblang.

options.A: −sin x, chunki $74 = 4 \cdot 18 + 2$ va hosilalar 4 davr bilan takrorlanadi

uz.explanation: Sinus hosilalari siklik: $\sin \to \cos \to -\sin \to -\cos \to \sin$ ... 4 davr bilan. 74 ning 4 ga boʻlinishida qoldiq 2 boʻlgani uchun 74-hosila 2-hosilaga teng: −sin x.

questions.text: Differentiate $f(x) = e^{2x}$.
questions.expl: By $\frac{d}{dx} (e^(g(x))) = e^(g(x)) \cdot g'(x)$ with g(x) = 2x: $f'(x) = e^{2x} \cdot 2 = 2e^{2x}$. The exponential keeps itself, and the chain factor is the derivative of the exponent.

en.text: Differentiate $f(x) = e^{2x}$ .
en.explanation: By $\frac{d}{dx} (e^(g(x))) = e^(g(x)) \cdot g'(x)$ with g(x) = 2x: $f'(x) = e^{2x} \cdot 2 = 2e^{2x}$ . The exponential keeps itself, and the chain factor is the derivative of the exponent.

ru.text: Продифференцируйте $f(x) = e^{2x}$.
ru.explanation: По правилу $\frac{d}{dx} (e^(g(x))) = e^(g(x)) \cdot g'(x)$ при g(x) = 2x: $f'(x) = e^{2x} \cdot 2 = 2e^{2x}$. Экспонента сохраняется, а цепной множитель — производная показателя.

uz.text: $f(x) = e^{2x}$ funksiyasini differensiallang.
uz.explanation: $\frac{d}{dx} (e^(g(x))) = e^(g(x)) \cdot g'(x)$ qoidasi boʻyicha, g(x) = 2x: $f'(x) = e^{2x} \cdot 2 = 2e^{2x}$. Eksponent oʻzini saqlaydi, zanjir koʻpaytuvchisi esa koʻrsatkich hosilasidir.

questions.text: Differentiate $f(x) = 3e^{x} + 2^{x} - 5$ and find f′(0).
questions.expl: $(e^{x})' = e^{x}$ and $(2^{x})' = 2^{x} \cdot \ln 2$ (since $2^{x} = e^(x \cdot \ln 2)$); the derivative of −5 is 0. So $f'(0) = 3 \cdot 1 + 1 \cdot \ln 2 = 3 + \ln 2 \approx 3.693$.

en.text: Differentiate $f(x) = 3e^{x} + 2^{x} - 5$ and find f′(0).
en.explanation: $(e^{x})' = e^{x}$ and $(2^{x})' = 2^{x} \cdot \ln 2$ (since $2^{x} = e^(x \cdot \ln 2)$ ); the derivative of −5 is 0. So $f'(0) = 3 \cdot 1 + 1 \cdot \ln 2 = 3 + \ln 2 \approx 3.693$ .

ru.text: Продифференцируйте $f(x) = 3e^{x} + 2^{x} - 5$ и найдите f′(0).

questions.text: Differentiate $f(x) = x \cdot \ln x (x > 0)$.
questions.expl: By the product rule: $f' = 1 \cdot \ln x + x \cdot (\frac{1}{x}) = \ln x + 1$.

en.text: Differentiate $f(x) = x \cdot \ln x (x > 0)$ .
en.explanation: By the product rule: $f' = 1 \cdot \ln x + x \cdot (\frac{1}{x}) = \ln x + 1$ .

questions.text: Differentiate $g(x) = \frac{e^{x}}{x} (x \ne 0)$.
questions.expl: By the quotient rule: $g' = \frac{(e^{x} \cdot x - e^{x} \cdot 1)}{x^{2}} = e^{x} \cdot \frac{(x - 1)}{x^{2}}$.

en.text: Differentiate $g(x) = \frac{e^{x}}{x} (x \ne 0)$ .
en.explanation: By the quotient rule: $g' = \frac{(e^{x} \cdot x - e^{x} \cdot 1)}{x^{2}} = e^{x} \cdot \frac{(x - 1)}{x^{2}}$ .

ru.text: Продифференцируйте $g(x) = \frac{e^{x}}{x} (x \ne 0)$.

uz.text: $g(x) = \frac{e^{x}}{x} (x \ne 0)$ funksiyasini differensiallang.

questions.text: A discharging capacitor has voltage $V(t) = 12 \cdot e^{-\frac{t}{2}} V (t$ in seconds). Find the initial rate of change of the voltage and V′(2).
questions.expl: $V'(t) = 12 \cdot e^{-\frac{t}{2}} \cdot (-\frac{1}{2}) = -6 \cdot e^{-\frac{t}{2}}$. So $V'(0) = -6 \frac{V}{s}$ and $V'(2) = -6 \cdot e^{-1} \approx -2.21 \frac{V}{s}$: the voltage decreases, and the rate of decrease slows over time.

en.text: A discharging capacitor has voltage $V(t) = 12 \cdot e^{-\frac{t}{2}} V (t$ in seconds). Find the initial rate of change of the voltage and V′(2).

ru.explanation: $V'(t) = 12 \cdot e^{-\frac{t}{2}} \cdot (-\frac{1}{2}) = -6 \cdot e^{-\frac{t}{2}}$. Поэтому V′(0) = −6 В$/$с и $V'(2) = -6 \cdot e^{-1} \approx -2.21$ В$/$с: напряжение убывает, причём скорость убывания со временем замедляется.

uz.text: Zaryadsizlanayotgan kondensatorning kuchlanishi $V(t) = 12 \cdot e^{-\frac{t}{2}} V (t$ sekundlarda). Kuchlanishning boshlangʻich oʻzgarish tezligini va V′(2) ni toping.

questions.text: Find the derivative of $f(x) = e^{x^3}$.
questions.expl: With $g(x) = x^{3}$ and $g'(x) = 3x^{2}$: $f'(x) = e^{x^3} \cdot 3x^{2} = 3x^{2} \cdot e^{x^3}$. The exponential stays unchanged; the chain rule adds the derivative of the exponent.

en.text: Find the derivative of $f(x) = e^{x^3}$ .
en.explanation: With $g(x) = x^{3}$ and $g'(x) = 3x^{2}$ : $f'(x) = e^{x^3} \cdot 3x^{2} = 3x^{2} \cdot e^{x^3}$ . The exponential stays unchanged; the chain rule adds the derivative of the exponent.

ru.text: Найдите производную функции $f(x) = e^{x^3}$.
ru.explanation: При $g(x) = x^{3}$ и $g'(x) = 3x^{2}$: $f'(x) = e^{x^3} \cdot 3x^{2} = 3x^{2} \cdot e^{x^3}$. Экспонента не меняется; цепное правило добавляет производную показателя.

uz.explanation: $g(x) = x^{3}$ va $g'(x) = 3x^{2}$ boʻlgani uchun: $f'(x) = e^{x^3} \cdot 3x^{2} = 3x^{2} \cdot e^{x^3}$. Eksponent oʻzgarmaydi; zanjir qoidasi koʻrsatkich hosilasini qoʻshadi.

questions.text: In a region of space there is the potential energy $U(x, y, z) = b(x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}) -$ bxy + c where b and c are constants of suitable size. What is the analytical expression of the force?
questions.expl: Force is the negative gradient of potential energy, so F = -∇U = -[$2bx - by$, $2by - bx$, $2bz$].

questions.text: The radius of the Earth is about $R_{E} = 6370 km$. An object with mass 20 kg is taken to a height of 160 km above the Earth's surface. 1) What is the object's mass at this height? 2) How much does the object weigh at this height?
questions.A: 1) The mass decreases; 2) The weight is 196.0 N
questions.B: 1) The mass is the same; 2) The weight is 186.5 N
questions.C: 1) The mass is the same; 2) The weight is 196.0 N
questions.D: 1) The mass decreases; 2) The weight is 186.5 N
questions.expl: 1) Mass is constant (independent of height); 2) Weight = mg' = 20 kg × 9.325 m/s² = 186.5 N (g' = GM/(R_E + 160 km)²).

questions.text:
A physical pendulum swings around an axis passing through a point P located a distance d from the center of mass. The pendulum has: 
• Mass M, 
• Moment of inertia I about the rotation axis, 
• Distance d from the center of mass to axis P. 
What is the period T of small oscillations?
questions.expl: Period formula for physical pendulum is T = $2π√(I / Mgd)$, matching option A.

• момент инерции I относительно оси вращения, 
• расстояние d от центра масс до оси P.

ru.explanation: Формула периода физического маятника: T = $2π√(I / Mgd)$, что соответствует варианту A.
